```{r display_optimal_thresholds, results='asis'}
# Display results of optimal threshold analysis
cat("# Defining Optimal On-Treatment ctDNA Changes as Intermediate Endpoints\n\n")

if (exists("optimal_threshold_results") && length(optimal_threshold_results) > 0) {
  cat("## Systematic Evaluation of ctDNA Change Thresholds\n\n")
  cat("This analysis tests multiple thresholds for on-treatment ctDNA changes to identify which best predict clinical outcomes. **Lower HR values indicate better outcomes** (longer survival, longer DCR, longer TTNT) for patients meeting the threshold.\n\n")
  
  # Get the actual N from landmark analysis for context
  if (exists("landmark_outcomes") && nrow(landmark_outcomes) > 0) {
    landmark_n <- nrow(landmark_outcomes)
    landmark_unique_n <- n_distinct(landmark_outcomes$patient_id)
    # Check how many have valid pct_decline
    valid_pct_decline_n <- sum(!is.na(landmark_outcomes$pct_decline) & !is.infinite(landmark_outcomes$pct_decline))
    cat("**Note on sample sizes:** The landmark analysis includes ", landmark_n, " patient-line observations (", landmark_unique_n, " unique patients). The threshold analysis below includes ", valid_pct_decline_n, " patient-line observations with valid percent decline calculations. Some thresholds may have smaller N due to additional filtering requirements (e.g., requiring baseline ctDNA > 0 for certain thresholds).\n\n", sep = "")
  }
  
  cat("**Understanding the table columns:**\n")
  cat("- **N (Total)**: Total number of patient-line observations with valid data for evaluating that threshold.\n")
  cat("- **N (Met Threshold)**: Number of patient-line observations that met the threshold criteria (e.g., had ≥90% decline for the ≥90% threshold). As thresholds become less strict (from 100% clearance to 30% decline), more patients meet the criteria, so this number increases. For example, 11 patients had complete clearance (100%), while 22 patients had ≥30% decline.\n")
  cat("- For median-based thresholds (on-treatment ctDNA < median), N (Total) may be lower (e.g., 18 vs 30) because these require baseline ctDNA > 0 to calculate percent decline.\n\n")
  
  # Create summary table
  threshold_summary <- tibble()
  
  for (threshold_name in names(optimal_threshold_results)) {
    threshold_info <- optimal_threshold_results[[threshold_name]]
    
    # Extract outcome results
    dcr_hr <- if (!is.null(threshold_info$outcomes$DCR)) {
      paste0(round(threshold_info$outcomes$DCR$hr, 2), 
             " (", round(threshold_info$outcomes$DCR$hr_lower, 2), "-",
             round(threshold_info$outcomes$DCR$hr_upper, 2), ")")
    } else {
      "N/A"
    }
    
    dcr_p <- if (!is.null(threshold_info$outcomes$DCR)) {
      p_val <- threshold_info$outcomes$DCR$p_value
      if (is.numeric(p_val) && p_val < 0.001) {
        "<0.001"
      } else if (is.numeric(p_val)) {
        as.character(round(p_val, 3))
      } else {
        as.character(p_val)
      }
    } else {
      "N/A"
    }
    
    os_hr <- if (!is.null(threshold_info$outcomes$OS)) {
      if (!is.na(threshold_info$outcomes$OS$hr) && is.finite(threshold_info$outcomes$OS$hr)) {
        paste0(round(threshold_info$outcomes$OS$hr, 2), 
               " (", round(threshold_info$outcomes$OS$hr_lower, 2), "-",
               round(threshold_info$outcomes$OS$hr_upper, 2), ")")
      } else {
        "N/A (log-rank)"  # Indicate that log-rank test was used (HR not estimable)
      }
    } else {
      "N/A"
    }
    
    os_p <- if (!is.null(threshold_info$outcomes$OS)) {
      p_val <- threshold_info$outcomes$OS$p_value
      if (is.numeric(p_val) && p_val < 0.001) {
        "<0.001"
      } else if (is.numeric(p_val)) {
        as.character(round(p_val, 3))
      } else {
        as.character(p_val)
      }
    } else {
      "N/A"
    }
    
    ttnt_hr <- if (!is.null(threshold_info$outcomes$TTNT)) {
      paste0(round(threshold_info$outcomes$TTNT$hr, 2), 
             " (", round(threshold_info$outcomes$TTNT$hr_lower, 2), "-",
             round(threshold_info$outcomes$TTNT$hr_upper, 2), ")")
    } else {
      "N/A"
    }
    
    ttnt_p <- if (!is.null(threshold_info$outcomes$TTNT)) {
      p_val <- threshold_info$outcomes$TTNT$p_value
      if (is.numeric(p_val) && p_val < 0.001) {
        "<0.001"
      } else if (is.numeric(p_val)) {
        as.character(round(p_val, 3))
      } else {
        as.character(p_val)
      }
    } else {
      "N/A"
    }
    
    # Get OS-specific n_total if available (for accurate count after OS data filtering)
    n_total_display <- if (!is.null(threshold_info$outcomes$OS) && !is.null(threshold_info$outcomes$OS$n_total)) {
      threshold_info$outcomes$OS$n_total
    } else {
      threshold_info$n_total
    }
    
    threshold_summary <- bind_rows(
      threshold_summary,
      tibble(
        `Threshold` = threshold_name,
        `Description` = threshold_info$desc,
        `N (Total)` = n_total_display,  # Use OS-specific n_total if available
        `N (Met Threshold)` = threshold_info$n_positive,  # Number of patients who met this threshold
        `DCR HR (95% CI)` = dcr_hr,
        `DCR P-value` = dcr_p,
        `OS HR (95% CI)` = os_hr,
        `OS P-value` = os_p,
        `TTNT HR (95% CI)` = ttnt_hr,
        `TTNT P-value` = ttnt_p
      )
    )
  }
  
  if (nrow(threshold_summary) > 0) {
    threshold_table <- threshold_summary %>%
      kable(
        caption = "Evaluation of Different ctDNA Change Thresholds as Intermediate Endpoints. N (Total) = total number of patient-line observations with valid data for that threshold. N (Met Threshold) = number of patient-line observations that met the threshold criteria (e.g., had ≥90% decline for the ≥90% threshold). As thresholds become less strict (from 100% to 30% decline), more patients meet the criteria, so N (Met Threshold) increases. For median-based thresholds, N (Total) may be lower (e.g., 18 vs 30) because these require baseline ctDNA > 0. HR < 1 indicates better outcomes (longer survival/DCR/TTNT) for patients meeting the threshold. Lower HR values suggest stronger predictive value.",
        format = "html"
      ) %>%
      kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"), full_width = TRUE, font_size = 10)
    
    cat(knitr::knit_print(threshold_table))
    cat("\n\n")
    
    # Identify optimal thresholds
    cat("## Optimal Threshold Identification\n\n")
    cat("**Criteria for optimal threshold:**\n")
    cat("1. Statistically significant association (p < 0.05) with clinical outcomes\n")
    cat("2. Strongest effect size (lowest HR) across multiple outcomes\n")
    cat("3. Clinically meaningful (e.g., complete clearance or substantial decline)\n\n")
    
    # Find thresholds with significant associations
    significant_thresholds <- threshold_summary %>%
      filter(
        (`DCR P-value` != "N/A" & suppressWarnings(as.numeric(`DCR P-value`)) < 0.05) |
        (`OS P-value` != "N/A" & suppressWarnings(as.numeric(`OS P-value`)) < 0.05) |
        (`TTNT P-value` != "N/A" & suppressWarnings(as.numeric(`TTNT P-value`)) < 0.05)
      )
    
    if (nrow(significant_thresholds) > 0) {
      cat("**Thresholds with statistically significant associations (p < 0.05):**\n\n")
      for (i in 1:nrow(significant_thresholds)) {
        cat("- **", significant_thresholds$Threshold[i], "**: ", significant_thresholds$Description[i], "\n", sep = "")
        if (significant_thresholds$`DCR P-value`[i] != "N/A" && suppressWarnings(as.numeric(significant_thresholds$`DCR P-value`[i])) < 0.05) {
          cat("  - DCR: HR = ", significant_thresholds$`DCR HR (95% CI)`[i], ", p = ", significant_thresholds$`DCR P-value`[i], "\n", sep = "")
        }
        if (significant_thresholds$`OS P-value`[i] != "N/A" && suppressWarnings(as.numeric(significant_thresholds$`OS P-value`[i])) < 0.05) {
          cat("  - OS: HR = ", significant_thresholds$`OS HR (95% CI)`[i], ", p = ", significant_thresholds$`OS P-value`[i], "\n", sep = "")
        }
        if (significant_thresholds$`TTNT P-value`[i] != "N/A" && suppressWarnings(as.numeric(significant_thresholds$`TTNT P-value`[i])) < 0.05) {
          cat("  - TTNT: HR = ", significant_thresholds$`TTNT HR (95% CI)`[i], ", p = ", significant_thresholds$`TTNT P-value`[i], "\n", sep = "")
        }
        cat("\n")
      }
    } else {
      cat("**Note:** No thresholds showed statistically significant associations (p < 0.05) in this analysis. This may be due to limited sample size or the need for adjusted models.\n\n")
    }
    
    cat("---\n\n")
  }
} else {
  cat("**Note:** Optimal threshold analysis requires landmark outcomes data. Analysis will proceed with binary clearance definition.\n\n")
}
```

```{r landmark_analysis_results}
# Display landmark analysis results
if (exists("landmark_outcomes") && nrow(landmark_outcomes) > 0) {
  # Summary of response categories
  response_summary_table <- landmark_outcomes %>%
    count(response_category) %>%
    mutate(Percentage = round(n / sum(n) * 100, 1)) %>%
    rename(`Response Category` = response_category, `N` = n) %>%
    kable(caption = "Distribution of Early On-Treatment ctDNA Response (Landmark = ctDNA between 6-24 weeks after start)") %>%
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"), full_width = TRUE)
  
  response_summary_table
  
  # Initialize variables
  hr_cleared <- hr_cleared_lower <- hr_cleared_upper <- p_cleared <- NA
  landmark_outcomes_cleared <- NULL
  landmark_results <- NULL
  
  # Create results table - unadjusted and adjusted models
  table_rows <- list()
  
  # Cox model: ctDNA Cleared at Landmark vs Not Cleared
  if (sum(!is.na(landmark_outcomes$ctdna_cleared_at_landmark)) > 10) {
    landmark_outcomes_cleared <- landmark_outcomes %>%
      filter(!is.na(ctdna_cleared_at_landmark)) %>%
      mutate(
        therapy_line_grouped = case_when(
          therapy_line == 1 ~ "1L",
          therapy_line == 2 ~ "2L",
          therapy_line == 3 ~ "3L",
          therapy_line >= 4 ~ "4L+",
          TRUE ~ as.character(therapy_line)
        ),
        therapy_line_factor = factor(therapy_line_grouped, levels = c("1L", "2L", "3L", "4L+"))
      )
    
    # Join therapy class if available
    if (exists("palliative_regimen_table") && nrow(palliative_regimen_table) > 0) {
      landmark_outcomes_cleared <- landmark_outcomes_cleared %>%
        left_join(
          palliative_regimen_table %>%
            mutate(therapy_line_match = ifelse(is.na(therapy_line_match), NA_integer_, therapy_line_match)) %>%
            select(patient_id, therapy_line_match, therapy_class) %>%
            distinct(),
          by = c("patient_id", "therapy_line" = "therapy_line_match")
        ) %>%
        mutate(
          therapy_class = replace_na(therapy_class, "unspecified"),
          therapy_class_factor = factor(therapy_class)
        )
    } else {
      landmark_outcomes_cleared <- landmark_outcomes_cleared %>%
        mutate(
          therapy_class = "unspecified",
          therapy_class_factor = factor("unspecified")
        )
    }
    
    # Join Bajorin risk factors if available
    # IMPORTANT: Normalize therapy lines >= 4 to 4 for matching, since Bajorin data uses "4L+" -> 4
    if (exists("bajorin_data") && nrow(bajorin_data) > 0) {
      # Normalize therapy lines in both datasets: >= 4 becomes 4 for matching
      bajorin_data_normalized <- bajorin_data %>%
        mutate(therapy_line_match = ifelse(therapy_line >= 4, 4, therapy_line))
      
      landmark_outcomes_cleared <- landmark_outcomes_cleared %>%
        mutate(therapy_line_match = ifelse(therapy_line >= 4, 4, therapy_line)) %>%
        left_join(
          bajorin_data_normalized %>% select(patient_id, therapy_line_match, kps_binary, visceral_mets_binary),
          by = c("patient_id", "therapy_line_match")
        ) %>%
        select(-therapy_line_match) %>%
        mutate(
          kps_factor = factor(kps_binary, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("KPS <80%", "KPS ≥80%")),
          visceral_mets_factor = factor(visceral_mets_binary, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("No Visceral Mets", "Visceral Mets"))
        )
    } else {
      landmark_outcomes_cleared <- landmark_outcomes_cleared %>%
        mutate(
          kps_binary = NA_real_,
          visceral_mets_binary = NA_real_,
          kps_factor = factor(NA, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("KPS <80%", "KPS ≥80%")),
          visceral_mets_factor = factor(NA, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("No Visceral Mets", "Visceral Mets"))
        )
    }
    
    # Model 1: Unadjusted Cox model (matches log-rank test from survival curve)
    cox_cleared_unadj <- tryCatch({
      coxph(Surv(mfs_time_from_landmark, mfs_event_from_landmark) ~ ctdna_cleared_at_landmark,
            data = landmark_outcomes_cleared)
    }, error = function(e) NULL)
    
    # Model 2: Adjusted for line of therapy
    cox_cleared_line <- tryCatch({
      coxph(Surv(mfs_time_from_landmark, mfs_event_from_landmark) ~ ctdna_cleared_at_landmark + therapy_line_factor,
            data = landmark_outcomes_cleared)
    }, error = function(e) NULL)
    
    # Model 3: Adjusted for KPS only (if available)
    cox_cleared_kps <- NULL
    cox_cleared_kps_summary <- NULL
    if (sum(!is.na(landmark_outcomes_cleared$kps_binary)) > 0) {
      landmark_outcomes_kps <- landmark_outcomes_cleared %>%
        filter(!is.na(kps_binary))
      
      if (nrow(landmark_outcomes_kps) > 0) {
        cox_cleared_kps <- tryCatch({
          coxph(Surv(mfs_time_from_landmark, mfs_event_from_landmark) ~ ctdna_cleared_at_landmark + kps_factor, 
                data = landmark_outcomes_kps)
        }, error = function(e) NULL)
        
        if (!is.null(cox_cleared_kps)) {
          cox_cleared_kps_summary <- summary(cox_cleared_kps)
        }
      }
    }
    
    # Model 4: Adjusted for visceral metastases only (if available)
    cox_cleared_visceral <- NULL
    cox_cleared_visceral_summary <- NULL
    if (sum(!is.na(landmark_outcomes_cleared$visceral_mets_binary)) > 0) {
      landmark_outcomes_visceral <- landmark_outcomes_cleared %>%
        filter(!is.na(visceral_mets_binary))
      
      if (nrow(landmark_outcomes_visceral) > 0) {
        cox_cleared_visceral <- tryCatch({
          coxph(Surv(mfs_time_from_landmark, mfs_event_from_landmark) ~ ctdna_cleared_at_landmark + visceral_mets_factor, 
                data = landmark_outcomes_visceral)
        }, error = function(e) NULL)
        
        if (!is.null(cox_cleared_visceral)) {
          cox_cleared_visceral_summary <- summary(cox_cleared_visceral)
        }
      }
    }
    
    # Model 5: Adjusted for line of therapy + therapy class
    # Only include if therapy class has sufficient sample size
    cox_cleared <- NULL
    cox_cleared_summary <- NULL
    therapy_class_sufficient <- FALSE
    
    therapy_class_counts <- landmark_outcomes_cleared %>%
      filter(!is.na(therapy_class)) %>%
      count(therapy_class) %>%
      filter(n >= 5) %>%
      pull(therapy_class)
    
    if (length(therapy_class_counts) > 0) {
      # Include patients with therapy classes that have sufficient sample size
      landmark_outcomes_cleared_class <- landmark_outcomes_cleared %>%
        filter(therapy_class %in% therapy_class_counts | is.na(therapy_class))
      
      if (nrow(landmark_outcomes_cleared_class) > 0) {
        landmark_outcomes_cleared_class <- landmark_outcomes_cleared_class %>%
          mutate(
            therapy_class_filtered = therapy_class,
            therapy_class_factor_filtered = factor(therapy_class_filtered)
          )
        
        cox_cleared <- tryCatch({
          coxph(Surv(mfs_time_from_landmark, mfs_event_from_landmark) ~ 
                ctdna_cleared_at_landmark + therapy_line_factor + therapy_class_factor_filtered,
                data = landmark_outcomes_cleared_class)
        }, error = function(e) NULL)
        
        if (!is.null(cox_cleared)) {
          cox_cleared_summary <- summary(cox_cleared)
          # Check if model converged and HR is reasonable
          if (isTRUE(cox_cleared$converged)) {
            hr_check <- cox_cleared_summary$conf.int[1, "exp(coef)"]
            hr_lower_check <- cox_cleared_summary$conf.int[1, "lower .95"]
            hr_upper_check <- cox_cleared_summary$conf.int[1, "upper .95"]
            
            # Check if HR is extreme
            is_extreme <- is.na(hr_check) || !is.finite(hr_check) || hr_check <= 0 || 
                         is.na(hr_lower_check) || !is.finite(hr_lower_check) ||
                         is.na(hr_upper_check) || !is.finite(hr_upper_check) ||
                         str_detect(paste0(round(hr_check, 2), " (", round(hr_lower_check, 2), "-", round(hr_upper_check, 2), ")"), 
                                   "0 \\(0-Inf\\)|Inf \\(0-Inf\\)|Inf \\(Inf-Inf\\)|0 \\(Inf-Inf\\)")
            
            if (!is_extreme) {
              therapy_class_sufficient <- TRUE
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }
    
    # Model 6: Multivariate (line + therapy class + KPS + visceral mets)
    # Use flexible model building: include only covariates with sufficient sample size
    has_kps <- sum(!is.na(landmark_outcomes_cleared$kps_binary)) > 0
    has_visceral <- sum(!is.na(landmark_outcomes_cleared$visceral_mets_binary)) > 0
    
      # Check therapy class sample sizes (include "unspecified")
      therapy_class_counts_multiv <- landmark_outcomes_cleared %>%
        filter(!is.na(therapy_class)) %>%
        count(therapy_class) %>%
        filter(n >= 5) %>%
        pull(therapy_class)
      has_therapy_class <- length(therapy_class_counts_multiv) > 0
    
    cox_cleared_multiv <- NULL
    cox_cleared_multiv_summary <- NULL
    landmark_outcomes_multiv <- NULL
    
    if (has_kps && has_visceral) {
      # Filter to observations with complete Bajorin data
      landmark_outcomes_multiv <- landmark_outcomes_cleared %>%
        filter(!is.na(kps_binary), !is.na(visceral_mets_binary))
      
      if (nrow(landmark_outcomes_multiv) > 0) {
        # Build model formula dynamically based on available covariates
        formula_parts <- c("ctdna_cleared_at_landmark", "therapy_line_factor")
        
        # Add therapy class only if it has sufficient sample size and produced valid results
        # (check if the simpler "line + class" model worked)
        if (has_therapy_class && therapy_class_sufficient) {
          landmark_outcomes_multiv <- landmark_outcomes_multiv %>%
            filter(therapy_class %in% therapy_class_counts_multiv | is.na(therapy_class)) %>%
            mutate(
              therapy_class_filtered = therapy_class,
              therapy_class_factor_filtered = factor(therapy_class_filtered)
            )
          formula_parts <- c(formula_parts, "therapy_class_factor_filtered")
        }
        
        # Add Bajorin factors
        formula_parts <- c(formula_parts, "kps_factor", "visceral_mets_factor")
        
        formula_str <- paste("Surv(mfs_time_from_landmark, mfs_event_from_landmark) ~", paste(formula_parts, collapse = " + "))
        
        cox_cleared_multiv <- tryCatch({
          coxph(as.formula(formula_str), data = landmark_outcomes_multiv)
        }, error = function(e) NULL)
        
        if (!is.null(cox_cleared_multiv)) {
          cox_cleared_multiv_summary <- summary(cox_cleared_multiv)
          # Check if model converged and HR is reasonable
          if (isTRUE(cox_cleared_multiv$converged)) {
            hr_multiv_check <- cox_cleared_multiv_summary$conf.int[1, "exp(coef)"]
            hr_multiv_lower_check <- cox_cleared_multiv_summary$conf.int[1, "lower .95"]
            hr_multiv_upper_check <- cox_cleared_multiv_summary$conf.int[1, "upper .95"]
            
            # Check if HR is extreme
            is_extreme_multiv <- is.na(hr_multiv_check) || !is.finite(hr_multiv_check) || hr_multiv_check <= 0 || 
                                is.na(hr_multiv_lower_check) || !is.finite(hr_multiv_lower_check) ||
                                is.na(hr_multiv_upper_check) || !is.finite(hr_multiv_upper_check) ||
                                str_detect(paste0(round(hr_multiv_check, 2), " (", round(hr_multiv_lower_check, 2), "-", round(hr_multiv_upper_check, 2), ")"), 
                                          "0 \\(0-Inf\\)|Inf \\(0-Inf\\)|Inf \\(Inf-Inf\\)|0 \\(Inf-Inf\\)")
            
            if (is_extreme_multiv) {
              # If extreme, set to NULL so it won't be used
              cox_cleared_multiv <- NULL
              cox_cleared_multiv_summary <- NULL
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }
    
    # Create results table showing HR progression across models (matching Question 1 structure)
    # Model 1: Unadjusted
    if (!is.null(cox_cleared_unadj)) {
      cox_cleared_unadj_summary <- summary(cox_cleared_unadj)
      hr_cleared_unadj <- cox_cleared_unadj_summary$conf.int[1, "exp(coef)"]
      hr_cleared_unadj_lower <- cox_cleared_unadj_summary$conf.int[1, "lower .95"]
      hr_cleared_unadj_upper <- cox_cleared_unadj_summary$conf.int[1, "upper .95"]
      p_cleared_unadj <- cox_cleared_unadj_summary$coefficients[1, "Pr(>|z|)"]
      
      table_rows[[length(table_rows) + 1]] <- tibble(
        `Model` = "Unadjusted",
        `HR (95% CI)` = paste0(round(hr_cleared_unadj, 2), " (", round(hr_cleared_unadj_lower, 2), "-", round(hr_cleared_unadj_upper, 2), ")"),
        `P-value` = ifelse(p_cleared_unadj < 0.001, "<0.001", as.character(round(p_cleared_unadj, 3)))
      )
    }
    
    # Model 2: Adjusted for line of therapy
    if (!is.null(cox_cleared_line)) {
      cox_cleared_line_summary <- summary(cox_cleared_line)
      hr_cleared_line <- cox_cleared_line_summary$conf.int[1, "exp(coef)"]
      hr_cleared_line_lower <- cox_cleared_line_summary$conf.int[1, "lower .95"]
      hr_cleared_line_upper <- cox_cleared_line_summary$conf.int[1, "upper .95"]
      p_cleared_line <- cox_cleared_line_summary$coefficients[1, "Pr(>|z|)"]
      
      table_rows[[length(table_rows) + 1]] <- tibble(
        `Model` = "Adjusted for line of therapy",
        `HR (95% CI)` = paste0(round(hr_cleared_line, 2), " (", round(hr_cleared_line_lower, 2), "-", round(hr_cleared_line_upper, 2), ")"),
        `P-value` = ifelse(p_cleared_line < 0.001, "<0.001", as.character(round(p_cleared_line, 3)))
      )
    }
    
    # Model 3: Adjusted for KPS only
    if (!is.null(cox_cleared_kps) && !is.null(cox_cleared_kps_summary)) {
      hr_cleared_kps <- cox_cleared_kps_summary$conf.int[1, "exp(coef)"]
      hr_cleared_kps_lower <- cox_cleared_kps_summary$conf.int[1, "lower .95"]
      hr_cleared_kps_upper <- cox_cleared_kps_summary$conf.int[1, "upper .95"]
      p_cleared_kps <- cox_cleared_kps_summary$coefficients[1, "Pr(>|z|)"]
      
      table_rows[[length(table_rows) + 1]] <- tibble(
        `Model` = "Adjusted for KPS",
        `HR (95% CI)` = paste0(round(hr_cleared_kps, 2), " (", round(hr_cleared_kps_lower, 2), "-", round(hr_cleared_kps_upper, 2), ")"),
        `P-value` = ifelse(p_cleared_kps < 0.001, "<0.001", as.character(round(p_cleared_kps, 3)))
      )
    }
    
    # Model 4: Adjusted for visceral metastases only
    if (!is.null(cox_cleared_visceral) && !is.null(cox_cleared_visceral_summary)) {
      hr_cleared_visceral <- cox_cleared_visceral_summary$conf.int[1, "exp(coef)"]
      hr_cleared_visceral_lower <- cox_cleared_visceral_summary$conf.int[1, "lower .95"]
      hr_cleared_visceral_upper <- cox_cleared_visceral_summary$conf.int[1, "upper .95"]
      p_cleared_visceral <- cox_cleared_visceral_summary$coefficients[1, "Pr(>|z|)"]
      
      table_rows[[length(table_rows) + 1]] <- tibble(
        `Model` = "Adjusted for visceral metastases",
        `HR (95% CI)` = paste0(round(hr_cleared_visceral, 2), " (", round(hr_cleared_visceral_lower, 2), "-", round(hr_cleared_visceral_upper, 2), ")"),
        `P-value` = ifelse(p_cleared_visceral < 0.001, "<0.001", as.character(round(p_cleared_visceral, 3)))
      )
    }
    
    # Model 5: Adjusted for line of therapy + therapy class
    # Only add if therapy class has sufficient sample size and model produced valid HR
    if (therapy_class_sufficient && !is.null(cox_cleared) && !is.null(cox_cleared_summary)) {
      hr_cleared <- cox_cleared_summary$conf.int[1, "exp(coef)"]
      hr_cleared_lower <- cox_cleared_summary$conf.int[1, "lower .95"]
      hr_cleared_upper <- cox_cleared_summary$conf.int[1, "upper .95"]
      p_cleared <- cox_cleared_summary$coefficients[1, "Pr(>|z|)"]
      
      hr_ci_text <- paste0(round(hr_cleared, 2), " (", round(hr_cleared_lower, 2), "-", round(hr_cleared_upper, 2), ")")
      
      table_rows[[length(table_rows) + 1]] <- tibble(
        `Model` = "Adjusted for line of therapy and therapy class",
        `HR (95% CI)` = hr_ci_text,
        `P-value` = ifelse(is.na(p_cleared), "NA", 
                          ifelse(p_cleared < 0.001, "<0.001", as.character(round(p_cleared, 3))))
      )
    }
    
    # Model 6: Adjusted for line of therapy, KPS, and visceral metastases (simpler format matching Question 1)
    # Create model without therapy class to match Question 1 format
    cox_cleared_bajorin <- NULL
    cox_cleared_bajorin_summary <- NULL
    if (has_kps && has_visceral) {
      landmark_outcomes_bajorin <- landmark_outcomes_cleared %>%
        filter(!is.na(kps_binary), !is.na(visceral_mets_binary))
      
      if (nrow(landmark_outcomes_bajorin) > 0) {
        cox_cleared_bajorin <- tryCatch({
          coxph(Surv(mfs_time_from_landmark, mfs_event_from_landmark) ~ 
                ctdna_cleared_at_landmark + therapy_line_factor + kps_factor + visceral_mets_factor,
                data = landmark_outcomes_bajorin)
        }, error = function(e) NULL)
        
        if (!is.null(cox_cleared_bajorin)) {
          cox_cleared_bajorin_summary <- summary(cox_cleared_bajorin)
        }
      }
    }
    
    if (!is.null(cox_cleared_bajorin) && !is.null(cox_cleared_bajorin_summary)) {
      hr_cleared_bajorin <- cox_cleared_bajorin_summary$conf.int[1, "exp(coef)"]
      hr_cleared_bajorin_lower <- cox_cleared_bajorin_summary$conf.int[1, "lower .95"]
      hr_cleared_bajorin_upper <- cox_cleared_bajorin_summary$conf.int[1, "upper .95"]
      p_cleared_bajorin <- cox_cleared_bajorin_summary$coefficients[1, "Pr(>|z|)"]
      
      # Check if HR is extreme before adding
      hr_ci_text_bajorin <- paste0(round(hr_cleared_bajorin, 2), " (", round(hr_cleared_bajorin_lower, 2), "-", round(hr_cleared_bajorin_upper, 2), ")")
      is_extreme_bajorin <- is.na(hr_cleared_bajorin) || !is.finite(hr_cleared_bajorin) || hr_cleared_bajorin <= 0 || 
                           is.na(hr_cleared_bajorin_lower) || !is.finite(hr_cleared_bajorin_lower) ||
                           is.na(hr_cleared_bajorin_upper) || !is.finite(hr_cleared_bajorin_upper) ||
                           str_detect(hr_ci_text_bajorin, "0 \\(0-Inf\\)|Inf \\(0-Inf\\)|Inf \\(Inf-Inf\\)|0 \\(Inf-Inf\\)")
      
      if (!is_extreme_bajorin) {
        model_text <- "Adjusted for line of therapy, KPS, and visceral metastases"
        if (!therapy_class_sufficient) {
          model_text <- paste0(model_text, " (therapy class excluded due to insufficient sample size)")
        }
        
        table_rows[[length(table_rows) + 1]] <- tibble(
          `Model` = model_text,
          `HR (95% CI)` = hr_ci_text_bajorin,
          `P-value` = ifelse(p_cleared_bajorin < 0.001, "<0.001", as.character(round(p_cleared_bajorin, 3)))
        )
      }
    }
  }
  
  # Create table if we have any valid models
  # Filter out rows with extreme HRs (0-Inf or Inf-Inf CI)
  if (length(table_rows) > 0) {
    landmark_results_df <- bind_rows(table_rows) %>%
      filter(!str_detect(`HR (95% CI)`, "0 \\(0-Inf\\)|Inf \\(0-Inf\\)|Inf \\(Inf-Inf\\)|0 \\(Inf-Inf\\)"))
    
    if (nrow(landmark_results_df) > 0) {
      # Extract p-values for adjustment (convert "<0.001" to 0.0005 for adjustment)
      p_values_numeric <- landmark_results_df$`P-value` %>%
        str_replace("<0.001", "0.0005") %>%
        as.numeric()
      
      # Apply Bonferroni correction for multiple comparisons
      p_values_adjusted <- p.adjust(p_values_numeric, method = "bonferroni")
      
      # Format adjusted p-values
      p_values_adjusted_formatted <- ifelse(p_values_adjusted < 0.001, "<0.001",
                                            as.character(round(p_values_adjusted, 3)))
      
      # Replace original p-values with adjusted p-values
      landmark_results_df <- landmark_results_df %>%
        mutate(`P-value` = p_values_adjusted_formatted)
      
      landmark_results <- landmark_results_df %>%
        kable(caption = "Multivariate Cox Model: On-Treatment ctDNA Clearance and Duration of Complete Response from Landmark. Models show HR progression as covariates are added. P-values are adjusted for multiple comparisons using Bonferroni correction. The unadjusted model p-value should match the log-rank test from the survival curve. HR < 1 indicates longer duration of complete response (lower risk of loss of CR or death) for patients with ctDNA cleared at landmark.") %>%
        kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"), full_width = TRUE)
    } else {
      landmark_results <- NULL
    }
  } else {
    landmark_results <- NULL
  }
  
  # Create detailed multivariate results table for on-treatment analysis
  # Only create if model converged and has reasonable HR values
  if (!is.null(cox_cleared_multiv)) {
    model_converged <- tryCatch({
      isTRUE(cox_cleared_multiv$converged)
    }, error = function(e) FALSE)
    
    if (model_converged) {
      cox_cleared_multiv_summary <- summary(cox_cleared_multiv)
      n_coef <- nrow(cox_cleared_multiv_summary$coefficients)
      
      # Build results as list first
      multiv_landmark_results_list <- list()
      
      # Add ctDNA cleared coefficient
      if (n_coef > 0) {
        hr_val_cleared <- cox_cleared_multiv_summary$conf.int[1, "exp(coef)"]
        hr_lower_cleared <- cox_cleared_multiv_summary$conf.int[1, "lower .95"]
        hr_upper_cleared <- cox_cleared_multiv_summary$conf.int[1, "upper .95"]
        p_val_cleared <- cox_cleared_multiv_summary$coefficients[1, "Pr(>|z|)"]
        
        # Only add if HR values are reasonable
        if (!is.na(hr_val_cleared) && is.finite(hr_val_cleared) && hr_val_cleared > 0 && hr_val_cleared < 1e10 &&
            !is.na(hr_lower_cleared) && is.finite(hr_lower_cleared) &&
            !is.na(hr_upper_cleared) && is.finite(hr_upper_cleared)) {
          multiv_landmark_results_list[[length(multiv_landmark_results_list) + 1]] <- tibble(
            `Variable` = if (exists("cox_cleared_multiv_adjustments") && !is.null(cox_cleared_multiv_adjustments) && length(cox_cleared_multiv_adjustments) > 0) {
              paste0("**PRIMARY RESULT: ctDNA Cleared at Landmark vs Not Cleared (Adjusted for ", paste(cox_cleared_multiv_adjustments, collapse = ", "), ")**")
            } else {
              "**PRIMARY RESULT: ctDNA Cleared at Landmark vs Not Cleared (Fully Adjusted)**"
            },
            `HR (95% CI)` = paste0(
              round(hr_val_cleared, 2), " (",
              round(hr_lower_cleared, 2), "-",
              round(hr_upper_cleared, 2), ")"
            ),
            `P-value` = if (p_val_cleared < 0.001) "<0.001" else as.character(round(p_val_cleared, 3))
          )
        }
      }
      
      # Add therapy line coefficients (with convergence checks)
      therapy_line_idx <- which(str_detect(rownames(cox_cleared_multiv_summary$coefficients), "therapy_line_factor"))
      if (length(therapy_line_idx) > 0) {
        for (i in seq_along(therapy_line_idx)) {
          idx <- therapy_line_idx[i]
          if (idx <= nrow(cox_cleared_multiv_summary$conf.int) && i <= length(therapy_line_labels)) {
            hr_val_line <- cox_cleared_multiv_summary$conf.int[idx, "exp(coef)"]
            hr_lower_line <- cox_cleared_multiv_summary$conf.int[idx, "lower .95"]
            hr_upper_line <- cox_cleared_multiv_summary$conf.int[idx, "upper .95"]
            p_val_line <- cox_cleared_multiv_summary$coefficients[idx, "Pr(>|z|)"]
            
            # Only add if HR values are reasonable
            if (!is.na(hr_val_line) && is.finite(hr_val_line) && hr_val_line > 0 && hr_val_line < 1e10 &&
                !is.na(hr_lower_line) && is.finite(hr_lower_line) &&
                !is.na(hr_upper_line) && is.finite(hr_upper_line)) {
              multiv_landmark_results_list[[length(multiv_landmark_results_list) + 1]] <- tibble(
                `Variable` = therapy_line_labels[i],
                `HR (95% CI)` = paste0(
                  round(hr_val_line, 2), " (",
                  round(hr_lower_line, 2), "-",
                  round(hr_upper_line, 2), ")"
                ),
                `P-value` = as.character(ifelse(p_val_line < 0.001, "<0.001", round(p_val_line, 3)))
              )
            }
          }
        }
      }
      
      # Add KPS coefficient (with convergence checks)
      kps_idx <- which(str_detect(rownames(cox_cleared_multiv_summary$coefficients), "kps_factor"))
      if (length(kps_idx) > 0) {
        idx <- kps_idx[1]
        if (idx <= nrow(cox_cleared_multiv_summary$conf.int)) {
          hr_val_kps <- cox_cleared_multiv_summary$conf.int[idx, "exp(coef)"]
          hr_lower_kps <- cox_cleared_multiv_summary$conf.int[idx, "lower .95"]
          hr_upper_kps <- cox_cleared_multiv_summary$conf.int[idx, "upper .95"]
          p_val_kps <- cox_cleared_multiv_summary$coefficients[idx, "Pr(>|z|)"]
          
          # Only add if HR values are reasonable
          if (!is.na(hr_val_kps) && is.finite(hr_val_kps) && hr_val_kps > 0 && hr_val_kps < 1e10 &&
              !is.na(hr_lower_kps) && is.finite(hr_lower_kps) &&
              !is.na(hr_upper_kps) && is.finite(hr_upper_kps)) {
            multiv_landmark_results_list[[length(multiv_landmark_results_list) + 1]] <- tibble(
              `Variable` = "KPS ≥80% vs <80%",
              `HR (95% CI)` = paste0(
                round(hr_val_kps, 2), " (",
                round(hr_lower_kps, 2), "-",
                round(hr_upper_kps, 2), ")"
              ),
              `P-value` = if (p_val_kps < 0.001) "<0.001" else as.character(round(p_val_kps, 3))
            )
          }
        }
      }
      
      # Add Visceral Metastases coefficient (with convergence checks)
      visceral_idx <- which(str_detect(rownames(cox_cleared_multiv_summary$coefficients), "visceral_mets_factor"))
      if (length(visceral_idx) > 0) {
        idx <- visceral_idx[1]
        if (idx <= nrow(cox_cleared_multiv_summary$conf.int)) {
          hr_val_visceral <- cox_cleared_multiv_summary$conf.int[idx, "exp(coef)"]
          hr_lower_visceral <- cox_cleared_multiv_summary$conf.int[idx, "lower .95"]
          hr_upper_visceral <- cox_cleared_multiv_summary$conf.int[idx, "upper .95"]
          p_val_visceral <- cox_cleared_multiv_summary$coefficients[idx, "Pr(>|z|)"]
          
          # Only add if HR values are reasonable
          if (!is.na(hr_val_visceral) && is.finite(hr_val_visceral) && hr_val_visceral > 0 && hr_val_visceral < 1e10 &&
              !is.na(hr_lower_visceral) && is.finite(hr_lower_visceral) &&
              !is.na(hr_upper_visceral) && is.finite(hr_upper_visceral)) {
            multiv_landmark_results_list[[length(multiv_landmark_results_list) + 1]] <- tibble(
              `Variable` = "Visceral Mets vs No Visceral Mets",
              `HR (95% CI)` = paste0(
                round(hr_val_visceral, 2), " (",
                round(hr_lower_visceral, 2), "-",
                round(hr_upper_visceral, 2), ")"
              ),
              `P-value` = if (p_val_visceral < 0.001) "<0.001" else as.character(round(p_val_visceral, 3))
            )
          }
        }
      }
      
      # Add Therapy Class coefficients (with convergence checks)
      # Exclude therapy classes with small sample sizes (unspecified, Other, and classes with <5 patients)
      therapy_class_idx <- which(str_detect(rownames(cox_cleared_multiv_summary$coefficients), "therapy_class_factor"))
      if (length(therapy_class_idx) > 0) {
        # Get sample sizes for each therapy class to filter out small groups
        excluded_classes <- c("unspecified", "Other")
        if (exists("landmark_outcomes_multiv") && !is.null(landmark_outcomes_multiv) && nrow(landmark_outcomes_multiv) > 0) {
          class_counts <- landmark_outcomes_multiv %>%
            filter(!is.na(therapy_class_factor)) %>%
            count(therapy_class_factor) %>%
            filter(n < 5 | as.character(therapy_class_factor) %in% excluded_classes)
          excluded_classes <- unique(c(excluded_classes, as.character(class_counts$therapy_class_factor)))
        }
        
        # Get all available therapy class levels from the model
        if (exists("landmark_outcomes_multiv") && !is.null(landmark_outcomes_multiv) && nrow(landmark_outcomes_multiv) > 0) {
          all_classes <- levels(landmark_outcomes_multiv$therapy_class_factor)
        } else {
          all_classes <- NULL
        }
        
        for (i in seq_along(therapy_class_idx)) {
          idx <- therapy_class_idx[i]
          if (idx <= nrow(cox_cleared_multiv_summary$conf.int)) {
            term_name <- rownames(cox_cleared_multiv_summary$coefficients)[idx]
            # Extract class name - handle multiple formats:
            # "therapy_class_factorICI", "therapy_class_factor ICI", "therapy_class_factorICI + ADC", etc.
            class_name <- str_replace(term_name, "^therapy_class_factor", "")
            class_name <- str_trim(class_name)
            
            # If we have factor levels, try to match to actual level names
            if (!is.null(all_classes) && length(all_classes) > 0) {
              # Try to find matching level (handles cases where factor name might be slightly different)
              matched_class <- all_classes[str_detect(all_classes, class_name) | str_detect(class_name, all_classes)]
              if (length(matched_class) > 0) {
                class_name <- matched_class[1]
              }
            }
            
            # Skip excluded classes (unspecified, Other, or small sample sizes)
            if (class_name %in% excluded_classes || class_name == "") {
              next
            }
            
            p_val_class <- cox_cleared_multiv_summary$coefficients[idx, "Pr(>|z|)"]
            hr_val <- cox_cleared_multiv_summary$conf.int[idx, "exp(coef)"]
            ci_lower <- cox_cleared_multiv_summary$conf.int[idx, "lower .95"]
            ci_upper <- cox_cleared_multiv_summary$conf.int[idx, "upper .95"]
            
            # Only add if HR values are reasonable
            if (!is.na(hr_val) && is.finite(hr_val) && hr_val > 0 && hr_val < 1e10 &&
                !is.na(ci_lower) && is.finite(ci_lower) &&
                !is.na(ci_upper) && is.finite(ci_upper)) {
              p_val_text <- if (is.na(p_val_class)) {
                "NA"
              } else if (p_val_class < 0.001) {
                "<0.001"
              } else {
                as.character(round(p_val_class, 3))
              }
              
              multiv_landmark_results_list[[length(multiv_landmark_results_list) + 1]] <- tibble(
                `Variable` = paste0("Therapy Class: ", class_name, " vs reference"),
                `HR (95% CI)` = paste0(
                  round(hr_val, 2), " (",
                  round(ci_lower, 2), "-",
                  round(ci_upper, 2), ")"
                ),
                `P-value` = p_val_text
              )
            }
          }
        }
      }
      
      # Combine all results - only create table if we have at least one row
      if (length(multiv_landmark_results_list) > 0) {
        multiv_landmark_results <- bind_rows(multiv_landmark_results_list)
        
        # Store for display - primary result is already highlighted in the Variable name
        # Create caption with actual adjustments made
        if (exists("cox_cleared_multiv_adjustments") && !is.null(cox_cleared_multiv_adjustments) && length(cox_cleared_multiv_adjustments) > 0) {
          adj_text_caption <- paste(cox_cleared_multiv_adjustments, collapse = ", ")
          caption_text <- paste0("Multivariate Cox Model: On-Treatment ctDNA Clearance and Duration of Complete Response from Landmark. **All results shown are adjusted** for ", adj_text_caption, ". The PRIMARY RESULT is ctDNA Cleared at Landmark vs Not Cleared. Note: Only covariates with sufficient sample size (≥3 observations per level, ≥10 total observations) were included. Only coefficients with reasonable HR values (converged models) are shown. Therapy classes with small sample sizes (unspecified, Other, or <5 patients) are excluded from the model.")
        } else {
          caption_text <- "Multivariate Cox Model: On-Treatment ctDNA Clearance and Duration of Complete Response from Landmark. **All results shown are adjusted** for available covariates with sufficient sample size. The PRIMARY RESULT is ctDNA Cleared at Landmark vs Not Cleared. Note: Only covariates with sufficient sample size (≥3 observations per level, ≥10 total observations) were included."
        }
        landmark_multiv_table <- multiv_landmark_results %>%
          kable(caption = caption_text, escape = FALSE) %>%
          kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"), full_width = TRUE, latex_options = "scale_down") %>%
          column_spec(1, width = "40%") %>%
          column_spec(2, width = "30%") %>%
          column_spec(3, width = "30%")
      } else {
        landmark_multiv_table <- NULL
      }
    } else {
      landmark_multiv_table <- NULL
    }
  } else {
    landmark_multiv_table <- NULL
  }
  
  # Ensure table variables are available for display chunks
  # (Tables will be displayed in separate chunks below)
} else {
  # If landmark_outcomes doesn't exist, set table to NULL
  landmark_multiv_table <- NULL
}
```

```{r continuous_ctdna_analyses, include=FALSE}
# ====================================================================================
# ADDITIONAL ANALYSES: Continuous ctDNA Variables for Research Question 2
# ====================================================================================
# These analyses complement the binary clearance analysis by examining continuous
# ctDNA measures: log-transformed on-treatment ctDNA and percent decline
# ====================================================================================

# Initialize variables for continuous analyses
cox_continuous_on_tx <- NULL
cox_pct_decline_continuous <- NULL
cox_interaction_baseline <- NULL
cox_combined_baseline_on_tx <- NULL
comprehensive_landmark_results <- NULL

# Add continuous variables to landmark_outcomes if not already present
if (exists("landmark_outcomes") && nrow(landmark_outcomes) > 0) {
  if (!"log_on_tx_ctdna" %in% names(landmark_outcomes)) {
    landmark_outcomes <- landmark_outcomes %>%
      mutate(
        log_on_tx_ctdna = log(on_tx_ctdna + 1),
        log_baseline_ctdna = log(baseline_ctdna + 1),
        baseline_high = log_baseline_ctdna > median(log_baseline_ctdna, na.rm = TRUE),
        baseline_high_factor = factor(baseline_high, levels = c(FALSE, TRUE), 
                                       labels = c("Low Baseline", "High Baseline"))
      )
  }
}

if (exists("landmark_outcomes") && nrow(landmark_outcomes) > 0 && 
    exists("landmark_outcomes_cleared") && !is.null(landmark_outcomes_cleared)) {
  
  # Add continuous variables to landmark_outcomes_cleared if not already present
  if (!"log_on_tx_ctdna" %in% names(landmark_outcomes_cleared)) {
    landmark_outcomes_cleared <- landmark_outcomes_cleared %>%
      mutate(
        log_on_tx_ctdna = log(on_tx_ctdna + 1),
        log_baseline_ctdna = log(baseline_ctdna + 1),
        baseline_high = log_baseline_ctdna > median(log_baseline_ctdna, na.rm = TRUE),
        baseline_high_factor = factor(baseline_high, levels = c(FALSE, TRUE), 
                                       labels = c("Low Baseline", "High Baseline"))
      )
  }
  
  # Prepare data with all necessary variables
  landmark_for_continuous <- landmark_outcomes_cleared %>%
    filter(!is.na(log_on_tx_ctdna), !is.na(pct_decline))
  
  # ANALYSIS 1: Continuous on-treatment ctDNA (log-transformed)
  if (nrow(landmark_for_continuous) > 10 && 
      sum(!is.na(landmark_for_continuous$kps_binary)) > 0 && 
      sum(!is.na(landmark_for_continuous$visceral_mets_binary)) > 0) {
    
    landmark_continuous_multiv <- landmark_for_continuous %>%
      filter(!is.na(kps_binary), !is.na(visceral_mets_binary))
    
    if (nrow(landmark_continuous_multiv) > 0) {
      cox_continuous_on_tx <- tryCatch({
        coxph(Surv(mfs_time_from_landmark, mfs_event_from_landmark) ~ 
              log_on_tx_ctdna + therapy_line_factor + therapy_class_factor + 
              kps_factor + visceral_mets_factor,
              data = landmark_continuous_multiv)
      }, error = function(e) NULL)
    }
  }
  
  # ANALYSIS 2: Percent decline as continuous variable
  if (nrow(landmark_for_continuous) > 10 && 
      sum(!is.na(landmark_for_continuous$kps_binary)) > 0 && 
      sum(!is.na(landmark_for_continuous$visceral_mets_binary)) > 0) {
    
    landmark_pct_multiv <- landmark_for_continuous %>%
      filter(!is.na(kps_binary), !is.na(visceral_mets_binary), 
             !is.infinite(pct_decline), !is.na(pct_decline))
    
    if (nrow(landmark_pct_multiv) > 0) {
      cox_pct_decline_continuous <- tryCatch({
        coxph(Surv(mfs_time_from_landmark, mfs_event_from_landmark) ~ 
              pct_decline + therapy_line_factor + therapy_class_factor + 
              kps_factor + visceral_mets_factor,
              data = landmark_pct_multiv)
      }, error = function(e) NULL)
    }
  }
  
  # ANALYSIS 3: Interaction between baseline and on-treatment ctDNA
  if (nrow(landmark_for_continuous) > 10 && 
      sum(!is.na(landmark_for_continuous$kps_binary)) > 0 && 
      sum(!is.na(landmark_for_continuous$visceral_mets_binary)) > 0 &&
      sum(!is.na(landmark_for_continuous$baseline_high_factor)) > 0) {
    
    landmark_interaction_multiv <- landmark_for_continuous %>%
      filter(!is.na(kps_binary), !is.na(visceral_mets_binary),
             !is.na(ctdna_cleared_at_landmark), !is.na(baseline_high_factor))
    
    if (nrow(landmark_interaction_multiv) > 0) {
      cox_interaction_baseline <- tryCatch({
        coxph(Surv(mfs_time_from_landmark, mfs_event_from_landmark) ~ 
              ctdna_cleared_at_landmark * baseline_high_factor + 
              therapy_line_factor + therapy_class_factor + 
              kps_factor + visceral_mets_factor,
              data = landmark_interaction_multiv)
      }, error = function(e) NULL)
    }
  }
  
  # ANALYSIS 4: Combined model (baseline + on-treatment)
  if (nrow(landmark_for_continuous) > 10 && 
      sum(!is.na(landmark_for_continuous$kps_binary)) > 0 && 
      sum(!is.na(landmark_for_continuous$visceral_mets_binary)) > 0) {
    
    landmark_combined_multiv <- landmark_for_continuous %>%
      filter(!is.na(kps_binary), !is.na(visceral_mets_binary),
             !is.na(log_baseline_ctdna), !is.na(ctdna_cleared_at_landmark))
    
    if (nrow(landmark_combined_multiv) > 0) {
      cox_combined_baseline_on_tx <- tryCatch({
        coxph(Surv(mfs_time_from_landmark, mfs_event_from_landmark) ~ 
              log_baseline_ctdna + ctdna_cleared_at_landmark + 
              therapy_line_factor + therapy_class_factor + 
              kps_factor + visceral_mets_factor,
              data = landmark_combined_multiv)
      }, error = function(e) NULL)
    }
  }
  
  # Create comprehensive results table
  results_list_continuous <- list()
  
  # Binary clearance (from existing analysis) - only if converged and reasonable HR
  if (exists("cox_cleared_multiv") && !is.null(cox_cleared_multiv)) {
    model_converged <- tryCatch({
      isTRUE(cox_cleared_multiv$converged)
    }, error = function(e) FALSE)
    
    if (model_converged) {
      cox_cleared_multiv_summary <- summary(cox_cleared_multiv)
      hr_val <- cox_cleared_multiv_summary$conf.int[1, "exp(coef)"]
      hr_lower <- cox_cleared_multiv_summary$conf.int[1, "lower .95"]
      hr_upper <- cox_cleared_multiv_summary$conf.int[1, "upper .95"]
      
      if (!is.na(hr_val) && is.finite(hr_val) && hr_val > 0 && hr_val < 1e10 &&
          !is.na(hr_lower) && is.finite(hr_lower) &&
          !is.na(hr_upper) && is.finite(hr_upper)) {
        results_list_continuous[[length(results_list_continuous) + 1]] <- tibble(
          `Model` = "Binary: Cleared vs Not Cleared",
          `Variable` = "ctDNA Cleared at Landmark",
          `HR (95% CI)` = paste0(
            round(hr_val, 2), " (",
            round(hr_lower, 2), "-",
            round(hr_upper, 2), ")"
          ),
          `P-value` = ifelse(cox_cleared_multiv_summary$coefficients[1, "Pr(>|z|)"] < 0.001, 
                             "<0.001", 
                             as.character(round(cox_cleared_multiv_summary$coefficients[1, "Pr(>|z|)"], 3))),
          `N` = cox_cleared_multiv$n
        )
      }
    }
  }
  
  # Continuous on-treatment ctDNA - only if converged and reasonable HR
  if (!is.null(cox_continuous_on_tx)) {
    model_converged <- tryCatch({
      isTRUE(cox_continuous_on_tx$converged)
    }, error = function(e) FALSE)
    
    if (model_converged) {
      cox_cont_summary <- summary(cox_continuous_on_tx)
      hr_val <- cox_cont_summary$conf.int[1, "exp(coef)"]
      hr_lower <- cox_cont_summary$conf.int[1, "lower .95"]
      hr_upper <- cox_cont_summary$conf.int[1, "upper .95"]
      
      if (!is.na(hr_val) && is.finite(hr_val) && hr_val > 0 && hr_val < 1e10 &&
          !is.na(hr_lower) && is.finite(hr_lower) &&
          !is.na(hr_upper) && is.finite(hr_upper)) {
        results_list_continuous[[length(results_list_continuous) + 1]] <- tibble(
          `Model` = "Continuous: Log(On-treatment ctDNA + 1)",
          `Variable` = "Per log-unit increase in on-treatment ctDNA",
          `HR (95% CI)` = paste0(
            round(hr_val, 2), " (",
            round(hr_lower, 2), "-",
            round(hr_upper, 2), ")"
          ),
          `P-value` = ifelse(cox_cont_summary$coefficients[1, "Pr(>|z|)"] < 0.001, 
                             "<0.001", 
                             as.character(round(cox_cont_summary$coefficients[1, "Pr(>|z|)"], 3))),
          `N` = cox_continuous_on_tx$n
        )
      }
    }
  }
  
  # Percent decline (per 10% unit for interpretability) - only if converged and reasonable HR
  if (!is.null(cox_pct_decline_continuous)) {
    model_converged <- tryCatch({
      isTRUE(cox_pct_decline_continuous$converged)
    }, error = function(e) FALSE)
    
    if (model_converged) {
      cox_pct_summary <- summary(cox_pct_decline_continuous)
      # HR per 10% increase in decline
      hr_per_10pct <- exp(cox_pct_summary$coefficients[1, "coef"] * 10)
      ci_lower_per_10pct <- exp((cox_pct_summary$coefficients[1, "coef"] - 
                                 1.96 * cox_pct_summary$coefficients[1, "se(coef)"]) * 10)
      ci_upper_per_10pct <- exp((cox_pct_summary$coefficients[1, "coef"] + 
                                 1.96 * cox_pct_summary$coefficients[1, "se(coef)"]) * 10)
      
      if (!is.na(hr_per_10pct) && is.finite(hr_per_10pct) && hr_per_10pct > 0 && hr_per_10pct < 1e10 &&
          !is.na(ci_lower_per_10pct) && is.finite(ci_lower_per_10pct) &&
          !is.na(ci_upper_per_10pct) && is.finite(ci_upper_per_10pct)) {
        results_list_continuous[[length(results_list_continuous) + 1]] <- tibble(
          `Model` = "Continuous: Percent Decline from Baseline",
          `Variable` = "Per 10% increase in decline",
          `HR (95% CI)` = paste0(
            round(hr_per_10pct, 2), " (",
            round(ci_lower_per_10pct, 2), "-",
            round(ci_upper_per_10pct, 2), ")"
          ),
          `P-value` = ifelse(cox_pct_summary$coefficients[1, "Pr(>|z|)"] < 0.001, 
                             "<0.001", 
                             as.character(round(cox_pct_summary$coefficients[1, "Pr(>|z|)"], 3))),
          `N` = cox_pct_decline_continuous$n
        )
      }
    }
  }
  
  # Combined model (baseline + on-treatment) - only if converged and reasonable HR
  if (!is.null(cox_combined_baseline_on_tx)) {
    model_converged <- tryCatch({
      isTRUE(cox_combined_baseline_on_tx$converged)
    }, error = function(e) FALSE)
    
    if (model_converged) {
      cox_comb_summary <- summary(cox_combined_baseline_on_tx)
      
      # Baseline ctDNA
      hr_baseline <- cox_comb_summary$conf.int[1, "exp(coef)"]
      hr_baseline_lower <- cox_comb_summary$conf.int[1, "lower .95"]
      hr_baseline_upper <- cox_comb_summary$conf.int[1, "upper .95"]
      
      if (!is.na(hr_baseline) && is.finite(hr_baseline) && hr_baseline > 0 && hr_baseline < 1e10 &&
          !is.na(hr_baseline_lower) && is.finite(hr_baseline_lower) &&
          !is.na(hr_baseline_upper) && is.finite(hr_baseline_upper)) {
        results_list_continuous[[length(results_list_continuous) + 1]] <- tibble(
          `Model` = "Combined: Baseline + On-treatment",
          `Variable` = "Baseline ctDNA (per log-unit)",
          `HR (95% CI)` = paste0(
            round(hr_baseline, 2), " (",
            round(hr_baseline_lower, 2), "-",
            round(hr_baseline_upper, 2), ")"
          ),
          `P-value` = ifelse(cox_comb_summary$coefficients[1, "Pr(>|z|)"] < 0.001, 
                             "<0.001", 
                             as.character(round(cox_comb_summary$coefficients[1, "Pr(>|z|)"], 3))),
          `N` = cox_combined_baseline_on_tx$n
        )
      }
      
      # On-treatment clearance
      if (nrow(cox_comb_summary$conf.int) >= 2) {
        hr_ontx <- cox_comb_summary$conf.int[2, "exp(coef)"]
        hr_ontx_lower <- cox_comb_summary$conf.int[2, "lower .95"]
        hr_ontx_upper <- cox_comb_summary$conf.int[2, "upper .95"]
        
        if (!is.na(hr_ontx) && is.finite(hr_ontx) && hr_ontx > 0 && hr_ontx < 1e10 &&
            !is.na(hr_ontx_lower) && is.finite(hr_ontx_lower) &&
            !is.na(hr_ontx_upper) && is.finite(hr_ontx_upper)) {
          results_list_continuous[[length(results_list_continuous) + 1]] <- tibble(
            `Model` = "Combined: Baseline + On-treatment",
            `Variable` = "On-treatment ctDNA Cleared",
            `HR (95% CI)` = paste0(
              round(hr_ontx, 2), " (",
              round(hr_ontx_lower, 2), "-",
              round(hr_ontx_upper, 2), ")"
            ),
            `P-value` = ifelse(cox_comb_summary$coefficients[2, "Pr(>|z|)"] < 0.001, 
                               "<0.001", 
                               as.character(round(cox_comb_summary$coefficients[2, "Pr(>|z|)"], 3))),
            `N` = cox_combined_baseline_on_tx$n
          )
        }
      }
    }
  }
  
  # Combine all results
  if (length(results_list_continuous) > 0) {
    comprehensive_landmark_results <- bind_rows(results_list_continuous)
  }
}

cat("Continuous ctDNA analyses completed.\n")
```

```{r landmark_interpretation, include=FALSE}
# Interpretation of Hazard Ratios (always show if we have results)
# Use multivariate HR (adjusted for line of therapy + KPS + visceral metastases)
if (exists("landmark_results") && !is.null(landmark_results)) {
  cat("\n**Interpretation of Hazard Ratios (adjusted for line of therapy, KPS, and visceral metastases):**\n\n")
  
  # Prefer multivariate HR if available, otherwise fall back to adjusted HR
  if (exists("hr_cleared_multiv") && !is.na(hr_cleared_multiv)) {
    hr_to_use <- hr_cleared_multiv
    hr_lower_to_use <- hr_cleared_multiv_lower
    hr_upper_to_use <- hr_cleared_multiv_upper
    p_to_use <- p_cleared_multiv
    adjustment_note <- " (adjusted for line of therapy, KPS, and visceral metastases)"
  } else if (exists("hr_cleared") && !is.na(hr_cleared)) {
    hr_to_use <- hr_cleared
    hr_lower_to_use <- hr_cleared_lower
    hr_upper_to_use <- hr_cleared_upper
    p_to_use <- p_cleared
    adjustment_note <- " (adjusted for line of therapy)"
  } else {
    hr_to_use <- NA
  }
  
  if (!is.na(hr_to_use)) {
    if (hr_to_use < 1) {
      cat("- **ctDNA Cleared at Landmark vs Not Cleared (HR = ", round(hr_to_use, 2), ", 95% CI: ", 
          round(hr_lower_to_use, 2), "-", round(hr_upper_to_use, 2), ", p = ", 
          ifelse(p_to_use < 0.001, "<0.001", round(p_to_use, 3)), ")", adjustment_note, ":** Patients who cleared ctDNA at the landmark time point (6-24 weeks after therapy initiation) had a ", 
          round((1 - hr_to_use) * 100, 1), "% lower risk of metastasis or death COMPARED to those who did not clear ctDNA at the landmark. ", sep = "")
    } else {
      cat("- **ctDNA Cleared at Landmark vs Not Cleared (HR = ", round(hr_to_use, 2), ", 95% CI: ", 
          round(hr_lower_to_use, 2), "-", round(hr_upper_to_use, 2), ", p = ", 
          ifelse(p_to_use < 0.001, "<0.001", round(p_to_use, 3)), ")", adjustment_note, ":** Patients who cleared ctDNA at the landmark time point (6-24 weeks after therapy initiation) had a ", 
          round((hr_to_use - 1) * 100, 1), "% higher risk of metastasis or death COMPARED to those who did not clear ctDNA at the landmark. ", sep = "")
    }
    cat("This suggests that early ctDNA clearance may serve as a pharmacodynamic response biomarker, indicating effective treatment and potentially predicting improved metastasis-free survival.\n\n")
  }
}
```

```{r landmark_survival_curves, include=FALSE}
# Survival curves: ctDNA Cleared at Landmark vs Not Cleared
if (exists("landmark_outcomes") && nrow(landmark_outcomes) > 0) {
  if (exists("landmark_outcomes_cleared") && 
      sum(landmark_outcomes_cleared$ctdna_cleared_at_landmark, na.rm = TRUE) > 0 && 
      sum(!landmark_outcomes_cleared$ctdna_cleared_at_landmark, na.rm = TRUE) > 0) {
    landmark_outcomes_cleared <- landmark_outcomes_cleared %>%
      mutate(
        cleared_label = ifelse(ctdna_cleared_at_landmark, "Cleared at Landmark", "Not Cleared at Landmark"),
        # Convert time to months for plotting
        mfs_time_from_landmark_months = mfs_time_from_landmark / 30.44
      )
    
    # Diagnostic: Check event counts
    cat("\n**Landmark Analysis Diagnostic:**\n")
    cat("Total patients in cleared analysis:", nrow(landmark_outcomes_cleared), "\n")
    cat("Events in Cleared group:", sum(landmark_outcomes_cleared$ctdna_cleared_at_landmark & landmark_outcomes_cleared$mfs_event_from_landmark == 1, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
    cat("Events in Not Cleared group:", sum(!landmark_outcomes_cleared$ctdna_cleared_at_landmark & landmark_outcomes_cleared$mfs_event_from_landmark == 1, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
    cat("Total events:", sum(landmark_outcomes_cleared$mfs_event_from_landmark, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
    cat("Median survival time from landmark (months):", round(median(landmark_outcomes_cleared$mfs_time_from_landmark_months, na.rm = TRUE), 1), "\n")
    
    surv_fit_cleared <- survfit(Surv(mfs_time_from_landmark_months, mfs_event_from_landmark) ~ cleared_label, 
                                  data = landmark_outcomes_cleared)
    
    # Get adjusted p-value from Cox model (prefer multivariate: adjusted for line of therapy + KPS + visceral metastases)
    # Use multivariate p-value if available, otherwise fall back to line of therapy only
    if (exists("p_cleared_multiv") && !is.na(p_cleared_multiv)) {
      # Use multivariate p-value (adjusted for line of therapy + KPS + visceral metastases)
      pval_text <- ifelse(p_cleared_multiv < 0.001, "<0.001", round(p_cleared_multiv, 3))
      pval_numeric <- p_cleared_multiv
      cat("Using adjusted p-value from Cox model (adjusted for line of therapy, KPS, and visceral metastases):", pval_text, "\n\n")
    } else if (exists("p_cleared") && !is.na(p_cleared)) {
      # Fall back to p-value adjusted for line of therapy only
      pval_text <- ifelse(p_cleared < 0.001, "<0.001", round(p_cleared, 3))
      pval_numeric <- p_cleared
      cat("Using adjusted p-value from Cox model (adjusted for line of therapy):", pval_text, "\n\n")
    } else {
      # Recalculate if not already available
      landmark_outcomes_cleared_for_cox <- landmark_outcomes %>%
        filter(!is.na(ctdna_cleared_at_landmark)) %>%
        mutate(
          therapy_line_grouped = case_when(
            therapy_line == 1 ~ "1L",
            therapy_line == 2 ~ "2L",
            therapy_line == 3 ~ "3L",
            therapy_line >= 4 ~ "4L+",
            TRUE ~ as.character(therapy_line)
          ),
          therapy_line_factor = factor(therapy_line_grouped, levels = c("1L", "2L", "3L", "4L+"))
        )
      
      # Add therapy class if available
      if (exists("palliative_regimen_table") && nrow(palliative_regimen_table) > 0) {
        landmark_outcomes_cleared_for_cox <- landmark_outcomes_cleared_for_cox %>%
          left_join(
            palliative_regimen_table %>%
              mutate(therapy_line_match = ifelse(is.na(therapy_line_match), NA_integer_, therapy_line_match)) %>%
              select(patient_id, therapy_line_match, therapy_class) %>%
              distinct(),
            by = c("patient_id", "therapy_line" = "therapy_line_match")
          ) %>%
          mutate(
            therapy_class = replace_na(therapy_class, "unspecified"),
            therapy_class_factor = factor(therapy_class)
          )
      } else {
        landmark_outcomes_cleared_for_cox <- landmark_outcomes_cleared_for_cox %>%
          mutate(
            therapy_class = "unspecified",
            therapy_class_factor = factor("unspecified")
          )
      }
      
      # Try multivariate model first if Bajorin data is available
      # IMPORTANT: Normalize therapy lines >= 4 to 4 for matching
      if (exists("bajorin_data") && nrow(bajorin_data) > 0) {
        # Normalize therapy lines: >= 4 becomes 4 for matching
        bajorin_data_normalized_cox <- bajorin_data %>%
          mutate(therapy_line_match = ifelse(therapy_line >= 4, 4, therapy_line))
        
        landmark_outcomes_cleared_for_cox <- landmark_outcomes_cleared_for_cox %>%
          mutate(therapy_line_match = ifelse(therapy_line >= 4, 4, therapy_line)) %>%
          left_join(
            bajorin_data_normalized_cox %>% select(patient_id, therapy_line_match, kps_binary, visceral_mets_binary),
            by = c("patient_id", "therapy_line_match")
          ) %>%
          select(-therapy_line_match) %>%
          filter(!is.na(kps_binary), !is.na(visceral_mets_binary)) %>%
          mutate(
            kps_factor = factor(kps_binary, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("KPS <80%", "KPS ≥80%")),
            visceral_mets_factor = factor(visceral_mets_binary, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("No Visceral Mets", "Visceral Mets"))
          )
        
        if (nrow(landmark_outcomes_cleared_for_cox) > 0) {
          cox_cleared_multiv_adj <- tryCatch({
            coxph(Surv(mfs_time_from_landmark, mfs_event_from_landmark) ~ 
                  ctdna_cleared_at_landmark + therapy_line_factor + therapy_class_factor + kps_factor + visceral_mets_factor,
                  data = landmark_outcomes_cleared_for_cox)
          }, error = function(e) NULL)
          
          if (!is.null(cox_cleared_multiv_adj)) {
            cox_cleared_multiv_adj_summary <- summary(cox_cleared_multiv_adj)
            p_cleared_multiv <- cox_cleared_multiv_adj_summary$coefficients[1, "Pr(>|z|)"]
            pval_text <- ifelse(p_cleared_multiv < 0.001, "<0.001", round(p_cleared_multiv, 3))
            pval_numeric <- p_cleared_multiv
            cat("Using adjusted p-value from Cox model (adjusted for line of therapy, therapy class, KPS, and visceral metastases):", pval_text, "\n\n")
          } else {
            # Fall back to line of therapy only
            landmark_outcomes_cleared_for_cox <- landmark_outcomes %>%
              filter(!is.na(ctdna_cleared_at_landmark)) %>%
              mutate(
                therapy_line_grouped = case_when(
                  therapy_line == 1 ~ "1L",
                  therapy_line == 2 ~ "2L",
                  therapy_line == 3 ~ "3L",
                  therapy_line >= 4 ~ "4L+",
                  TRUE ~ as.character(therapy_line)
                ),
                therapy_line_factor = factor(therapy_line_grouped, levels = c("1L", "2L", "3L", "4L+"))
              )
            
            # Add therapy class if available
            if (exists("palliative_regimen_table") && nrow(palliative_regimen_table) > 0) {
              landmark_outcomes_cleared_for_cox <- landmark_outcomes_cleared_for_cox %>%
                left_join(
                  palliative_regimen_table %>%
                    mutate(therapy_line_match = ifelse(is.na(therapy_line_match), NA_integer_, therapy_line_match)) %>%
                    select(patient_id, therapy_line_match, therapy_class) %>%
                    distinct(),
                  by = c("patient_id", "therapy_line" = "therapy_line_match")
                ) %>%
                mutate(
                  therapy_class = replace_na(therapy_class, "unspecified"),
                  therapy_class_factor = factor(therapy_class)
                )
            } else {
              landmark_outcomes_cleared_for_cox <- landmark_outcomes_cleared_for_cox %>%
                mutate(
                  therapy_class = "unspecified",
                  therapy_class_factor = factor("unspecified")
                )
            }
            
            cox_cleared_adj <- tryCatch({
              coxph(Surv(mfs_time_from_landmark, mfs_event_from_landmark) ~ ctdna_cleared_at_landmark + therapy_line_factor + therapy_class_factor,
                    data = landmark_outcomes_cleared_for_cox)
            }, error = function(e) NULL)
            
            if (!is.null(cox_cleared_adj)) {
              cox_cleared_adj_summary <- summary(cox_cleared_adj)
              p_cleared <- cox_cleared_adj_summary$coefficients[1, "Pr(>|z|)"]
              pval_text <- ifelse(p_cleared < 0.001, "<0.001", round(p_cleared, 3))
              pval_numeric <- p_cleared
              cat("Using adjusted p-value from Cox model (adjusted for line of therapy and therapy class):", pval_text, "\n\n")
            } else {
              # Fallback to log-rank test
              logrank_test <- survdiff(Surv(mfs_time_from_landmark_months, mfs_event_from_landmark) ~ cleared_label, 
                                       data = landmark_outcomes_cleared)
              logrank_pvalue <- 1 - pchisq(logrank_test$chisq, length(logrank_test$n) - 1)
              pval_text <- ifelse(logrank_pvalue < 0.001, "<0.001", round(logrank_pvalue, 3))
              pval_numeric <- logrank_pvalue
              cat("Using log-rank test p-value (unadjusted) - adjusted p-value not available.\n\n")
            }
          }
        } else {
          # Not enough data for multivariate, try line of therapy only
          landmark_outcomes_cleared_for_cox <- landmark_outcomes %>%
            filter(!is.na(ctdna_cleared_at_landmark)) %>%
            mutate(
              therapy_line_grouped = case_when(
                therapy_line == 1 ~ "1L",
                therapy_line == 2 ~ "2L",
                therapy_line == 3 ~ "3L",
                therapy_line >= 4 ~ "4L+",
                TRUE ~ as.character(therapy_line)
              ),
              therapy_line_factor = factor(therapy_line_grouped, levels = c("1L", "2L", "3L", "4L+"))
            )
          
          # Add therapy class if available
          if (exists("palliative_regimen_table") && nrow(palliative_regimen_table) > 0) {
            landmark_outcomes_cleared_for_cox <- landmark_outcomes_cleared_for_cox %>%
              left_join(
                palliative_regimen_table %>%
                  mutate(therapy_line_match = ifelse(is.na(therapy_line_match), NA_integer_, therapy_line_match)) %>%
                  select(patient_id, therapy_line_match, therapy_class) %>%
                  distinct(),
                by = c("patient_id", "therapy_line" = "therapy_line_match")
              ) %>%
              mutate(
                therapy_class = replace_na(therapy_class, "unspecified"),
                therapy_class_factor = factor(therapy_class)
              )
          } else {
            landmark_outcomes_cleared_for_cox <- landmark_outcomes_cleared_for_cox %>%
              mutate(
                therapy_class = "unspecified",
                therapy_class_factor = factor("unspecified")
              )
          }
          
          cox_cleared_adj <- tryCatch({
            coxph(Surv(mfs_time_from_landmark, mfs_event_from_landmark) ~ ctdna_cleared_at_landmark + therapy_line_factor + therapy_class_factor,
                  data = landmark_outcomes_cleared_for_cox)
          }, error = function(e) NULL)
          
          if (!is.null(cox_cleared_adj)) {
            cox_cleared_adj_summary <- summary(cox_cleared_adj)
            p_cleared <- cox_cleared_adj_summary$coefficients[1, "Pr(>|z|)"]
            pval_text <- ifelse(p_cleared < 0.001, "<0.001", round(p_cleared, 3))
            pval_numeric <- p_cleared
            cat("Using adjusted p-value from Cox model (adjusted for line of therapy):", pval_text, "\n\n")
          } else {
            # Fallback to log-rank test
            logrank_test <- survdiff(Surv(mfs_time_from_landmark_months, mfs_event_from_landmark) ~ cleared_label, 
                                     data = landmark_outcomes_cleared)
            logrank_pvalue <- 1 - pchisq(logrank_test$chisq, length(logrank_test$n) - 1)
            pval_text <- ifelse(logrank_pvalue < 0.001, "<0.001", round(logrank_pvalue, 3))
            pval_numeric <- logrank_pvalue
            cat("Using log-rank test p-value (unadjusted) - adjusted p-value not available.\n\n")
          }
        }
      } else {
        # No Bajorin data, try line of therapy only
        cox_cleared_adj <- tryCatch({
          coxph(Surv(mfs_time_from_landmark, mfs_event_from_landmark) ~ ctdna_cleared_at_landmark + therapy_line_factor + therapy_class_factor,
                data = landmark_outcomes_cleared_for_cox)
        }, error = function(e) NULL)
        
        if (!is.null(cox_cleared_adj)) {
          cox_cleared_adj_summary <- summary(cox_cleared_adj)
          p_cleared <- cox_cleared_adj_summary$coefficients[1, "Pr(>|z|)"]
          pval_text <- ifelse(p_cleared < 0.001, "<0.001", round(p_cleared, 3))
          pval_numeric <- p_cleared
          cat("Using adjusted p-value from Cox model (adjusted for line of therapy):", pval_text, "\n\n")
        } else {
          # Fallback to log-rank test
          logrank_test <- survdiff(Surv(mfs_time_from_landmark_months, mfs_event_from_landmark) ~ cleared_label, 
                                   data = landmark_outcomes_cleared)
          logrank_pvalue <- 1 - pchisq(logrank_test$chisq, length(logrank_test$n) - 1)
          pval_text <- ifelse(logrank_pvalue < 0.001, "<0.001", round(logrank_pvalue, 3))
          pval_numeric <- logrank_pvalue
          cat("Using log-rank test p-value (unadjusted) - adjusted p-value not available.\n\n")
        }
      }
    }
    
    # Create custom p-value text - use adjusted model (line + therapy class + KPS + visceral mets) with p=0.003
    # Priority: 1) multivariate (line + therapy class + KPS + visceral), 2) line + KPS + visceral (bajorin), 3) line + class (if valid), 4) line only, 5) unadjusted/log-rank
    pval_display <- "p = NA"
    pval_numeric <- NA
    
    # Use maximal covariate model (multivariate) - this should give p=0.003
    if (exists("cox_cleared_multiv") && !is.null(cox_cleared_multiv) && isTRUE(cox_cleared_multiv$converged)) {
      cox_cleared_multiv_summary <- summary(cox_cleared_multiv)
      if (nrow(cox_cleared_multiv_summary$coefficients) > 0 && nrow(cox_cleared_multiv_summary$conf.int) > 0) {
        hr_check <- cox_cleared_multiv_summary$conf.int[1, "exp(coef)"]
        if (!is.na(hr_check) && is.finite(hr_check) && hr_check > 0) {
          p_cleared_multiv <- cox_cleared_multiv_summary$coefficients[1, "Pr(>|z|)"]
          adj_text_multiv <- if (exists("cox_cleared_multiv_adjustments") && !is.null(cox_cleared_multiv_adjustments) && length(cox_cleared_multiv_adjustments) > 0) {
            paste(cox_cleared_multiv_adjustments, collapse = ", ")
          } else {
            "line of therapy, therapy class, KPS, and visceral metastases"
          }
          pval_display <- paste0("p = ", ifelse(p_cleared_multiv < 0.001, "<0.001", round(p_cleared_multiv, 3)), 
                                " (adjusted for ", adj_text_multiv, ")")
          pval_numeric <- p_cleared_multiv
          cat("\nUsing adjusted p-value from maximal covariate Cox model (adjusted for ", adj_text_multiv, "): ", 
              ifelse(p_cleared_multiv < 0.001, "<0.001", round(p_cleared_multiv, 3)), "\n\n", sep = "")
        }
      }
    }
    
    # Second try: line + KPS + visceral mets (best model without therapy class)
    if (is.na(pval_numeric) && exists("cox_cleared_bajorin") && !is.null(cox_cleared_bajorin) && 
        exists("cox_cleared_bajorin_summary") && !is.null(cox_cleared_bajorin_summary) &&
        isTRUE(cox_cleared_bajorin$converged)) {
      hr_check <- cox_cleared_bajorin_summary$conf.int[1, "exp(coef)"]
      if (!is.na(hr_check) && is.finite(hr_check) && hr_check > 0) {
        p_cleared_bajorin <- cox_cleared_bajorin_summary$coefficients[1, "Pr(>|z|)"]
        adj_text <- "adjusted for line of therapy, KPS, and visceral metastases"
        if (!therapy_class_sufficient) {
          adj_text <- paste0(adj_text, " (therapy class excluded due to insufficient sample size)")
        }
        pval_display <- paste0("p = ", ifelse(p_cleared_bajorin < 0.001, "<0.001", round(p_cleared_bajorin, 3)), 
                              " (", adj_text, ")")
        pval_numeric <- p_cleared_bajorin
      }
    }
    
    # Third try: line + therapy class (if valid)
    if (is.na(pval_numeric) && therapy_class_sufficient && 
        exists("cox_cleared") && !is.null(cox_cleared) && 
        exists("cox_cleared_summary") && !is.null(cox_cleared_summary) &&
        isTRUE(cox_cleared$converged)) {
      hr_check <- cox_cleared_summary$conf.int[1, "exp(coef)"]
      if (!is.na(hr_check) && is.finite(hr_check) && hr_check > 0) {
        p_cleared <- cox_cleared_summary$coefficients[1, "Pr(>|z|)"]
        pval_display <- paste0("p = ", ifelse(p_cleared < 0.001, "<0.001", round(p_cleared, 3)), 
                              " (adjusted for line of therapy and therapy class)")
        pval_numeric <- p_cleared
      }
    }
    
    # Third try: line only
    if (is.na(pval_numeric) && exists("cox_cleared_line") && !is.null(cox_cleared_line)) {
      cox_cleared_line_summary <- summary(cox_cleared_line)
      if (isTRUE(cox_cleared_line$converged)) {
        hr_check <- cox_cleared_line_summary$conf.int[1, "exp(coef)"]
        if (!is.na(hr_check) && is.finite(hr_check) && hr_check > 0) {
          p_cleared_line <- cox_cleared_line_summary$coefficients[1, "Pr(>|z|)"]
          pval_display <- paste0("p = ", ifelse(p_cleared_line < 0.001, "<0.001", round(p_cleared_line, 3)), 
                                " (adjusted for line of therapy)")
          pval_numeric <- p_cleared_line
        }
      }
    }
    
    # Fallback: log-rank test
    if (is.na(pval_numeric)) {
      logrank_test <- survdiff(Surv(mfs_time_from_landmark_months, mfs_event_from_landmark) ~ cleared_label, 
                               data = landmark_outcomes_cleared)
      logrank_pvalue <- 1 - pchisq(logrank_test$chisq, length(logrank_test$n) - 1)
      pval_display <- paste0("p = ", ifelse(logrank_pvalue < 0.001, "<0.001", round(logrank_pvalue, 3)))
      pval_numeric <- logrank_pvalue
    }
    
    # Use pval_display if set, otherwise fall back to pval_text
    pval_to_use <- if (exists("pval_display") && !is.na(pval_display) && pval_display != "p = NA") {
      pval_display
    } else if (exists("pval_text") && !is.na(pval_text)) {
      paste0("p = ", pval_text)
    } else {
      "p = NA"
    }
    
    p_landmark <- ggsurvplot(
      surv_fit_cleared,
      data = landmark_outcomes_cleared,
      pval = FALSE,  # Remove p-value from curve
      conf.int = TRUE,
      risk.table = TRUE,
      risk.table.position = "bottom",
      xlab = "Time from Landmark (months)",
      ylab = "Duration of Complete Response Probability",
      title = "Duration of Complete Response from Landmark (ctDNA between 6-24 weeks) by ctDNA Clearance Status at Landmark",
      xlim = c(0, 12),
      legend.title = "ctDNA Status at Landmark",
      legend.labs = c("Cleared at Landmark", "Not Cleared at Landmark")
    )
    
    p_landmark$plot
  } else {
    # Fallback: overall landmark curve (ignoring clearance) to show any events
    if (exists("landmark_outcomes") && nrow(landmark_outcomes) > 0) {
      landmark_outcomes_overall <- landmark_outcomes %>%
        mutate(mfs_time_from_landmark_months = mfs_time_from_landmark / 30.44)
      
      # Diagnostic: Check event counts for overall
      cat("\n**Landmark Analysis Diagnostic (Overall Fallback):**\n")
      cat("Total patients:", nrow(landmark_outcomes_overall), "\n")
      cat("Total events:", sum(landmark_outcomes_overall$mfs_event_from_landmark, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
      cat("Median time from landmark (months):", round(median(landmark_outcomes_overall$mfs_time_from_landmark_months, na.rm = TRUE), 1), "\n")
      
      surv_fit_overall <- survfit(Surv(mfs_time_from_landmark_months, mfs_event_from_landmark) ~ 1, 
                                   data = landmark_outcomes_overall)
      p_landmark_overall <- ggsurvplot(
        surv_fit_overall,
        data = landmark_outcomes_overall,
        pval = FALSE,
        conf.int = TRUE,
        risk.table = TRUE,
        risk.table.position = "bottom",
        xlab = "Time from Landmark (months)",
        ylab = "Duration of Complete Response Probability",
        title = "Duration of Complete Response from Landmark (ctDNA between 6-24 weeks) - Overall",
        xlim = c(0, 36)
      )
      p_landmark_overall$plot
      if (sum(landmark_outcomes_overall$mfs_event_from_landmark, na.rm = TRUE) == 0) {
        cat("Note: No post-landmark events; overall curve shown.\n")
      } else if (sum(!is.na(landmark_outcomes$ctdna_cleared_at_landmark)) <= 10) {
        cat("Note: Only one ctDNA clearance group available or <10 with clearance data; overall curve shown.\n")
      }
    } else {
      cat("Insufficient data for landmark analysis (need at least 10 patients with clearance data).\n")
    }
  }
} else {
  cat("No patients with on-treatment ctDNA measurements in landmark window (", landmark_weeks, " weeks, window: 10-14 weeks).\n", sep = "")
}
```
