<!-- ## Secondary Analysis: Time to Next Treatment - SUPPRESSED from knit output per user request -->

<!-- **What is the association between early on-treatment ctDNA response (cleared vs not cleared) at 6-24 weeks after therapy initiation and time to next treatment?** -->

This secondary analysis examines whether early ctDNA clearance (within 6-24 weeks after starting therapy) is associated with longer time to next treatment. Time to next treatment is defined as the time from therapy initiation until the start of the next line of therapy or death, whichever occurs first.

```{r time_to_next_treatment_setup, include=FALSE}
# ====================================================================================
# TIME TO NEXT TREATMENT ANALYSIS
# ====================================================================================
# Time to next treatment = time from therapy start to next therapy line OR death
# Event = 1 if patient started next therapy OR died
# Censored = 0 if patient is alive and hasn't started next therapy by last follow-up
# ====================================================================================

# For each patient-line observation, find the next therapy line
# Next therapy = therapy_line + 1 for the same patient
next_therapy_data <- all_palliative_therapy_lines %>%
  arrange(patient_id, therapy_line) %>%
  group_by(patient_id) %>%
  mutate(
    next_therapy_line = lead(therapy_line),
    next_therapy_start_date = lead(therapy_start_date)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(patient_id, therapy_line, next_therapy_line, next_therapy_start_date)

# Get death dates and last follow-up dates
death_date_cols <- names(dat_combined)[str_detect(names(dat_combined), regex("^death_date$|death.*date$", ignore_case = TRUE)) & 
                                       !str_detect(names(dat_combined), regex("cause|reason", ignore_case = TRUE))]
survival_cols <- names(dat_combined)[str_detect(names(dat_combined), regex("last.*follow.*up.*date|follow.*up.*date", ignore_case = TRUE)) & 
                                     !str_detect(names(dat_combined), regex("death", ignore_case = TRUE))]
alive_cols <- names(dat_combined)[str_detect(names(dat_combined), regex("^alive_yes_no$|alive.*yes.*no", ignore_case = TRUE))]

# Create time to next treatment outcomes for landmark analysis
if (exists("landmark_outcomes") && nrow(landmark_outcomes) > 0) {
  landmark_ttnt <- landmark_outcomes %>%
    select(patient_id, therapy_line, time_zero_date, landmark_time, 
           ctdna_cleared_at_landmark, baseline_ctdna, on_tx_ctdna, pct_decline, response_category) %>%
    # Join with next therapy data
    left_join(next_therapy_data, by = c("patient_id", "therapy_line")) %>%
    # Join with death and follow-up data
    left_join(
      dat_combined %>%
        select(patient_id, all_of(c(death_date_cols, survival_cols, alive_cols))),
      by = "patient_id"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      death_date = if (length(death_date_cols) > 0) {
        as_date_safe(.data[[death_date_cols[1]]])
      } else {
        as.Date(NA)
      },
      last_fu_date = if (length(survival_cols) > 0) {
        as_date_safe(.data[[survival_cols[1]]])
      } else {
        as.Date(NA)
      },
      alive_status = if (length(alive_cols) > 0) {
        case_when(
          str_detect(tolower(as.character(.data[[alive_cols[1]]])), "yes|y|1") ~ "Yes",
          str_detect(tolower(as.character(.data[[alive_cols[1]]])), "no|n|0") ~ "No",
          TRUE ~ NA_character_
        )
      } else {
        NA_character_
      },
      # Time 0 for TTNT analysis = therapy start date (time_zero_date)
      # Event date = next therapy start date OR death date, whichever comes first
      event_date = case_when(
        !is.na(next_therapy_start_date) & !is.na(death_date) ~ 
          pmin(next_therapy_start_date, death_date, na.rm = TRUE),
        !is.na(next_therapy_start_date) ~ next_therapy_start_date,
        !is.na(death_date) ~ death_date,
        TRUE ~ as.Date(NA)
      ),
      # Censor date = last follow-up if no event
      censor_date = case_when(
        !is.na(event_date) ~ event_date,
        !is.na(last_fu_date) ~ last_fu_date,
        TRUE ~ as.Date(NA)
      ),
      # TTNT time = time from therapy start to event/censor
      ttnt_time = as.numeric(censor_date - time_zero_date),
      # TTNT event = 1 if next therapy started OR death occurred
      ttnt_event = case_when(
        !is.na(next_therapy_start_date) & !is.na(death_date) ~ 
          ifelse(next_therapy_start_date <= death_date, 1, 1),  # Both are events
        !is.na(next_therapy_start_date) ~ 1,  # Next therapy started
        !is.na(death_date) ~ 1,  # Death occurred
        TRUE ~ 0  # Censored (alive, no next therapy)
      ),
      # Event type for clarity
      event_type = case_when(
        !is.na(next_therapy_start_date) & !is.na(death_date) & next_therapy_start_date <= death_date ~ "Next Therapy",
        !is.na(next_therapy_start_date) & !is.na(death_date) & death_date < next_therapy_start_date ~ "Death",
        !is.na(next_therapy_start_date) ~ "Next Therapy",
        !is.na(death_date) ~ "Death",
        TRUE ~ "Censored"
      )
    ) %>%
    # Filter: require valid TTNT time
    filter(!is.na(ttnt_time), ttnt_time > 0)
  
  cat("Time to Next Treatment Analysis Setup:\n")
  cat("Patients in landmark analysis:", nrow(landmark_outcomes), "\n")
  cat("Patients with valid TTNT data:", nrow(landmark_ttnt), "\n")
  cat("TTNT events (next therapy or death):", sum(landmark_ttnt$ttnt_event, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
  cat("TTNT censored (alive, no next therapy):", sum(landmark_ttnt$ttnt_event == 0, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
  cat("Median TTNT time (days):", round(median(landmark_ttnt$ttnt_time, na.rm = TRUE), 0), "\n")
} else {
  landmark_ttnt <- NULL
  cat("Landmark outcomes not available for TTNT analysis.\n")
}
```

```{r time_to_next_treatment_landmark_analysis, include=FALSE}
# ====================================================================================
# LANDMARK ANALYSIS: Time to Next Treatment
# ====================================================================================
# Perform landmark analysis for TTNT: analyze survival from landmark time point forward
# ====================================================================================

if (exists("landmark_ttnt") && !is.null(landmark_ttnt) && nrow(landmark_ttnt) > 0) {
  # Calculate TTNT from landmark time point
  # Only include patients who survived to landmark (didn't start next therapy or die before landmark)
  landmark_ttnt_analysis <- landmark_ttnt %>%
    mutate(
      # Calculate landmark date
      landmark_date = time_zero_date + days(landmark_time),
      # Check if next therapy started before landmark (exclude these patients)
      next_therapy_before_landmark = !is.na(next_therapy_start_date) & 
                                      next_therapy_start_date < landmark_date,
      # Check if death occurred before landmark (exclude these patients)
      death_before_landmark = !is.na(death_date) & 
                              death_date < landmark_date,
      # Only include patients who survived to landmark (no next therapy or death before landmark)
      survived_to_landmark = !next_therapy_before_landmark & !death_before_landmark & ttnt_time >= landmark_time,
      # TTNT time from landmark = time from landmark to next therapy/death
      # If next therapy started after landmark, calculate from landmark
      # If death occurred after landmark, calculate from landmark
      ttnt_time_from_landmark = case_when(
        !is.na(next_therapy_start_date) & next_therapy_start_date >= landmark_date ~
          as.numeric(next_therapy_start_date - landmark_date),
        !is.na(death_date) & death_date >= landmark_date ~
          as.numeric(death_date - landmark_date),
        !is.na(last_fu_date) ~ as.numeric(last_fu_date - landmark_date),
        TRUE ~ NA_real_
      ),
      # Event status: 1 if next therapy or death occurred after landmark, 0 if censored
      ttnt_event_from_landmark = case_when(
        !is.na(next_therapy_start_date) & next_therapy_start_date >= landmark_date ~ 1,
        !is.na(death_date) & death_date >= landmark_date ~ 1,
        TRUE ~ 0
      )
    ) %>%
    # Filter: require valid survival time from landmark and no event before landmark
    filter(survived_to_landmark, !is.na(ttnt_time_from_landmark), ttnt_time_from_landmark > 0)
  
  cat("Landmark TTNT Analysis:\n")
  cat("Patients who survived to landmark:", nrow(landmark_ttnt_analysis), "\n")
  cat("TTNT events after landmark:", sum(landmark_ttnt_analysis$ttnt_event_from_landmark, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
  cat("Median TTNT from landmark (days):", round(median(landmark_ttnt_analysis$ttnt_time_from_landmark, na.rm = TRUE), 0), "\n")
  
  # Prepare data for Cox models (same structure as DCR analysis)
  landmark_ttnt_cleared <- landmark_ttnt_analysis %>%
    filter(!is.na(ctdna_cleared_at_landmark)) %>%
    mutate(
      therapy_line_grouped = case_when(
        therapy_line == 1 ~ "1L",
        therapy_line == 2 ~ "2L",
        therapy_line == 3 ~ "3L",
        therapy_line >= 4 ~ "4L+",
        TRUE ~ as.character(therapy_line)
      ),
      therapy_line_factor = factor(therapy_line_grouped, levels = c("1L", "2L", "3L", "4L+"))
    )
  
  # Join therapy class if available
  if (exists("palliative_regimen_table") && nrow(palliative_regimen_table) > 0) {
    landmark_ttnt_cleared <- landmark_ttnt_cleared %>%
      left_join(
        palliative_regimen_table %>%
          mutate(therapy_line_match = ifelse(is.na(therapy_line_match), NA_integer_, therapy_line_match)) %>%
          select(patient_id, therapy_line_match, therapy_class) %>%
          distinct(),
        by = c("patient_id", "therapy_line" = "therapy_line_match")
      ) %>%
      mutate(
        therapy_class = replace_na(therapy_class, "unspecified"),
        therapy_class_factor = factor(therapy_class)
      )
  } else {
    landmark_ttnt_cleared <- landmark_ttnt_cleared %>%
      mutate(
        therapy_class = "unspecified",
        therapy_class_factor = factor("unspecified")
      )
  }
  
  # Join Bajorin risk factors if available
  # IMPORTANT: Normalize therapy lines >= 4 to 4 for matching
  if (exists("bajorin_data") && nrow(bajorin_data) > 0) {
    # Normalize therapy lines: >= 4 becomes 4 for matching
    bajorin_data_normalized_ttnt <- bajorin_data %>%
      mutate(therapy_line_match = ifelse(therapy_line >= 4, 4, therapy_line))
    
    landmark_ttnt_cleared <- landmark_ttnt_cleared %>%
      mutate(therapy_line_match = ifelse(therapy_line >= 4, 4, therapy_line)) %>%
      left_join(
        bajorin_data_normalized_ttnt %>% select(patient_id, therapy_line_match, kps_binary, visceral_mets_binary),
        by = c("patient_id", "therapy_line_match")
      ) %>%
      select(-therapy_line_match) %>%
      mutate(
        kps_factor = factor(kps_binary, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("KPS <80%", "KPS ≥80%")),
        visceral_mets_factor = factor(visceral_mets_binary, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("No Visceral Mets", "Visceral Mets"))
      )
  } else {
    landmark_ttnt_cleared <- landmark_ttnt_cleared %>%
      mutate(
        kps_binary = NA_real_,
        visceral_mets_binary = NA_real_,
        kps_factor = factor(NA, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("KPS <80%", "KPS ≥80%")),
        visceral_mets_factor = factor(NA, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("No Visceral Mets", "Visceral Mets"))
      )
  }
  
  # Model 1: Unadjusted Cox model
  cox_ttnt_unadj <- tryCatch({
    coxph(Surv(ttnt_time_from_landmark, ttnt_event_from_landmark) ~ ctdna_cleared_at_landmark,
          data = landmark_ttnt_cleared)
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat("Error fitting unadjusted TTNT Cox model:", e$message, "\n")
    NULL
  })
  
  # Model 2: Adjusted for line of therapy
  cox_ttnt_line <- tryCatch({
    coxph(Surv(ttnt_time_from_landmark, ttnt_event_from_landmark) ~ ctdna_cleared_at_landmark + therapy_line_factor,
          data = landmark_ttnt_cleared)
  }, error = function(e) NULL)
  
  # Model 3: Adjusted for KPS only (if available)
  cox_ttnt_kps <- NULL
  cox_ttnt_kps_summary <- NULL
  if (sum(!is.na(landmark_ttnt_cleared$kps_binary)) > 0) {
    landmark_ttnt_kps <- landmark_ttnt_cleared %>%
      filter(!is.na(kps_binary))
    
    if (nrow(landmark_ttnt_kps) > 0) {
      cox_ttnt_kps <- tryCatch({
        coxph(Surv(ttnt_time_from_landmark, ttnt_event_from_landmark) ~ ctdna_cleared_at_landmark + kps_factor, 
              data = landmark_ttnt_kps)
      }, error = function(e) NULL)
      
      if (!is.null(cox_ttnt_kps)) {
        cox_ttnt_kps_summary <- summary(cox_ttnt_kps)
      }
    }
  }
  
  # Model 4: Adjusted for visceral metastases only (if available)
  cox_ttnt_visceral <- NULL
  cox_ttnt_visceral_summary <- NULL
  if (sum(!is.na(landmark_ttnt_cleared$visceral_mets_binary)) > 0) {
    landmark_ttnt_visceral <- landmark_ttnt_cleared %>%
      filter(!is.na(visceral_mets_binary))
    
    if (nrow(landmark_ttnt_visceral) > 0) {
      cox_ttnt_visceral <- tryCatch({
        coxph(Surv(ttnt_time_from_landmark, ttnt_event_from_landmark) ~ ctdna_cleared_at_landmark + visceral_mets_factor, 
              data = landmark_ttnt_visceral)
      }, error = function(e) NULL)
      
      if (!is.null(cox_ttnt_visceral)) {
        cox_ttnt_visceral_summary <- summary(cox_ttnt_visceral)
      }
    }
  }
  
  # Model 4b: Adjusted for line of therapy + KPS + visceral mets (Bajorin factors, no therapy class)
  cox_ttnt_bajorin <- NULL
  cox_ttnt_bajorin_summary <- NULL
  if (sum(!is.na(landmark_ttnt_cleared$kps_binary)) > 0 && 
      sum(!is.na(landmark_ttnt_cleared$visceral_mets_binary)) > 0) {
    landmark_ttnt_bajorin <- landmark_ttnt_cleared %>%
      filter(!is.na(kps_binary), !is.na(visceral_mets_binary))
    
    if (nrow(landmark_ttnt_bajorin) > 0) {
      cox_ttnt_bajorin <- tryCatch({
        coxph(Surv(ttnt_time_from_landmark, ttnt_event_from_landmark) ~ 
              ctdna_cleared_at_landmark + therapy_line_factor + kps_factor + visceral_mets_factor,
              data = landmark_ttnt_bajorin)
      }, error = function(e) NULL)
      
      if (!is.null(cox_ttnt_bajorin)) {
        cox_ttnt_bajorin_summary <- summary(cox_ttnt_bajorin)
      }
    }
  }
  
  # Model 5: Adjusted for line of therapy + therapy class
  # First check if therapy class produces valid results
  therapy_class_sufficient_ttnt <- FALSE
  cox_ttnt_adj <- tryCatch({
    # Filter out therapy classes with insufficient sample size
    therapy_class_counts_ttnt <- landmark_ttnt_cleared %>%
      filter(!is.na(therapy_class)) %>%
      count(therapy_class) %>%
      filter(n >= 5) %>%
      pull(therapy_class)
    
    landmark_ttnt_cleared_class <- landmark_ttnt_cleared %>%
      filter(therapy_class %in% therapy_class_counts_ttnt | is.na(therapy_class))
    
    if (nrow(landmark_ttnt_cleared_class) > 0 && length(therapy_class_counts_ttnt) > 0) {
      landmark_ttnt_cleared_class <- landmark_ttnt_cleared_class %>%
        mutate(
          therapy_class_filtered = ifelse(therapy_class %in% therapy_class_counts_ttnt, therapy_class, "unspecified"),
          therapy_class_factor_filtered = factor(therapy_class_filtered)
        )
      
      cox_ttnt_adj <- coxph(Surv(ttnt_time_from_landmark, ttnt_event_from_landmark) ~ 
            ctdna_cleared_at_landmark + therapy_line_factor + therapy_class_factor_filtered,
            data = landmark_ttnt_cleared_class)
      
      # Validate that model produced reasonable results
      if (!is.null(cox_ttnt_adj) && isTRUE(cox_ttnt_adj$converged)) {
        cox_ttnt_adj_summary <- summary(cox_ttnt_adj)
        if (nrow(cox_ttnt_adj_summary$coefficients) > 0 && nrow(cox_ttnt_adj_summary$conf.int) > 0) {
          hr_check_ttnt <- cox_ttnt_adj_summary$conf.int[1, "exp(coef)"]
          hr_lower_check_ttnt <- cox_ttnt_adj_summary$conf.int[1, "lower .95"]
          hr_upper_check_ttnt <- cox_ttnt_adj_summary$conf.int[1, "upper .95"]
          
          # Check if HR is reasonable (not extreme)
          is_extreme_ttnt <- is.na(hr_check_ttnt) || !is.finite(hr_check_ttnt) || hr_check_ttnt <= 0 || 
                           is.na(hr_lower_check_ttnt) || !is.finite(hr_lower_check_ttnt) ||
                           is.na(hr_upper_check_ttnt) || !is.finite(hr_upper_check_ttnt) ||
                           str_detect(paste0(round(hr_check_ttnt, 2), " (", round(hr_lower_check_ttnt, 2), "-", round(hr_upper_check_ttnt, 2), ")"), 
                                     "0 \\(0-Inf\\)|Inf \\(0-Inf\\)|Inf \\(Inf-Inf\\)|0 \\(Inf-Inf\\)")
          
          if (!is_extreme_ttnt) {
            therapy_class_sufficient_ttnt <- TRUE
          }
        }
      }
      
      cox_ttnt_adj
    } else {
      NULL
    }
  }, error = function(e) NULL)
  
  # Model 6: Multivariate (line + therapy class + KPS + visceral mets)
  # Use flexible model building: include only covariates with sufficient sample size
  has_kps_ttnt <- sum(!is.na(landmark_ttnt_cleared$kps_binary)) > 0
  has_visceral_ttnt <- sum(!is.na(landmark_ttnt_cleared$visceral_mets_binary)) > 0
  
  # Check therapy class sample sizes (include "unspecified")
  therapy_class_counts_ttnt_multiv <- landmark_ttnt_cleared %>%
    filter(!is.na(therapy_class)) %>%
    count(therapy_class) %>%
    filter(n >= 5) %>%
    pull(therapy_class)
  has_therapy_class_ttnt <- length(therapy_class_counts_ttnt_multiv) > 0 && therapy_class_sufficient_ttnt
  
  cox_ttnt_multiv <- NULL
  cox_ttnt_multiv_summary <- NULL
  landmark_ttnt_multiv <- NULL
  
  if (has_kps_ttnt && has_visceral_ttnt) {
    # Filter to observations with complete Bajorin data
    landmark_ttnt_multiv <- landmark_ttnt_cleared %>%
      filter(!is.na(kps_binary), !is.na(visceral_mets_binary))
    
    if (nrow(landmark_ttnt_multiv) > 0) {
      # Build model formula dynamically based on available covariates
      formula_parts_ttnt <- c("ctdna_cleared_at_landmark", "therapy_line_factor")
      
      # Add therapy class only if it has sufficient sample size and produced valid results
      if (has_therapy_class_ttnt && therapy_class_sufficient_ttnt) {
        landmark_ttnt_multiv <- landmark_ttnt_multiv %>%
          filter(therapy_class %in% therapy_class_counts_ttnt_multiv | is.na(therapy_class)) %>%
          mutate(
            therapy_class_filtered = therapy_class,
            therapy_class_factor_filtered = factor(therapy_class_filtered)
          )
        formula_parts_ttnt <- c(formula_parts_ttnt, "therapy_class_factor_filtered")
      }
      
      # Add Bajorin factors
      formula_parts_ttnt <- c(formula_parts_ttnt, "kps_factor", "visceral_mets_factor")
      
      formula_str_ttnt <- paste("Surv(ttnt_time_from_landmark, ttnt_event_from_landmark) ~", paste(formula_parts_ttnt, collapse = " + "))
      
      cox_ttnt_multiv <- tryCatch({
        coxph(as.formula(formula_str_ttnt), data = landmark_ttnt_multiv)
      }, error = function(e) NULL)
      
      if (!is.null(cox_ttnt_multiv)) {
        cox_ttnt_multiv_summary <- summary(cox_ttnt_multiv)
      }
    }
  }
  
  # Create results table showing HR progression across models (matching Question 1 structure)
  ttnt_table_rows <- list()
  
  # Model 1: Unadjusted
  if (!is.null(cox_ttnt_unadj)) {
    cox_ttnt_unadj_summary <- summary(cox_ttnt_unadj)
    hr_ttnt_unadj <- cox_ttnt_unadj_summary$conf.int[1, "exp(coef)"]
    hr_ttnt_unadj_lower <- cox_ttnt_unadj_summary$conf.int[1, "lower .95"]
    hr_ttnt_unadj_upper <- cox_ttnt_unadj_summary$conf.int[1, "upper .95"]
    p_ttnt_unadj <- cox_ttnt_unadj_summary$coefficients[1, "Pr(>|z|)"]
    
    ttnt_table_rows[[length(ttnt_table_rows) + 1]] <- tibble(
      `Model` = "Unadjusted",
      `HR (95% CI)` = paste0(round(hr_ttnt_unadj, 2), " (", round(hr_ttnt_unadj_lower, 2), "-", round(hr_ttnt_unadj_upper, 2), ")"),
      `P-value` = ifelse(p_ttnt_unadj < 0.001, "<0.001", as.character(round(p_ttnt_unadj, 3)))
    )
  }
  
  # Model 2: Adjusted for line of therapy
  if (!is.null(cox_ttnt_line)) {
    cox_ttnt_line_summary <- summary(cox_ttnt_line)
    hr_ttnt_line <- cox_ttnt_line_summary$conf.int[1, "exp(coef)"]
    hr_ttnt_line_lower <- cox_ttnt_line_summary$conf.int[1, "lower .95"]
    hr_ttnt_line_upper <- cox_ttnt_line_summary$conf.int[1, "upper .95"]
    p_ttnt_line <- cox_ttnt_line_summary$coefficients[1, "Pr(>|z|)"]
    
    ttnt_table_rows[[length(ttnt_table_rows) + 1]] <- tibble(
      `Model` = "Adjusted for line of therapy",
      `HR (95% CI)` = paste0(round(hr_ttnt_line, 2), " (", round(hr_ttnt_line_lower, 2), "-", round(hr_ttnt_line_upper, 2), ")"),
      `P-value` = ifelse(p_ttnt_line < 0.001, "<0.001", as.character(round(p_ttnt_line, 3)))
    )
  }
  
  # Model 3: Adjusted for KPS only
  if (!is.null(cox_ttnt_kps) && !is.null(cox_ttnt_kps_summary)) {
    hr_ttnt_kps <- cox_ttnt_kps_summary$conf.int[1, "exp(coef)"]
    hr_ttnt_kps_lower <- cox_ttnt_kps_summary$conf.int[1, "lower .95"]
    hr_ttnt_kps_upper <- cox_ttnt_kps_summary$conf.int[1, "upper .95"]
    p_ttnt_kps <- cox_ttnt_kps_summary$coefficients[1, "Pr(>|z|)"]
    
    ttnt_table_rows[[length(ttnt_table_rows) + 1]] <- tibble(
      `Model` = "Adjusted for KPS",
      `HR (95% CI)` = paste0(round(hr_ttnt_kps, 2), " (", round(hr_ttnt_kps_lower, 2), "-", round(hr_ttnt_kps_upper, 2), ")"),
      `P-value` = ifelse(p_ttnt_kps < 0.001, "<0.001", as.character(round(p_ttnt_kps, 3)))
    )
  }
  
  # Model 4: Adjusted for visceral metastases only
  if (!is.null(cox_ttnt_visceral) && !is.null(cox_ttnt_visceral_summary)) {
    hr_ttnt_visceral <- cox_ttnt_visceral_summary$conf.int[1, "exp(coef)"]
    hr_ttnt_visceral_lower <- cox_ttnt_visceral_summary$conf.int[1, "lower .95"]
    hr_ttnt_visceral_upper <- cox_ttnt_visceral_summary$conf.int[1, "upper .95"]
    p_ttnt_visceral <- cox_ttnt_visceral_summary$coefficients[1, "Pr(>|z|)"]
    
    ttnt_table_rows[[length(ttnt_table_rows) + 1]] <- tibble(
      `Model` = "Adjusted for visceral metastases",
      `HR (95% CI)` = paste0(round(hr_ttnt_visceral, 2), " (", round(hr_ttnt_visceral_lower, 2), "-", round(hr_ttnt_visceral_upper, 2), ")"),
      `P-value` = ifelse(p_ttnt_visceral < 0.001, "<0.001", as.character(round(p_ttnt_visceral, 3)))
    )
  }
  
  # Model 4b: Adjusted for line of therapy + KPS + visceral mets (Bajorin factors, no therapy class)
  if (!is.null(cox_ttnt_bajorin) && !is.null(cox_ttnt_bajorin_summary) && isTRUE(cox_ttnt_bajorin$converged)) {
    hr_ttnt_bajorin <- cox_ttnt_bajorin_summary$conf.int[1, "exp(coef)"]
    hr_ttnt_bajorin_lower <- cox_ttnt_bajorin_summary$conf.int[1, "lower .95"]
    hr_ttnt_bajorin_upper <- cox_ttnt_bajorin_summary$conf.int[1, "upper .95"]
    p_ttnt_bajorin <- cox_ttnt_bajorin_summary$coefficients[1, "Pr(>|z|)"]
    
    # Check if HR is reasonable
    is_extreme_bajorin <- is.na(hr_ttnt_bajorin) || !is.finite(hr_ttnt_bajorin) || hr_ttnt_bajorin <= 0 || 
                         is.na(hr_ttnt_bajorin_lower) || !is.finite(hr_ttnt_bajorin_lower) ||
                         is.na(hr_ttnt_bajorin_upper) || !is.finite(hr_ttnt_bajorin_upper) ||
                         hr_ttnt_bajorin_lower == 0 || is.infinite(hr_ttnt_bajorin_upper)
    
    if (!is_extreme_bajorin) {
      ttnt_table_rows[[length(ttnt_table_rows) + 1]] <- tibble(
        `Model` = "Adjusted for line of therapy, KPS, and visceral metastases",
        `HR (95% CI)` = paste0(round(hr_ttnt_bajorin, 2), " (", round(hr_ttnt_bajorin_lower, 2), "-", round(hr_ttnt_bajorin_upper, 2), ")"),
        `P-value` = ifelse(p_ttnt_bajorin < 0.001, "<0.001", as.character(round(p_ttnt_bajorin, 3)))
      )
    }
  }
  
  # Model 5: Adjusted for line of therapy + therapy class
  # Only include if HR is reasonable (not extreme) - EXCLUDE this model if it has extreme HR
  if (!is.null(cox_ttnt_adj)) {
    cox_ttnt_adj_summary <- summary(cox_ttnt_adj)
    hr_ttnt_adj <- cox_ttnt_adj_summary$conf.int[1, "exp(coef)"]
    hr_ttnt_adj_lower <- cox_ttnt_adj_summary$conf.int[1, "lower .95"]
    hr_ttnt_adj_upper <- cox_ttnt_adj_summary$conf.int[1, "upper .95"]
    p_ttnt_adj <- cox_ttnt_adj_summary$coefficients[1, "Pr(>|z|)"]
    
    # Check if HR is extreme (0-Inf CI) - check numeric values first
    # Also check if HR is exactly 0 or CI contains Inf
    is_extreme_adj <- is.na(hr_ttnt_adj) || !is.finite(hr_ttnt_adj) || hr_ttnt_adj <= 0 || 
                     is.na(hr_ttnt_adj_lower) || !is.finite(hr_ttnt_adj_lower) ||
                     is.na(hr_ttnt_adj_upper) || !is.finite(hr_ttnt_adj_upper) ||
                     hr_ttnt_adj_lower == 0 || is.infinite(hr_ttnt_adj_upper) ||
                     hr_ttnt_adj == 0 || (hr_ttnt_adj_lower == 0 && is.infinite(hr_ttnt_adj_upper))
    
    # Only add if HR is reasonable - DO NOT add if extreme
    if (!is_extreme_adj) {
      hr_text <- paste0(round(hr_ttnt_adj, 2), " (", round(hr_ttnt_adj_lower, 2), "-", round(hr_ttnt_adj_upper, 2), ")")
      # Double-check the text doesn't contain extreme patterns
      if (!str_detect(hr_text, "0 \\(0-Inf\\)|Inf \\(0-Inf\\)|Inf \\(Inf-Inf\\)|0 \\(Inf-Inf\\)|^0 \\(|Inf\\)")) {
        ttnt_table_rows[[length(ttnt_table_rows) + 1]] <- tibble(
          `Model` = "Adjusted for line of therapy and therapy class",
          `HR (95% CI)` = hr_text,
          `P-value` = ifelse(p_ttnt_adj < 0.001, "<0.001", as.character(round(p_ttnt_adj, 3)))
        )
      }
    }
  }
  
  # Model 6: Adjusted for all (line + therapy class + KPS + visceral mets)
  if (!is.null(cox_ttnt_multiv) && !is.null(cox_ttnt_multiv_summary)) {
    hr_ttnt_multiv <- cox_ttnt_multiv_summary$conf.int[1, "exp(coef)"]
    hr_ttnt_multiv_lower <- cox_ttnt_multiv_summary$conf.int[1, "lower .95"]
    hr_ttnt_multiv_upper <- cox_ttnt_multiv_summary$conf.int[1, "upper .95"]
    p_ttnt_multiv <- cox_ttnt_multiv_summary$coefficients[1, "Pr(>|z|)"]
    
    # Determine which covariates were included
    adj_text_ttnt <- "line of therapy"
    if (has_therapy_class_ttnt) adj_text_ttnt <- paste0(adj_text_ttnt, ", therapy class")
    adj_text_ttnt <- paste0(adj_text_ttnt, ", KPS, and visceral metastases")
    
    ttnt_table_rows[[length(ttnt_table_rows) + 1]] <- tibble(
      `Model` = paste0("Adjusted for ", adj_text_ttnt),
      `HR (95% CI)` = paste0(round(hr_ttnt_multiv, 2), " (", round(hr_ttnt_multiv_lower, 2), "-", round(hr_ttnt_multiv_upper, 2), ")"),
      `P-value` = ifelse(p_ttnt_multiv < 0.001, "<0.001", as.character(round(p_ttnt_multiv, 3)))
    )
  }
  
  # Create table if we have any valid models
  # Filter out rows with extreme HRs (0-Inf or Inf-Inf CI) - be more aggressive
  if (length(ttnt_table_rows) > 0) {
    ttnt_results_df <- bind_rows(ttnt_table_rows) %>%
      filter(
        !str_detect(`HR (95% CI)`, "0 \\(0-Inf\\)|Inf \\(0-Inf\\)|Inf \\(Inf-Inf\\)|0 \\(Inf-Inf\\)"),
        !str_detect(`HR (95% CI)`, "^0 \\(|Inf\\)"),
        !str_detect(`P-value`, "^0\\.999$|^0\\.999 |^1\\.000$")  # Also filter rows with p=0.999
      )
    
    if (nrow(ttnt_results_df) > 0) {
      ttnt_results <- ttnt_results_df %>%
        kable(caption = "Multivariate Cox Model: On-Treatment ctDNA Clearance and Time to Next Treatment from Landmark. Models show HR progression as covariates are added. HR < 1 indicates longer time to next treatment (lower risk of starting next therapy or death) for patients with ctDNA cleared at landmark.") %>%
        kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"), full_width = TRUE)
      cat("TTNT results table created with", nrow(ttnt_results_df), "model(s).\n")
    } else {
      ttnt_results <- NULL
      cat("TTNT results table not created - all models had extreme HR values (0-Inf CI).\n")
    }
  } else {
    ttnt_results <- NULL
    cat("TTNT results table not created - no models converged with valid HR values.\n")
  }
  
  # Create detailed multivariate results table
  if (!is.null(cox_ttnt_multiv) && isTRUE(cox_ttnt_multiv$converged)) {
    cox_ttnt_multiv_summary <- summary(cox_ttnt_multiv)
    n_coef <- nrow(cox_ttnt_multiv_summary$coefficients)
    
    ttnt_multiv_results_list <- list()
    
    # Add ctDNA cleared coefficient
    if (n_coef > 0) {
      hr_val_cleared <- cox_ttnt_multiv_summary$conf.int[1, "exp(coef)"]
      hr_lower_cleared <- cox_ttnt_multiv_summary$conf.int[1, "lower .95"]
      hr_upper_cleared <- cox_ttnt_multiv_summary$conf.int[1, "upper .95"]
      p_val_cleared <- cox_ttnt_multiv_summary$coefficients[1, "Pr(>|z|)"]
      
      if (!is.na(hr_val_cleared) && is.finite(hr_val_cleared) && hr_val_cleared > 0 && hr_val_cleared < 1e10 &&
          !is.na(hr_lower_cleared) && is.finite(hr_lower_cleared) &&
          !is.na(hr_upper_cleared) && is.finite(hr_upper_cleared)) {
        # Create adjustment text for primary result
        if (exists("cox_ttnt_multiv_adjustments") && !is.null(cox_ttnt_multiv_adjustments) && length(cox_ttnt_multiv_adjustments) > 0) {
          adj_text_detailed <- paste0("Adjusted for ", cox_ttnt_multiv_adjustments)
        } else {
          adj_text_detailed <- "Fully Adjusted"
        }
        ttnt_multiv_results_list[[length(ttnt_multiv_results_list) + 1]] <- tibble(
          `Variable` = paste0("**PRIMARY RESULT: ctDNA Cleared at Landmark vs Not Cleared (", adj_text_detailed, ")**"),
          `HR (95% CI)` = paste0(
            round(hr_val_cleared, 2), " (",
            round(hr_lower_cleared, 2), "-",
            round(hr_upper_cleared, 2), ")"
          ),
          `P-value` = if (p_val_cleared < 0.001) "<0.001" else as.character(round(p_val_cleared, 3))
        )
      }
    }
    
    # Add therapy line coefficients
    therapy_line_idx <- which(str_detect(rownames(cox_ttnt_multiv_summary$coefficients), "therapy_line_factor"))
    if (length(therapy_line_idx) > 0) {
      for (i in seq_along(therapy_line_idx)) {
        idx <- therapy_line_idx[i]
        if (idx <= nrow(cox_ttnt_multiv_summary$conf.int)) {
          term_name <- rownames(cox_ttnt_multiv_summary$coefficients)[idx]
          line_name <- str_replace(term_name, "therapy_line_factor", "")
          
          hr_val_line <- cox_ttnt_multiv_summary$conf.int[idx, "exp(coef)"]
          hr_lower_line <- cox_ttnt_multiv_summary$conf.int[idx, "lower .95"]
          hr_upper_line <- cox_ttnt_multiv_summary$conf.int[idx, "upper .95"]
          p_val_line <- cox_ttnt_multiv_summary$coefficients[idx, "Pr(>|z|)"]
          
          if (!is.na(hr_val_line) && is.finite(hr_val_line) && hr_val_line > 0 && hr_val_line < 1e10 &&
              !is.na(hr_lower_line) && is.finite(hr_lower_line) &&
              !is.na(hr_upper_line) && is.finite(hr_upper_line)) {
            ttnt_multiv_results_list[[length(ttnt_multiv_results_list) + 1]] <- tibble(
              `Variable` = paste0("Therapy Line: ", line_name, " vs reference"),
              `HR (95% CI)` = paste0(
                round(hr_val_line, 2), " (",
                round(hr_lower_line, 2), "-",
                round(hr_upper_line, 2), ")"
              ),
              `P-value` = if (p_val_line < 0.001) "<0.001" else as.character(round(p_val_line, 3))
            )
          }
        }
      }
    }
    
    # Add KPS coefficient
    kps_idx <- which(str_detect(rownames(cox_ttnt_multiv_summary$coefficients), "kps_factor"))
    if (length(kps_idx) > 0) {
      idx <- kps_idx[1]
      if (idx <= nrow(cox_ttnt_multiv_summary$conf.int)) {
        hr_val_kps <- cox_ttnt_multiv_summary$conf.int[idx, "exp(coef)"]
        hr_lower_kps <- cox_ttnt_multiv_summary$conf.int[idx, "lower .95"]
        hr_upper_kps <- cox_ttnt_multiv_summary$conf.int[idx, "upper .95"]
        p_val_kps <- cox_ttnt_multiv_summary$coefficients[idx, "Pr(>|z|)"]
        
        if (!is.na(hr_val_kps) && is.finite(hr_val_kps) && hr_val_kps > 0 && hr_val_kps < 1e10 &&
            !is.na(hr_lower_kps) && is.finite(hr_lower_kps) &&
            !is.na(hr_upper_kps) && is.finite(hr_upper_kps)) {
          ttnt_multiv_results_list[[length(ttnt_multiv_results_list) + 1]] <- tibble(
            `Variable` = "KPS ≥80% vs <80%",
            `HR (95% CI)` = paste0(
              round(hr_val_kps, 2), " (",
              round(hr_lower_kps, 2), "-",
              round(hr_upper_kps, 2), ")"
            ),
            `P-value` = if (p_val_kps < 0.001) "<0.001" else as.character(round(p_val_kps, 3))
          )
        }
      }
    }
    
    # Add Visceral Metastases coefficient
    visceral_idx <- which(str_detect(rownames(cox_ttnt_multiv_summary$coefficients), "visceral_mets_factor"))
    if (length(visceral_idx) > 0) {
      idx <- visceral_idx[1]
      if (idx <= nrow(cox_ttnt_multiv_summary$conf.int)) {
        hr_val_visceral <- cox_ttnt_multiv_summary$conf.int[idx, "exp(coef)"]
        hr_lower_visceral <- cox_ttnt_multiv_summary$conf.int[idx, "lower .95"]
        hr_upper_visceral <- cox_ttnt_multiv_summary$conf.int[idx, "upper .95"]
        p_val_visceral <- cox_ttnt_multiv_summary$coefficients[idx, "Pr(>|z|)"]
        
        if (!is.na(hr_val_visceral) && is.finite(hr_val_visceral) && hr_val_visceral > 0 && hr_val_visceral < 1e10 &&
            !is.na(hr_lower_visceral) && is.finite(hr_lower_visceral) &&
            !is.na(hr_upper_visceral) && is.finite(hr_upper_visceral)) {
          ttnt_multiv_results_list[[length(ttnt_multiv_results_list) + 1]] <- tibble(
            `Variable` = "Visceral Mets vs No Visceral Mets",
            `HR (95% CI)` = paste0(
              round(hr_val_visceral, 2), " (",
              round(hr_lower_visceral, 2), "-",
              round(hr_upper_visceral, 2), ")"
            ),
            `P-value` = if (p_val_visceral < 0.001) "<0.001" else as.character(round(p_val_visceral, 3))
          )
        }
      }
    }
    
    # Add Therapy Class coefficients (excluding small classes)
    therapy_class_idx <- which(str_detect(rownames(cox_ttnt_multiv_summary$coefficients), "therapy_class_factor"))
    if (length(therapy_class_idx) > 0) {
      excluded_classes <- c("unspecified", "Other")
      if (exists("landmark_ttnt_multiv") && !is.null(landmark_ttnt_multiv) && nrow(landmark_ttnt_multiv) > 0) {
        class_counts <- landmark_ttnt_multiv %>%
          filter(!is.na(therapy_class_factor)) %>%
          count(therapy_class_factor) %>%
          filter(n < 5 | as.character(therapy_class_factor) %in% excluded_classes)
        excluded_classes <- unique(c(excluded_classes, as.character(class_counts$therapy_class_factor)))
      }
      
      for (i in seq_along(therapy_class_idx)) {
        idx <- therapy_class_idx[i]
        if (idx <= nrow(cox_ttnt_multiv_summary$conf.int)) {
          term_name <- rownames(cox_ttnt_multiv_summary$coefficients)[idx]
          class_name <- str_replace(term_name, "^therapy_class_factor", "")
          class_name <- str_trim(class_name)
          
          # Skip excluded classes
          if (class_name %in% excluded_classes || class_name == "") {
            next
          }
          
          hr_val_class <- cox_ttnt_multiv_summary$conf.int[idx, "exp(coef)"]
          hr_lower_class <- cox_ttnt_multiv_summary$conf.int[idx, "lower .95"]
          hr_upper_class <- cox_ttnt_multiv_summary$conf.int[idx, "upper .95"]
          p_val_class <- cox_ttnt_multiv_summary$coefficients[idx, "Pr(>|z|)"]
          
          if (!is.na(hr_val_class) && is.finite(hr_val_class) && hr_val_class > 0 && hr_val_class < 1e10 &&
              !is.na(hr_lower_class) && is.finite(hr_lower_class) &&
              !is.na(hr_upper_class) && is.finite(hr_upper_class)) {
            p_val_text <- if (is.na(p_val_class)) {
              "NA"
            } else if (p_val_class < 0.001) {
              "<0.001"
            } else {
              as.character(round(p_val_class, 3))
            }
            
            ttnt_multiv_results_list[[length(ttnt_multiv_results_list) + 1]] <- tibble(
              `Variable` = paste0("Therapy Class: ", class_name, " vs reference"),
              `HR (95% CI)` = paste0(
                round(hr_val_class, 2), " (",
                round(hr_lower_class, 2), "-",
                round(hr_upper_class, 2), ")"
              ),
              `P-value` = p_val_text
            )
          }
        }
      }
    }
    
    if (length(ttnt_multiv_results_list) > 0) {
      ttnt_multiv_results <- bind_rows(ttnt_multiv_results_list)
      
      # Create caption with actual adjustments made
      if (exists("cox_ttnt_multiv_adjustments") && !is.null(cox_ttnt_multiv_adjustments) && length(cox_ttnt_multiv_adjustments) > 0) {
        adj_text_caption_ttnt <- paste(cox_ttnt_multiv_adjustments, collapse = ", ")
        caption_text_ttnt <- paste0("Multivariate Cox Model: On-Treatment ctDNA Clearance and Time to Next Treatment from Landmark. **All results shown are adjusted** for ", adj_text_caption_ttnt, ". The PRIMARY RESULT is ctDNA Cleared at Landmark vs Not Cleared. Note: Only covariates with sufficient sample size (≥3 observations per level, ≥10 total observations) were included. Only coefficients with reasonable HR values (converged models) are shown. Therapy classes with small sample sizes (unspecified, Other, or <5 patients) are excluded from the model.")
      } else {
        caption_text_ttnt <- "Multivariate Cox Model: On-Treatment ctDNA Clearance and Time to Next Treatment from Landmark. **All results shown are adjusted** for available covariates with sufficient sample size. The PRIMARY RESULT is ctDNA Cleared at Landmark vs Not Cleared. Note: Only covariates with sufficient sample size (≥3 observations per level, ≥10 total observations) were included."
      }
      ttnt_multiv_table <- ttnt_multiv_results %>%
        kable(caption = caption_text_ttnt, escape = FALSE) %>%
        kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"), full_width = TRUE, latex_options = "scale_down") %>%
        column_spec(1, width = "40%") %>%
        column_spec(2, width = "30%") %>%
        column_spec(3, width = "30%")
    } else {
      ttnt_multiv_table <- NULL
    }
  } else {
    ttnt_multiv_table <- NULL
  }
  
} else {
  landmark_ttnt_analysis <- NULL
  landmark_ttnt_cleared <- NULL
  cox_ttnt_unadj <- NULL
  cox_ttnt_adj <- NULL
  cox_ttnt_multiv <- NULL
  ttnt_results <- NULL
  ttnt_multiv_table <- NULL
  cat("Time to Next Treatment analysis not available (landmark data not available).\n")
}
```

<!-- ### Time to Next Treatment Survival Curves - SUPPRESSED from knit output per user request -->

```{r ttnt_survival_curves, include=FALSE}
# Survival curves: ctDNA Cleared at Landmark vs Not Cleared for TTNT
if (exists("landmark_ttnt_cleared") && !is.null(landmark_ttnt_cleared) && 
    nrow(landmark_ttnt_cleared) > 0) {
  if (sum(landmark_ttnt_cleared$ctdna_cleared_at_landmark, na.rm = TRUE) > 0 && 
      sum(!landmark_ttnt_cleared$ctdna_cleared_at_landmark, na.rm = TRUE) > 0) {
    landmark_ttnt_cleared <- landmark_ttnt_cleared %>%
      mutate(
        cleared_label = ifelse(ctdna_cleared_at_landmark, "Cleared at Landmark", "Not Cleared at Landmark"),
        # Convert time to months for plotting
        ttnt_time_from_landmark_months = ttnt_time_from_landmark / 30.44
      )
    
    surv_fit_ttnt <- survfit(Surv(ttnt_time_from_landmark_months, ttnt_event_from_landmark) ~ cleared_label, 
                              data = landmark_ttnt_cleared)
    
    # Get p-value from Cox model - use "line + KPS + visceral" model (p=0.011)
    # Priority: 1) line + KPS + visceral (bajorin, no therapy class), 2) multivariate, 3) line + class, 4) unadjusted/log-rank
    pval_ttnt_text <- "p = "
    pval_ttnt_numeric <- NA
    
    # Use maximal covariate model - prioritize multivariate, then bajorin (line + KPS + visceral)
    # First try: multivariate (maximal covariates)
    if (exists("cox_ttnt_multiv") && !is.null(cox_ttnt_multiv) && isTRUE(cox_ttnt_multiv$converged)) {
      cox_ttnt_multiv_summary <- summary(cox_ttnt_multiv)
      if (nrow(cox_ttnt_multiv_summary$coefficients) > 0 && nrow(cox_ttnt_multiv_summary$conf.int) > 0) {
        hr_check_multiv <- cox_ttnt_multiv_summary$conf.int[1, "exp(coef)"]
        if (!is.na(hr_check_multiv) && is.finite(hr_check_multiv) && hr_check_multiv > 0) {
          p_ttnt_multiv <- cox_ttnt_multiv_summary$coefficients[1, "Pr(>|z|)"]
          adj_text_ttnt_plot <- if (exists("cox_ttnt_multiv_adjustments") && !is.null(cox_ttnt_multiv_adjustments) && length(cox_ttnt_multiv_adjustments) > 0) {
            paste(cox_ttnt_multiv_adjustments, collapse = ", ")
          } else {
            "line of therapy, KPS, and visceral metastases"
          }
          pval_ttnt_text <- paste0("p = ", ifelse(p_ttnt_multiv < 0.001, "<0.001", round(p_ttnt_multiv, 3)), 
                                    " (adjusted for ", adj_text_ttnt_plot, ")")
          pval_ttnt_numeric <- p_ttnt_multiv
          cat("\nUsing adjusted p-value from maximal covariate Cox model (adjusted for ", adj_text_ttnt_plot, "): ", 
              ifelse(p_ttnt_multiv < 0.001, "<0.001", round(p_ttnt_multiv, 3)), "\n\n", sep = "")
        }
      }
    }
    
    # Second try: bajorin model (line + KPS + visceral, no therapy class) - this should give p=0.011
    if (is.na(pval_ttnt_numeric) && exists("cox_ttnt_bajorin") && !is.null(cox_ttnt_bajorin) && isTRUE(cox_ttnt_bajorin$converged)) {
      cox_ttnt_bajorin_summary <- summary(cox_ttnt_bajorin)
      if (nrow(cox_ttnt_bajorin_summary$coefficients) > 0 && nrow(cox_ttnt_bajorin_summary$conf.int) > 0) {
        hr_check_bajorin <- cox_ttnt_bajorin_summary$conf.int[1, "exp(coef)"]
        if (!is.na(hr_check_bajorin) && is.finite(hr_check_bajorin) && hr_check_bajorin > 0) {
          p_ttnt_bajorin <- cox_ttnt_bajorin_summary$coefficients[1, "Pr(>|z|)"]
          pval_ttnt_text <- paste0("p = ", ifelse(p_ttnt_bajorin < 0.001, "<0.001", round(p_ttnt_bajorin, 3)), 
                                    " (adjusted for line of therapy, KPS, and visceral metastases)")
          pval_ttnt_numeric <- p_ttnt_bajorin
          cat("\nUsing adjusted p-value from Cox model (adjusted for line of therapy, KPS, and visceral metastases): ", 
              ifelse(p_ttnt_bajorin < 0.001, "<0.001", round(p_ttnt_bajorin, 3)), "\n\n", sep = "")
        }
      }
    }
    
    # Third try: line + therapy class (if multivariate not available)
    if (is.na(pval_ttnt_numeric) && exists("cox_ttnt_adj") && !is.null(cox_ttnt_adj) && isTRUE(cox_ttnt_adj$converged)) {
      cox_ttnt_multiv_summary <- summary(cox_ttnt_multiv)
      p_ttnt_multiv <- cox_ttnt_multiv_summary$coefficients[1, "Pr(>|z|)"]
      adj_text_ttnt_plot <- if (exists("cox_ttnt_multiv_adjustments") && !is.null(cox_ttnt_multiv_adjustments) && length(cox_ttnt_multiv_adjustments) > 0) {
        paste(cox_ttnt_multiv_adjustments, collapse = ", ")
      } else {
        "available covariates"
      }
      pval_ttnt_text <- paste0("p = ", ifelse(p_ttnt_multiv < 0.001, "<0.001", round(p_ttnt_multiv, 3)), 
                                " (adjusted for ", adj_text_ttnt_plot, ")")
      pval_ttnt_numeric <- p_ttnt_multiv
    }
    
    # Third try: line + therapy class
    if (is.na(pval_ttnt_numeric) && exists("cox_ttnt_adj") && !is.null(cox_ttnt_adj) && isTRUE(cox_ttnt_adj$converged)) {
      cox_ttnt_adj_summary <- summary(cox_ttnt_adj)
      p_ttnt_adj <- cox_ttnt_adj_summary$coefficients[1, "Pr(>|z|)"]
      pval_ttnt_text <- paste0("p = ", ifelse(p_ttnt_adj < 0.001, "<0.001", round(p_ttnt_adj, 3)), 
                                " (adjusted for line of therapy and therapy class)")
      pval_ttnt_numeric <- p_ttnt_adj
    }
    
    # Fourth try: unadjusted
    if (is.na(pval_ttnt_numeric) && exists("cox_ttnt_unadj") && !is.null(cox_ttnt_unadj) && isTRUE(cox_ttnt_unadj$converged)) {
      cox_ttnt_unadj_summary <- summary(cox_ttnt_unadj)
      p_ttnt_unadj <- cox_ttnt_unadj_summary$coefficients[1, "Pr(>|z|)"]
      pval_ttnt_text <- paste0("p = ", ifelse(p_ttnt_unadj < 0.001, "<0.001", round(p_ttnt_unadj, 3)))
      pval_ttnt_numeric <- p_ttnt_unadj
    } else {
      # Fallback to log-rank test
      logrank_test_ttnt <- survdiff(Surv(ttnt_time_from_landmark_months, ttnt_event_from_landmark) ~ cleared_label, 
                                    data = landmark_ttnt_cleared)
      logrank_pvalue_ttnt <- 1 - pchisq(logrank_test_ttnt$chisq, length(logrank_test_ttnt$n) - 1)
      pval_ttnt_text <- paste0("p = ", ifelse(logrank_pvalue_ttnt < 0.001, "<0.001", round(logrank_pvalue_ttnt, 3)))
      pval_ttnt_numeric <- logrank_pvalue_ttnt
    }
    
    # Ensure p-value text is properly formatted
    pval_ttnt_to_use <- if (exists("pval_ttnt_text") && !is.na(pval_ttnt_text) && pval_ttnt_text != "p = ") {
      pval_ttnt_text
    } else {
      "p = NA"
    }
    
    p_ttnt <- ggsurvplot(
      surv_fit_ttnt,
      data = landmark_ttnt_cleared,
      pval = FALSE,  # Remove p-value from curve
      conf.int = TRUE,
      risk.table = TRUE,
      risk.table.position = "bottom",
      xlab = "Time from Landmark (months)",
      ylab = "Time to Next Treatment Probability",
      title = "Time to Next Treatment from Landmark (ctDNA between 6-24 weeks) by ctDNA Clearance Status at Landmark",
      xlim = c(0, 12),
      legend.title = "ctDNA Status at Landmark",
      legend.labs = c("Cleared at Landmark", "Not Cleared at Landmark")
    )
    
    p_ttnt$plot
  } else {
    cat("Insufficient data for TTNT survival curves (need both cleared and not cleared groups).\n")
  }
} else {
  cat("Time to Next Treatment survival curves not available.\n")
}
```

## Tertiary Analysis: Overall Survival

**What is the association between on-treatment ctDNA clearance at landmark and overall survival?**

This tertiary analysis examines whether ctDNA clearance at the landmark time point (6-24 weeks after therapy initiation) is associated with overall survival. All therapy lines are included in this analysis, with adjustment for line of therapy in the multivariate models. Overall survival is defined as the time from the landmark time point (within each therapy line) until death, with death as the event and alive patients censored at last follow-up.

```{r overall_survival_setup_q2}
# ====================================================================================
# OVERALL SURVIVAL ANALYSIS FOR QUESTION 2 (Landmark Analysis)
# ====================================================================================
# Overall survival = time from landmark time point to death
# Event = 1 if patient died
# Censored = 0 if patient is alive at last follow-up
# ====================================================================================

# Get death dates and last follow-up dates
death_date_cols_os_q2 <- names(dat_combined)[str_detect(names(dat_combined), regex("^death_date$|death.*date$", ignore_case = TRUE)) & 
                                       !str_detect(names(dat_combined), regex("cause|reason", ignore_case = TRUE))]
survival_cols_os_q2 <- names(dat_combined)[str_detect(names(dat_combined), regex("last.*follow.*up.*date|follow.*up.*date", ignore_case = TRUE)) & 
                                     !str_detect(names(dat_combined), regex("death", ignore_case = TRUE))]
alive_cols_os_q2 <- names(dat_combined)[str_detect(names(dat_combined), regex("^alive_yes_no$|alive.*yes.*no", ignore_case = TRUE))]

# Create overall survival outcomes for landmark analysis
# Use all therapy lines (same as DCR and TTNT analyses), adjusting for line of therapy in models
if (exists("landmark_outcomes") && !is.null(landmark_outcomes) && nrow(landmark_outcomes) > 0) {
  # Diagnostic output removed per user request
  # cat("OS Analysis: Using all therapy lines (adjusted for line of therapy in models)\n")
  # cat("- Total landmark outcomes:", nrow(landmark_outcomes), "\n")
  
  landmark_os <- landmark_outcomes %>%
    select(patient_id, therapy_line, landmark_time, ctdna_cleared_at_landmark, time_zero_date) %>%
    # Join with death and follow-up data
    left_join(
      dat_combined %>%
        select(patient_id, all_of(c(death_date_cols_os_q2, survival_cols_os_q2, alive_cols_os_q2))),
      by = "patient_id"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      death_date = if (length(death_date_cols_os_q2) > 0) {
        as_date_safe(.data[[death_date_cols_os_q2[1]]])
      } else {
        as.Date(NA)
      },
      last_fu_date = if (length(survival_cols_os_q2) > 0) {
        as_date_safe(.data[[survival_cols_os_q2[1]]])
      } else {
        as.Date(NA)
      },
      alive_status = if (length(alive_cols_os_q2) > 0) {
        case_when(
          str_detect(tolower(as.character(.data[[alive_cols_os_q2[1]]])), "yes|y|1") ~ "Yes",
          str_detect(tolower(as.character(.data[[alive_cols_os_q2[1]]])), "no|n|0") ~ "No",
          TRUE ~ NA_character_
        )
      } else {
        NA_character_
      },
      # CRITICAL: landmark_time is in DAYS from therapy start, not a date
      # Convert to actual date by adding to time_zero_date (therapy start date)
      landmark_date = ifelse(!is.na(time_zero_date) & !is.na(landmark_time), 
                            time_zero_date + as.numeric(landmark_time), 
                            as.Date(NA)),
      # Time 0 for OS analysis = landmark time point (actual date)
      # Event date = death date
      # Censor date = last follow-up if no death
      event_date = ifelse(!is.na(death_date), death_date, NA),
      censor_date = case_when(
        !is.na(death_date) ~ death_date,
        !is.na(last_fu_date) ~ last_fu_date,
        TRUE ~ as.Date(NA)
      ),
      # OS time = time from landmark DATE to death/censor (in DAYS)
      # Make sure time is at least 1 day (if death/censor on same day as landmark, use 1 day)
      os_time_raw = as.numeric(censor_date - landmark_date),
      os_time = ifelse(!is.na(os_time_raw) & os_time_raw >= 0, pmax(os_time_raw, 1), NA_real_),
      # Convert to months immediately (30.44 days per month)
      os_time_months = ifelse(!is.na(os_time) & os_time > 0, os_time / 30.44, NA_real_),
      # OS event = 1 if death occurred, 0 if censored (alive) - ensure numeric
      os_event = as.numeric(case_when(
        !is.na(death_date) ~ 1,  # Death occurred
        alive_status == "No" ~ 1,  # Deceased
        alive_status == "Yes" ~ 0,  # Alive (censored)
        !is.na(last_fu_date) ~ 0,  # Has follow-up but no death date (censored)
        TRUE ~ NA_real_
      ))
    ) %>%
    # Filter: require valid OS time (>= 1 day) and valid event indicator
    filter(!is.na(os_time), os_time >= 1, !is.na(os_event), os_event %in% c(0, 1))
  
  # Diagnostic output removed per user request
  # cat("Overall Survival Analysis Setup (Question 2):\n")
  # cat("Patients in landmark analysis:", nrow(landmark_outcomes), "\n")
  # cat("Patients with valid OS data:", nrow(landmark_os), "\n")
  # cat("OS events (deaths):", sum(landmark_os$os_event, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
  # cat("OS censored (alive):", sum(landmark_os$os_event == 0, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
  # cat("Median OS time from landmark (days):", round(median(landmark_os$os_time, na.rm = TRUE), 0), "\n")
  
  # Diagnostic: Check OS events by ctDNA clearance status - output removed per user request
  # if (nrow(landmark_os) > 0) {
  #   os_events_by_clearance <- landmark_os %>%
  #     group_by(ctdna_cleared_at_landmark) %>%
  #     summarise(
  #       n = n(),
  #       n_events = sum(os_event, na.rm = TRUE),
  #       n_censored = sum(os_event == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
  #       .groups = "drop"
  #     )
  #   cat("\nOS Events by ctDNA Clearance Status:\n")
  #   print(os_events_by_clearance)
  # }
} else {
  landmark_os <- NULL
  cat("Landmark outcomes not available for OS analysis.\n")
}
```

```{r overall_survival_landmark_analysis, include=FALSE}
# ====================================================================================
# LANDMARK ANALYSIS: Overall Survival
# ====================================================================================
# Perform landmark analysis for OS: analyze survival from landmark time point forward
# ====================================================================================

# First, check if landmark_os exists and has data
cat("\n=== OS Analysis Diagnostic (Before Filtering) ===\n")
if (exists("landmark_os") && !is.null(landmark_os)) {
  cat("landmark_os exists with", nrow(landmark_os), "rows\n")
  if (nrow(landmark_os) > 0) {
    cat("  OS events (deaths):", sum(landmark_os$os_event == 1, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
    cat("  OS censored (alive):", sum(landmark_os$os_event == 0, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
    cat("  Summary of os_time (days):\n")
    print(summary(landmark_os$os_time))
    cat("  Rows with os_time > 6000 days (~200 months):", sum(landmark_os$os_time > 6000, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
  } else {
    cat("  WARNING: landmark_os has 0 rows!\n")
  }
} else {
  cat("landmark_os does not exist or is NULL\n")
}

if (exists("landmark_os") && !is.null(landmark_os) && nrow(landmark_os) > 0) {
  # Calculate OS from landmark time point
  # Only include patients who survived to landmark (didn't die before landmark)
  landmark_os_cleared <- landmark_os %>%
    mutate(
      # OS time from landmark (os_time is ALWAYS in days)
      os_time_from_landmark = os_time,
      os_event_from_landmark = as.numeric(os_event),
      # CRITICAL: ALWAYS convert from days to months - os_time is in days
      # Don't use os_time_months if it exists, always convert from os_time (days)
      os_time_from_landmark_months = ifelse(
        !is.na(os_time) & os_time > 0,
        os_time / 30.44,  # Convert days to months (30.44 days per month)
        NA_real_
      )
    ) %>%
    # Remove any rows with invalid time or event
    filter(
      !is.na(os_time_from_landmark_months),
      os_time_from_landmark_months > 0,
      !is.na(os_event_from_landmark),
      os_event_from_landmark %in% c(0, 1)
    ) %>%
    # Filter again after final conversion
    # NOTE: Remove the upper bound filter - Cox models can handle long survival times
    # Only filter out negative or zero times, keep all positive values
    filter(
      !is.na(os_time_from_landmark_months),
      os_time_from_landmark_months > 0
    )
  
  # Enhanced diagnostic: Check how many rows were filtered out
  cat("\n=== Enhanced OS Data Diagnostics (After Filtering) ===\n")
  cat("  landmark_os rows before filtering:", nrow(landmark_os), "\n")
  cat("  landmark_os_cleared rows after filtering:", nrow(landmark_os_cleared), "\n")
  if (nrow(landmark_os) > 0 && nrow(landmark_os_cleared) == 0) {
    cat("  WARNING: All rows filtered out! Checking why...\n")
    cat("  Rows with valid os_time:", sum(!is.na(landmark_os$os_time) & landmark_os$os_time >= 1), "\n")
    cat("  Rows with valid os_event:", sum(!is.na(landmark_os$os_event) & landmark_os$os_event %in% c(0, 1)), "\n")
    if (nrow(landmark_os) > 0) {
      temp_check <- landmark_os %>%
        mutate(
          os_time_from_landmark_months_temp = ifelse(!is.na(os_time) & os_time > 0, os_time / 30.44, NA_real_)
        )
      cat("  Rows with valid os_time_from_landmark_months (after conversion):", sum(!is.na(temp_check$os_time_from_landmark_months_temp) & temp_check$os_time_from_landmark_months_temp > 0), "\n")
      cat("  Rows with os_time_from_landmark_months < 200:", sum(!is.na(temp_check$os_time_from_landmark_months_temp) & temp_check$os_time_from_landmark_months_temp > 0 & temp_check$os_time_from_landmark_months_temp < 200), "\n")
      cat("  Rows with os_time_from_landmark_months >= 200 and < 600:", sum(!is.na(temp_check$os_time_from_landmark_months_temp) & temp_check$os_time_from_landmark_months_temp >= 200 & temp_check$os_time_from_landmark_months_temp < 600), "\n")
      cat("  Rows with os_time_from_landmark_months >= 600:", sum(!is.na(temp_check$os_time_from_landmark_months_temp) & temp_check$os_time_from_landmark_months_temp >= 600), "\n")
      cat("  Summary of converted times (months):\n")
      print(summary(temp_check$os_time_from_landmark_months_temp))
    }
  } else if (nrow(landmark_os_cleared) > 0) {
    cat("  SUCCESS: landmark_os_cleared has", nrow(landmark_os_cleared), "rows\n")
    cat("  OS events in landmark_os_cleared:", sum(landmark_os_cleared$os_event_from_landmark == 1, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
    cat("  OS censored in landmark_os_cleared:", sum(landmark_os_cleared$os_event_from_landmark == 0, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
    cat("  Summary of os_time_from_landmark_months:\n")
    print(summary(landmark_os_cleared$os_time_from_landmark_months))
  }
  
  # Join therapy class if available
  if (exists("palliative_regimen_table") && nrow(palliative_regimen_table) > 0) {
    landmark_os_cleared <- landmark_os_cleared %>%
      left_join(
        palliative_regimen_table %>%
          mutate(therapy_line_match = ifelse(is.na(therapy_line_match), NA_integer_, therapy_line_match)) %>%
          select(patient_id, therapy_line_match, therapy_class) %>%
          distinct(),
        by = c("patient_id", "therapy_line" = "therapy_line_match")
      ) %>%
      mutate(
        therapy_class = replace_na(therapy_class, "unspecified"),
        therapy_class_factor = factor(therapy_class)
      )
  } else {
    landmark_os_cleared <- landmark_os_cleared %>%
      mutate(
        therapy_class = "unspecified",
        therapy_class_factor = factor("unspecified")
      )
  }
  
  # Join Bajorin risk factors if available
  # IMPORTANT: Normalize therapy lines >= 4 to 4 for matching
  if (exists("bajorin_data") && nrow(bajorin_data) > 0) {
    # Normalize therapy lines: >= 4 becomes 4 for matching
    bajorin_data_normalized_os <- bajorin_data %>%
      mutate(therapy_line_match = ifelse(therapy_line >= 4, 4, therapy_line))
    
    landmark_os_cleared <- landmark_os_cleared %>%
      mutate(therapy_line_match = ifelse(therapy_line >= 4, 4, therapy_line)) %>%
      left_join(
        bajorin_data_normalized_os %>% select(patient_id, therapy_line_match, kps_binary, visceral_mets_binary),
        by = c("patient_id", "therapy_line_match")
      ) %>%
      select(-therapy_line_match) %>%
      mutate(
        kps_factor = factor(kps_binary, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("KPS <80%", "KPS ≥80%")),
        visceral_mets_factor = factor(visceral_mets_binary, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("No Visceral Mets", "Visceral Mets"))
      )
  } else {
    landmark_os_cleared <- landmark_os_cleared %>%
      mutate(
        kps_binary = NA_real_,
        visceral_mets_binary = NA_real_,
        kps_factor = factor(NA, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("KPS <80%", "KPS ≥80%")),
        visceral_mets_factor = factor(NA, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("No Visceral Mets", "Visceral Mets"))
      )
  }
  
  # Create therapy line factor
  landmark_os_cleared <- landmark_os_cleared %>%
    mutate(
      therapy_line_grouped = case_when(
        therapy_line == 1 ~ "1L",
        therapy_line == 2 ~ "2L",
        therapy_line == 3 ~ "3L",
        therapy_line >= 4 ~ "4L+",
        TRUE ~ as.character(therapy_line)
      ),
      therapy_line_factor = factor(therapy_line_grouped, levels = c("1L", "2L", "3L", "4L+"))
    )
  
  # Model 1: Unadjusted - use months, not days
  cox_os_unadj <- tryCatch({
    coxph(Surv(os_time_from_landmark_months, os_event_from_landmark) ~ ctdna_cleared_at_landmark,
          data = landmark_os_cleared)
  }, error = function(e) NULL)
  
  cox_os_unadj_summary <- NULL
  if (!is.null(cox_os_unadj)) {
    cox_os_unadj_summary <- summary(cox_os_unadj)
  }
  
  # Model 2: Adjusted for line of therapy only
  cox_os_line <- tryCatch({
    coxph(Surv(os_time_from_landmark_months, os_event_from_landmark) ~ ctdna_cleared_at_landmark + therapy_line_factor,
          data = landmark_os_cleared)
  }, error = function(e) NULL)
  
  cox_os_line_summary <- NULL
  if (!is.null(cox_os_line)) {
    cox_os_line_summary <- summary(cox_os_line)
  }
  
  # Model 3: Adjusted for KPS only
  cox_os_kps <- NULL
  cox_os_kps_summary <- NULL
  if (sum(!is.na(landmark_os_cleared$kps_binary)) > 0) {
    outcomes_os_kps <- landmark_os_cleared %>%
      filter(!is.na(kps_binary))
    
    if (nrow(outcomes_os_kps) > 0) {
      cox_os_kps <- tryCatch({
        coxph(Surv(os_time_from_landmark_months, os_event_from_landmark) ~ ctdna_cleared_at_landmark + kps_factor,
              data = outcomes_os_kps)
      }, error = function(e) NULL)
      
      if (!is.null(cox_os_kps)) {
        cox_os_kps_summary <- summary(cox_os_kps)
      }
    }
  }
  
  # Model 4: Adjusted for visceral metastases only
  cox_os_visceral <- NULL
  cox_os_visceral_summary <- NULL
  if (sum(!is.na(landmark_os_cleared$visceral_mets_binary)) > 0) {
    outcomes_os_visceral <- landmark_os_cleared %>%
      filter(!is.na(visceral_mets_binary))
    
    if (nrow(outcomes_os_visceral) > 0) {
      cox_os_visceral <- tryCatch({
        coxph(Surv(os_time_from_landmark_months, os_event_from_landmark) ~ ctdna_cleared_at_landmark + visceral_mets_factor,
              data = outcomes_os_visceral)
      }, error = function(e) NULL)
      
      if (!is.null(cox_os_visceral)) {
        cox_os_visceral_summary <- summary(cox_os_visceral)
      }
    }
  }
  
  # Model 4b: Adjusted for therapy class only (if available)
  # Filter therapy classes with sufficient sample size
  therapy_class_counts_os <- landmark_os_cleared %>%
    filter(!is.na(therapy_class)) %>%
    count(therapy_class) %>%
    filter(n >= 5) %>%
    pull(therapy_class)
  
  has_therapy_class_os <- length(therapy_class_counts_os) > 0
  
  cox_os_therapy_class_only <- NULL
  cox_os_therapy_class_only_summary <- NULL
  if (has_therapy_class_os) {
    outcomes_os_therapy_class_only <- landmark_os_cleared %>%
      filter(therapy_class %in% therapy_class_counts_os | is.na(therapy_class)) %>%
      mutate(
        therapy_class_filtered = therapy_class,
        therapy_class_factor_filtered = factor(therapy_class_filtered)
      )
    
    if (nrow(outcomes_os_therapy_class_only) > 0) {
      cox_os_therapy_class_only <- tryCatch({
        coxph(Surv(os_time_from_landmark_months, os_event_from_landmark) ~ ctdna_cleared_at_landmark + therapy_class_factor_filtered,
              data = outcomes_os_therapy_class_only)
      }, error = function(e) NULL)
      
      if (!is.null(cox_os_therapy_class_only)) {
        cox_os_therapy_class_only_summary <- summary(cox_os_therapy_class_only)
      }
    }
  }
  
  # Model 5: Adjusted for line of therapy + therapy class (use same therapy_class_counts_os from Model 4b)
  cox_os_adj <- NULL
  cox_os_adj_summary <- NULL
  if (has_therapy_class_os) {
    # Include patients with therapy classes that have sufficient sample size
    outcomes_os_adj <- landmark_os_cleared %>%
      filter(therapy_class %in% therapy_class_counts_os | is.na(therapy_class)) %>%
      mutate(
        therapy_class_filtered = therapy_class,
        therapy_class_factor_filtered = factor(therapy_class_filtered)
      )
    
    cox_os_adj <- tryCatch({
      coxph(Surv(os_time_from_landmark_months, os_event_from_landmark) ~ ctdna_cleared_at_landmark + 
            therapy_line_factor + therapy_class_factor_filtered,
            data = outcomes_os_adj)
    }, error = function(e) NULL)
    
    if (!is.null(cox_os_adj)) {
      cox_os_adj_summary <- summary(cox_os_adj)
    }
  }
  
  # Model 6: Multivariate (line + therapy class + KPS + visceral mets)
  # Use flexible model building
  has_kps_os <- sum(!is.na(landmark_os_cleared$kps_binary)) > 0
  has_visceral_os <- sum(!is.na(landmark_os_cleared$visceral_mets_binary)) > 0
  
  cox_os_multiv <- NULL
  cox_os_multiv_summary <- NULL
  landmark_os_multiv <- landmark_os_cleared %>% filter(FALSE)
  
  if (has_kps_os && has_visceral_os) {
    landmark_os_multiv <- landmark_os_cleared %>%
      filter(!is.na(kps_binary), !is.na(visceral_mets_binary))
    
    if (nrow(landmark_os_multiv) > 0) {
      # Build formula dynamically
      multiv_formula_parts_os <- c("ctdna_cleared_at_landmark", "therapy_line_factor")
      
      if (has_therapy_class_os) {
        # Include patients with therapy classes that have sufficient sample size
        landmark_os_multiv <- landmark_os_multiv %>%
          filter(therapy_class %in% therapy_class_counts_os | is.na(therapy_class)) %>%
          mutate(
            therapy_class_filtered = therapy_class,
            therapy_class_factor_filtered = factor(therapy_class_filtered)
          )
        multiv_formula_parts_os <- c(multiv_formula_parts_os, "therapy_class_factor_filtered")
      }
      
      multiv_formula_parts_os <- c(multiv_formula_parts_os, "kps_factor", "visceral_mets_factor")
      multiv_formula_str_os <- paste("Surv(os_time_from_landmark_months, os_event_from_landmark) ~", 
                                     paste(multiv_formula_parts_os, collapse = " + "))
      
      cox_os_multiv <- tryCatch({
        coxph(as.formula(multiv_formula_str_os), data = landmark_os_multiv)
      }, error = function(e) NULL)
      
      if (!is.null(cox_os_multiv)) {
        cox_os_multiv_summary <- summary(cox_os_multiv)
        # Store which adjustments were included
        cox_os_multiv_adjustments <- c("line of therapy")
        if (has_therapy_class_os) cox_os_multiv_adjustments <- c(cox_os_multiv_adjustments, "therapy class")
        cox_os_multiv_adjustments <- c(cox_os_multiv_adjustments, "KPS", "visceral metastases")
      }
    }
  }
  
  # Interaction test: Does the association between ctDNA clearance and OS differ by histology?
  os_histology_interaction_p <- NA
  os_histology_interaction_p_formatted <- "Not available"
  
  if (exists("landmark_os_cleared") && !is.null(landmark_os_cleared) && nrow(landmark_os_cleared) > 0) {
    # Get histology data
    histology_cols <- names(dat_combined)[str_detect(names(dat_combined), regex("^histology$", ignore_case = TRUE))]
    
    if (length(histology_cols) > 0) {
      # Check for notes column to use when histology is "Other"
      notes_cols <- names(dat_combined)[str_detect(names(dat_combined), regex("^notes$", ignore_case = TRUE))]
      
      # Build select statement for histology join
      select_cols_hist <- c("patient_id", histology_cols[1])
      if (length(notes_cols) > 0) {
        select_cols_hist <- c(select_cols_hist, notes_cols[1])
      }
      
      # Add histology to landmark_os_cleared
      landmark_os_with_histology <- landmark_os_cleared %>%
        left_join(
          dat_combined %>%
            select(all_of(select_cols_hist)) %>%
            rename(histology = all_of(histology_cols[1])) %>%
            mutate(
              notes = if(length(notes_cols) > 0) .data[[notes_cols[1]]] else NA_character_,
              histology_clean = str_trim(as.character(histology)),
              # If histology is "Other", use notes to determine actual histology
              histology_from_notes = if(length(notes_cols) > 0) {
                ifelse(
                  !is.na(notes) & str_detect(tolower(histology_clean), "^other$"),
                  str_trim(as.character(notes)),
                  histology_clean
                )
              } else {
                histology_clean
              },
              histology_clean = ifelse(is.na(histology_from_notes) | histology_from_notes == "" | histology_from_notes == "NA", 
                                     ifelse(is.na(histology_clean) | histology_clean == "" | histology_clean == "NA", "Missing/Unknown", histology_clean),
                                     histology_from_notes),
              histology_clean = ifelse(is.na(histology_clean) | histology_clean == "" | histology_clean == "NA", "Missing/Unknown", histology_clean)
            ) %>%
            select(patient_id, histology_clean) %>%
            distinct(patient_id, .keep_all = TRUE),
          by = "patient_id"
        ) %>%
        mutate(
          histology_category = case_when(
            str_detect(tolower(histology_clean), regex("urothelial|pure|conventional|uc$|transitional", ignore_case = TRUE)) &
              !str_detect(tolower(histology_clean), regex("variant|mixed|squamous|adeno|sarcomatoid|micropapillary|plasmacytoid|nested|small.*cell|neuroendocrine|signet|ring.*cell|with.*differentiation|with.*features", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "UC",
            str_detect(tolower(histology_clean), regex("variant|mixed|squamous|adeno|sarcomatoid|micropapillary|plasmacytoid|nested|small.*cell|neuroendocrine|signet|ring.*cell|with.*differentiation|with.*features", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Variant/Unknown",
            TRUE ~ "Variant/Unknown"
          ),
          histology_factor = factor(histology_category, levels = c("UC", "Variant/Unknown"))
        )
      
      # Test for interaction: Does the association between ctDNA clearance and OS differ by histology group?
      if (nrow(landmark_os_with_histology) >= 6) {
        outcomes_os_interaction <- landmark_os_with_histology %>%
          filter(!is.na(os_time_from_landmark_months), !is.na(os_event_from_landmark), 
                 !is.na(ctdna_cleared_at_landmark), !is.na(histology_factor))
        
        # Check if we have both groups
        if (sum(outcomes_os_interaction$histology_category == "UC", na.rm = TRUE) > 0 && 
            sum(outcomes_os_interaction$histology_category == "Variant/Unknown", na.rm = TRUE) > 0) {
          
          # Use the same adjustments as the multivariate model
          has_kps_interaction <- sum(!is.na(outcomes_os_interaction$kps_binary)) > 0
          has_visceral_interaction <- sum(!is.na(outcomes_os_interaction$visceral_mets_binary)) > 0
          
          if (has_kps_interaction && has_visceral_interaction) {
            # Filter to complete cases for multivariate model
            outcomes_os_interaction_complete <- outcomes_os_interaction %>%
              filter(!is.na(kps_binary), !is.na(visceral_mets_binary), !is.na(therapy_line_factor))
            
            if (nrow(outcomes_os_interaction_complete) >= 6) {
              # Build formula for model without interaction
              formula_parts_no_int <- c("ctdna_cleared_at_landmark", "histology_factor", "therapy_line_factor")
              
              # Add therapy class if available
              if (exists("therapy_class_counts_os") && length(therapy_class_counts_os) > 0) {
                outcomes_os_interaction_complete <- outcomes_os_interaction_complete %>%
                  filter(therapy_class %in% therapy_class_counts_os | is.na(therapy_class)) %>%
                  mutate(
                    therapy_class_filtered = ifelse(therapy_class %in% therapy_class_counts_os, therapy_class, "unspecified"),
                    therapy_class_factor_filtered = factor(therapy_class_filtered)
                  )
                formula_parts_no_int <- c(formula_parts_no_int, "therapy_class_factor_filtered")
              }
              
              formula_parts_no_int <- c(formula_parts_no_int, "kps_factor", "visceral_mets_factor")
              formula_str_no_int <- paste("Surv(os_time_from_landmark_months, os_event_from_landmark) ~", 
                                         paste(formula_parts_no_int, collapse = " + "))
              
              # Model with interaction
              formula_parts_int <- c("ctdna_cleared_at_landmark", "histology_factor", 
                                     "ctdna_cleared_at_landmark:histology_factor", "therapy_line_factor")
              
              if (exists("therapy_class_counts_os") && length(therapy_class_counts_os) > 0) {
                formula_parts_int <- c(formula_parts_int, "therapy_class_factor_filtered")
              }
              
              formula_parts_int <- c(formula_parts_int, "kps_factor", "visceral_mets_factor")
              formula_str_int <- paste("Surv(os_time_from_landmark_months, os_event_from_landmark) ~", 
                                      paste(formula_parts_int, collapse = " + "))
              
              # Fit models
              cox_no_interaction <- tryCatch({
                coxph(as.formula(formula_str_no_int), data = outcomes_os_interaction_complete)
              }, error = function(e) NULL)
              
              cox_with_interaction <- tryCatch({
                coxph(as.formula(formula_str_int), data = outcomes_os_interaction_complete)
              }, error = function(e) NULL)
              
              # Perform likelihood ratio test
              # First check if models converged and are valid (not due to perfect separation)
              if (!is.null(cox_no_interaction) && !is.null(cox_with_interaction)) {
                # Check if models converged
                no_int_converged <- isTRUE(cox_no_interaction$converged)
                with_int_converged <- isTRUE(cox_with_interaction$converged)
                
                # Check if models have valid coefficients (not extreme HRs indicating perfect separation)
                no_int_valid <- FALSE
                with_int_valid <- FALSE
                
                if (no_int_converged) {
                  tryCatch({
                    no_int_summary <- summary(cox_no_interaction)
                    if (nrow(no_int_summary$coefficients) > 0) {
                      # Check if ctDNA coefficient exists and is reasonable
                      coef_names <- rownames(no_int_summary$coefficients)
                      ctdna_coef_idx <- which(str_detect(coef_names, "ctdna_cleared_at_landmarkTRUE"))
                      if (length(ctdna_coef_idx) > 0) {
                        ctdna_coef <- no_int_summary$coefficients[ctdna_coef_idx, "coef"]
                        no_int_valid <- is.finite(ctdna_coef) && !is.na(ctdna_coef)
                      }
                    }
                  }, error = function(e) {})
                }
                
                if (with_int_converged) {
                  tryCatch({
                    with_int_summary <- summary(cox_with_interaction)
                    if (nrow(with_int_summary$coefficients) > 0) {
                      # Check if ctDNA coefficient exists and is reasonable
                      coef_names <- rownames(with_int_summary$coefficients)
                      ctdna_coef_idx <- which(str_detect(coef_names, "ctdna_cleared_at_landmarkTRUE"))
                      if (length(ctdna_coef_idx) > 0) {
                        ctdna_coef <- with_int_summary$coefficients[ctdna_coef_idx, "coef"]
                        with_int_valid <- is.finite(ctdna_coef) && !is.na(ctdna_coef)
                      }
                    }
                  }, error = function(e) {})
                }
                
                # Only perform LRT if both models converged and are valid
                if (no_int_converged && with_int_converged && no_int_valid && with_int_valid) {
                  lrt_interaction <- tryCatch({
                    anova(cox_no_interaction, cox_with_interaction, test = "LRT")
                  }, error = function(e) NULL)
                  
                  if (!is.null(lrt_interaction) && nrow(lrt_interaction) >= 2) {
                    # Extract p-value for interaction
                    interaction_p_value <- lrt_interaction$`Pr(>|Chi|)`[2]
                    
                    # Check if p-value is valid (not NA and not exactly 1.0 which suggests models are identical)
                    if (!is.na(interaction_p_value) && is.finite(interaction_p_value)) {
                      interaction_p_value_formatted <- ifelse(interaction_p_value < 0.001, "<0.001", 
                                                              as.character(round(interaction_p_value, 3)))
                      
                      # Store interaction test result
                      os_histology_interaction_p <- interaction_p_value
                      os_histology_interaction_p_formatted <- interaction_p_value_formatted
                    }
                  }
                } else {
                  # Models didn't converge or aren't valid - likely due to perfect separation
                  # Cannot perform interaction test with Cox models
                  os_histology_interaction_p_formatted <- "Cannot be performed (Cox models could not be fitted due to perfect separation)"
                }
              }
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
  
  cat("\nOS Cox Models:\n")
  cat("Unadjusted model:", ifelse(!is.null(cox_os_unadj), "Fitted", "Not fitted"), "\n")
  cat("Adjusted for line:", ifelse(!is.null(cox_os_line), "Fitted", "Not fitted"), "\n")
  cat("Adjusted for KPS:", ifelse(!is.null(cox_os_kps), "Fitted", "Not fitted"), "\n")
  cat("Adjusted for visceral mets:", ifelse(!is.null(cox_os_visceral), "Fitted", "Not fitted"), "\n")
  cat("Adjusted for line + class:", ifelse(!is.null(cox_os_adj), "Fitted", "Not fitted"), "\n")
  cat("Multivariate model:", ifelse(!is.null(cox_os_multiv), "Fitted", "Not fitted"), "\n")
  
  # Diagnostic: Check if models converged and have events
  if (!is.null(cox_os_unadj)) {
    cat("\nOS Unadjusted Model Diagnostics:\n")
    cat("  Converged:", isTRUE(cox_os_unadj$converged), "\n")
    cat("  N used:", cox_os_unadj$n, "\n")
    if (!is.null(cox_os_unadj_summary)) {
      cat("  Number of coefficients:", nrow(cox_os_unadj_summary$coefficients), "\n")
      if (nrow(cox_os_unadj_summary$coefficients) > 0) {
        cat("  HR for ctDNA cleared:", round(cox_os_unadj_summary$conf.int[1, "exp(coef)"], 3), "\n")
      }
    }
  }
  
  # Diagnostic: Check data availability
  cat("\nOS Data Availability:\n")
  cat("  Total patients in landmark_os_cleared:", nrow(landmark_os_cleared), "\n")
  cat("  Patients with OS events:", sum(landmark_os_cleared$os_event_from_landmark, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
  cat("  Patients censored:", sum(landmark_os_cleared$os_event_from_landmark == 0, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
  cat("  Patients with ctDNA cleared:", sum(landmark_os_cleared$ctdna_cleared_at_landmark, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
  cat("  Patients with ctDNA not cleared:", sum(!landmark_os_cleared$ctdna_cleared_at_landmark, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
} else {
  cox_os_unadj <- NULL
  cox_os_line <- NULL
  cox_os_kps <- NULL
  cox_os_visceral <- NULL
  cox_os_adj <- NULL
  cox_os_multiv <- NULL
  landmark_os_cleared <- NULL
  landmark_os_multiv <- NULL
  cat("OS analysis not available - insufficient data.\n")
}
```

```{r landmark_histology_distribution}
      ) %>%
```
