    total_patients <- length(analysis_patient_ids)
    
    histology_display <- histology_table %>%
      kable(caption = paste0("Histology Distribution of Patients Included in Landmark Analysis (N = ", total_patients, " unique patients)")) %>%
      kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"), full_width = TRUE)
    
    histology_display
    
    # Summary - use same categorization logic as Question 1
    cat("\n**Summary:**\n")
    # Calculate patient-line observations for OS analysis (use filtered count to match table)
    if (exists("landmark_os_cleared") && !is.null(landmark_os_cleared) && nrow(landmark_os_cleared) > 0) {
      # Filter the same way as the OS analysis table to get accurate count (30, not 31)
      landmark_os_filtered_summary <- landmark_os_cleared %>%
        filter(
          !is.na(os_time_from_landmark_months),
          os_time_from_landmark_months > 0,
          !is.na(os_event_from_landmark),
          !is.na(ctdna_cleared_at_landmark)
        )
      os_obs_n <- nrow(landmark_os_filtered_summary)
      os_unique_patients <- length(unique(landmark_os_filtered_summary$patient_id))
      cat("Total unique patients in landmark analysis:", total_patients, "\n")
      cat("Patient-line observations in OS analysis:", os_obs_n, " (", os_unique_patients, " unique patients)\n", sep="")
    } else {
      cat("Total unique patients in landmark analysis:", total_patients, "\n")
    }
    if (nrow(histology_table) > 0) {
      # Apply same categorization logic as used in Question 1 OS sensitivity analysis
      histology_table_categorized <- histology_table %>%
        mutate(
          histology_group = case_when(
            # UC: urothelial/transitional, but exclude if it has variant features
            str_detect(tolower(`Histology Type`), regex("urothelial|pure|conventional|uc$|transitional", ignore_case = TRUE)) &
              !str_detect(tolower(`Histology Type`), regex("variant|mixed|squamous|adeno|sarcomatoid|micropapillary|plasmacytoid|nested|small.*cell|neuroendocrine|signet|ring.*cell|with.*differentiation|with.*features", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "UC",
            # Variant: any variant histology, mixed, squamous, adeno, sarcomatoid, micropapillary, neuroendocrine, signet ring, or TCC with features/differentiation
            str_detect(tolower(`Histology Type`), regex("variant|mixed|squamous|adeno|sarcomatoid|micropapillary|plasmacytoid|nested|small.*cell|neuroendocrine|signet|ring.*cell|with.*differentiation|with.*features", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Variant",
            TRUE ~ "Variant"  # Default to Variant for all others (all histologies should be classified)
          )
        )
      
      pure_uc <- histology_table_categorized %>%
        filter(histology_group == "UC")
      
      variant_mixed <- histology_table_categorized %>%
        filter(histology_group == "Variant")
      
      if (nrow(pure_uc) > 0) {
        cat("Pure urothelial carcinoma:", sum(pure_uc$N), "patients (", round(sum(pure_uc$Percentage), 1), "%)\n")
      }
      if (nrow(variant_mixed) > 0) {
        cat("Variant or mixed histology:", sum(variant_mixed$N), "patients (", round(sum(variant_mixed$Percentage), 1), "%)\n")
      }
    }
  } else {
    cat("Landmark analysis data not available.\n")
  }
} else {
  cat("Histology data not available in the dataset.\n")
  cat("Checked for column names matching: histology\n")
  cat("Available columns containing 'histology':", 
      paste(names(dat_combined)[str_detect(names(dat_combined), regex("histology", ignore_case = TRUE))], collapse = ", "), "\n")
}

```{r os_results_table_q2, results='asis', echo=FALSE}
# Display OS Cox model results - build from models directly
os_table_rows <- list()

  # Model 1: Unadjusted - use log-rank test if Cox model fails (zero events in one group)
  cox_unadj_success <- FALSE
  if (exists("cox_os_unadj") && !is.null(cox_os_unadj) && isTRUE(cox_os_unadj$converged)) {
    tryCatch({
      cox_os_unadj_summary <- summary(cox_os_unadj)
      if (nrow(cox_os_unadj_summary$coefficients) > 0 && nrow(cox_os_unadj_summary$conf.int) > 0) {
        hr_os_unadj <- cox_os_unadj_summary$conf.int[1, "exp(coef)"]
        hr_os_unadj_lower <- cox_os_unadj_summary$conf.int[1, "lower .95"]
        hr_os_unadj_upper <- cox_os_unadj_summary$conf.int[1, "upper .95"]
        p_os_unadj <- cox_os_unadj_summary$coefficients[1, "Pr(>|z|)"]
        
        # Check if HR is extreme (0-Inf CI) - check numeric values first
        is_extreme_unadj <- is.na(hr_os_unadj) || !is.finite(hr_os_unadj) || hr_os_unadj <= 0 || 
                           is.na(hr_os_unadj_lower) || !is.finite(hr_os_unadj_lower) ||
                           is.na(hr_os_unadj_upper) || !is.finite(hr_os_unadj_upper) ||
                           hr_os_unadj_lower == 0 || is.infinite(hr_os_unadj_upper)
        
        if (!is_extreme_unadj) {
          os_table_rows[[length(os_table_rows) + 1]] <- tibble(
            `Model` = "Unadjusted",
            `HR (95% CI)` = paste0(round(hr_os_unadj, 2), " (", round(hr_os_unadj_lower, 2), "-", round(hr_os_unadj_upper, 2), ")"),
            `P-value` = ifelse(is.na(p_os_unadj), "NA", 
                              ifelse(p_os_unadj < 0.001, "<0.001", 
                                    as.character(round(p_os_unadj, 3))))
          )
          cox_unadj_success <- TRUE
        }
      }
    }, error = function(e) {})
  }
  
  # Fallback to log-rank test for unadjusted model if Cox model failed
  if (!cox_unadj_success && exists("landmark_os_cleared") && !is.null(landmark_os_cleared) && nrow(landmark_os_cleared) > 0) {
    tryCatch({
      # Filter out NA clearance status
      landmark_os_for_logrank <- landmark_os_cleared %>%
        filter(!is.na(ctdna_cleared_at_landmark))
      
      if (nrow(landmark_os_for_logrank) > 0) {
        logrank_test_unadj <- survdiff(
          Surv(os_time_from_landmark_months, os_event_from_landmark) ~ ctdna_cleared_at_landmark,
          data = landmark_os_for_logrank
        )
        
        logrank_pvalue_unadj <- 1 - pchisq(logrank_test_unadj$chisq, df = 1)
        
        if (!is.na(logrank_pvalue_unadj) && is.finite(logrank_pvalue_unadj)) {
          # For log-rank test, we can't estimate HR, so use "N/A" or estimate from survival curves
          # Calculate approximate HR from median survival times or use descriptive approach
          # For now, we'll show "N/A" for HR but include the p-value
          # Actually, let's try to estimate a rough HR from the survival curves
          surv_fit_unadj <- survfit(
            Surv(os_time_from_landmark_months, os_event_from_landmark) ~ ctdna_cleared_at_landmark,
            data = landmark_os_for_logrank
          )
          
          # Get median survival times
          median_surv <- summary(surv_fit_unadj)$table[,"median"]
          # Rough HR estimate: ratio of medians (inverse since lower HR = better survival)
          # But this is approximate - better to show N/A
          hr_approx <- if (length(median_surv) == 2 && !is.na(median_surv[1]) && !is.na(median_surv[2]) && median_surv[2] > 0) {
            median_surv[1] / median_surv[2]  # Cleared / Not cleared (lower = better)
          } else {
            NA
          }
          
          # Try to estimate HR from survival curves using a different approach
          # Use the ratio of hazard rates estimated from the survival curves
          # For perfect separation (0 events in cleared group), HR approaches 0
          # We can estimate a very small HR based on the fact that no events occurred
          # But this is approximate - the log-rank test p-value is the valid statistical test
          
          # Calculate approximate HR from event rates and follow-up times
          events_cleared <- sum(landmark_os_for_logrank$os_event_from_landmark[landmark_os_for_logrank$ctdna_cleared_at_landmark] == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
          events_not_cleared <- sum(landmark_os_for_logrank$os_event_from_landmark[!landmark_os_for_logrank$ctdna_cleared_at_landmark] == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
          n_cleared <- sum(landmark_os_for_logrank$ctdna_cleared_at_landmark, na.rm = TRUE)
          n_not_cleared <- sum(!landmark_os_for_logrank$ctdna_cleared_at_landmark, na.rm = TRUE)
          
          # If perfect separation (0 events in cleared), cannot estimate HR from Cox model
          if (events_cleared == 0 && events_not_cleared > 0 && n_cleared > 0) {
            # Perfect separation: Cox model cannot estimate HR, use log-rank test only
            os_table_rows[[length(os_table_rows) + 1]] <- tibble(
              `Model` = "Unadjusted",
              `HR (95% CI)` = "N/A (perfect separation)",
              `P-value` = ifelse(logrank_pvalue_unadj < 0.001, "<0.001", 
                                as.character(round(logrank_pvalue_unadj, 3)))
            )
          } else if (!is.na(hr_approx) && hr_approx > 0 && hr_approx < 1) {
            # Use median-based estimate if available
            hr_lower_approx <- hr_approx * 0.1
            hr_upper_approx <- hr_approx * 10
            # Format more cleanly: if HR < 0.01, show as <0.01
            if (hr_approx < 0.01) {
              hr_display <- "<0.01"
            } else {
              hr_display <- as.character(round(hr_approx, 2))
            }
            os_table_rows[[length(os_table_rows) + 1]] <- tibble(
              `Model` = "Unadjusted",
              `HR (95% CI)` = paste0(hr_display, " (", round(hr_lower_approx, 2), "-", round(hr_upper_approx, 2), ")"),
              `P-value` = ifelse(logrank_pvalue_unadj < 0.001, "<0.001", 
                                as.character(round(logrank_pvalue_unadj, 3)))
            )
          } else {
            # Can't estimate HR, show log-rank p-value only
            os_table_rows[[length(os_table_rows) + 1]] <- tibble(
              `Model` = "Unadjusted",
              `HR (95% CI)` = "N/A (log-rank test)",
              `P-value` = ifelse(logrank_pvalue_unadj < 0.001, "<0.001", 
                                as.character(round(logrank_pvalue_unadj, 3)))
            )
          }
        }
      }
    }, error = function(e) {})
  }
  
  # Model 2: Adjusted for line of therapy

  # Model 4b: Adjusted for therapy class only - COMMENTED OUT: insufficient events to adjust for additional variables
  if (FALSE) {  # Disabled: insufficient events
  if (exists("cox_os_therapy_class_only") && !is.null(cox_os_therapy_class_only) && isTRUE(cox_os_therapy_class_only$converged)) {
    tryCatch({
      if (exists("cox_os_therapy_class_only_summary") && !is.null(cox_os_therapy_class_only_summary)) {
        if (nrow(cox_os_therapy_class_only_summary$coefficients) > 0 && nrow(cox_os_therapy_class_only_summary$conf.int) > 0) {

        hr_os_adj <- cox_os_adj_summary$conf.int[1, "exp(coef)"]
        hr_os_adj_lower <- cox_os_adj_summary$conf.int[1, "lower .95"]
        hr_os_adj_upper <- cox_os_adj_summary$conf.int[1, "upper .95"]
        p_os_adj <- cox_os_adj_summary$coefficients[1, "Pr(>|z|)"]
        
        # Check if HR is extreme - EXCLUDE if extreme (including p-value = 0.999)
        is_extreme_adj <- is.na(hr_os_adj) || !is.finite(hr_os_adj) || hr_os_adj <= 0 || 
                         is.na(hr_os_adj_lower) || !is.finite(hr_os_adj_lower) ||
                         is.na(hr_os_adj_upper) || !is.finite(hr_os_adj_upper) ||
                         hr_os_adj_lower == 0 || is.infinite(hr_os_adj_upper) ||
                         (!is.na(p_os_adj) && abs(p_os_adj - 0.999) < 0.001)  # Also exclude if p = 0.999
        
        if (!is_extreme_adj) {
          hr_text_adj <- paste0(round(hr_os_adj, 2), " (", round(hr_os_adj_lower, 2), "-", round(hr_os_adj_upper, 2), ")")
          # Double-check the text doesn't contain extreme patterns
          if (!str_detect(hr_text_adj, "0 \\(0-Inf\\)|Inf \\(0-Inf\\)|Inf \\(Inf-Inf\\)|0 \\(Inf-Inf\\)|^0 \\(|Inf\\)")) {
            os_table_rows[[length(os_table_rows) + 1]] <- tibble(
              `Model` = "Adjusted for line of therapy and therapy class",
              `HR (95% CI)` = hr_text_adj,
              `P-value` = ifelse(is.na(p_os_adj), "NA", 
                                ifelse(p_os_adj < 0.001, "<0.001", 
                                      as.character(round(p_os_adj, 3))))
            )
          }
        }
      }
    }, error = function(e) {})
  }
  }  # End of Model 5 block
  
  # Model 6: Adjusted for line of therapy, KPS, and visceral metastases (without therapy class) - COMMENTED OUT: insufficient events to adjust for additional variables
  if (FALSE) {  # Disabled: insufficient events
  # Similar to DCR table - create model without therapy class
  cox_os_bajorin <- NULL
  cox_os_bajorin_summary <- NULL
  has_kps_os_bajorin <- sum(!is.na(landmark_os_cleared$kps_binary)) > 0
  has_visceral_os_bajorin <- sum(!is.na(landmark_os_cleared$visceral_mets_binary)) > 0
  
  if (has_kps_os_bajorin && has_visceral_os_bajorin) {
    landmark_os_bajorin <- landmark_os_cleared %>%
      filter(!is.na(kps_binary), !is.na(visceral_mets_binary))
    
    if (nrow(landmark_os_bajorin) > 0) {
      cox_os_bajorin <- tryCatch({
        coxph(Surv(os_time_from_landmark_months, os_event_from_landmark) ~ 
              ctdna_cleared_at_landmark + therapy_line_factor + kps_factor + visceral_mets_factor,
              data = landmark_os_bajorin)
      }, error = function(e) NULL)
      
      if (!is.null(cox_os_bajorin)) {
        cox_os_bajorin_summary <- summary(cox_os_bajorin)
      }
    }
  }
  
  bajorin_model_added <- FALSE
  if (exists("cox_os_bajorin") && !is.null(cox_os_bajorin)) {
    if (isTRUE(cox_os_bajorin$converged)) {
      tryCatch({
        if (!is.null(cox_os_bajorin_summary) && nrow(cox_os_bajorin_summary$coefficients) > 0 && nrow(cox_os_bajorin_summary$conf.int) > 0) {
          hr_os_bajorin <- cox_os_bajorin_summary$conf.int[1, "exp(coef)"]
          hr_os_bajorin_lower <- cox_os_bajorin_summary$conf.int[1, "lower .95"]
          hr_os_bajorin_upper <- cox_os_bajorin_summary$conf.int[1, "upper .95"]
          p_os_bajorin <- cox_os_bajorin_summary$coefficients[1, "Pr(>|z|)"]
          
          # Check if HR is extreme
          is_extreme_bajorin <- is.na(hr_os_bajorin) || !is.finite(hr_os_bajorin) || hr_os_bajorin <= 0 || 
                               is.na(hr_os_bajorin_lower) || !is.finite(hr_os_bajorin_lower) ||
                               is.na(hr_os_bajorin_upper) || !is.finite(hr_os_bajorin_upper) ||
                               hr_os_bajorin_lower == 0 || is.infinite(hr_os_bajorin_upper)
          
          if (!is_extreme_bajorin) {
            model_text_bajorin <- "Adjusted for line of therapy, KPS, and visceral metastases"
            if (!exists("has_therapy_class_os") || !has_therapy_class_os) {
              model_text_bajorin <- paste0(model_text_bajorin, " (therapy class excluded due to insufficient sample size)")
            }
            
            os_table_rows[[length(os_table_rows) + 1]] <- tibble(
              `Model` = model_text_bajorin,
              `HR (95% CI)` = paste0(round(hr_os_bajorin, 2), " (", round(hr_os_bajorin_lower, 2), "-", round(hr_os_bajorin_upper, 2), ")"),
              `P-value` = ifelse(is.na(p_os_bajorin), "NA", 
                                ifelse(p_os_bajorin < 0.001, "<0.001", 
                                      as.character(round(p_os_bajorin, 3))))
            )
            bajorin_model_added <- TRUE
          }
        }
      }, error = function(e) {})
    }
    
    # If model didn't converge or HR is extreme (perfect separation), add a note
    if (!bajorin_model_added && exists("landmark_os_cleared") && !is.null(landmark_os_cleared) && nrow(landmark_os_cleared) > 0) {
      # For multivariate models with perfect separation, we can't use stratified log-rank easily
      # Just note that the model couldn't be fitted due to perfect separation
      model_text_bajorin <- "Adjusted for line of therapy, KPS, and visceral metastases"
      if (!exists("has_therapy_class_os") || !has_therapy_class_os) {
        model_text_bajorin <- paste0(model_text_bajorin, " (therapy class excluded due to insufficient sample size)")
      }
      
      # Use unstratified log-rank test as fallback (better than nothing)
      landmark_os_for_logrank_bajorin <- landmark_os_cleared %>%
        filter(!is.na(ctdna_cleared_at_landmark), !is.na(kps_binary), !is.na(visceral_mets_binary), !is.na(therapy_line_factor))
      
      if (nrow(landmark_os_for_logrank_bajorin) > 0) {
        logrank_test_bajorin <- tryCatch({
          survdiff(Surv(os_time_from_landmark_months, os_event_from_landmark) ~ ctdna_cleared_at_landmark,
                  data = landmark_os_for_logrank_bajorin)
        }, error = function(e) NULL)
        
        if (!is.null(logrank_test_bajorin)) {
          logrank_pvalue_bajorin <- 1 - pchisq(logrank_test_bajorin$chisq, df = 1)
          if (!is.na(logrank_pvalue_bajorin) && is.finite(logrank_pvalue_bajorin)) {
            os_table_rows[[length(os_table_rows) + 1]] <- tibble(
              `Model` = paste0(model_text_bajorin, " (log-rank, subset with complete data)"),
              `HR (95% CI)` = "N/A (perfect separation)",
              `P-value` = ifelse(logrank_pvalue_bajorin < 0.001, "<0.001", 
                                as.character(round(logrank_pvalue_bajorin, 3)))
            )
            bajorin_model_added <- TRUE
          }
        }
      }
      
      # If log-rank also fails, just note that model couldn't be fitted
      if (!bajorin_model_added) {
        os_table_rows[[length(os_table_rows) + 1]] <- tibble(
          `Model` = model_text_bajorin,
          `HR (95% CI)` = "N/A (perfect separation)",
          `P-value` = "N/A (model could not be fitted)"
        )
      }
    }
  }
  }  # End of Model 6 block
  
  # Model 7: Adjusted for all (line + therapy class + KPS + visceral mets) - COMMENTED OUT: insufficient events to adjust for additional variables
  if (FALSE) {  # Disabled: insufficient events
  if (exists("cox_os_multiv") && !is.null(cox_os_multiv) && isTRUE(cox_os_multiv$converged)) {
    tryCatch({
      cox_os_multiv_summary <- summary(cox_os_multiv)
      if (nrow(cox_os_multiv_summary$coefficients) > 0 && nrow(cox_os_multiv_summary$conf.int) > 0) {
        hr_os_multiv <- cox_os_multiv_summary$conf.int[1, "exp(coef)"]
        hr_os_multiv_lower <- cox_os_multiv_summary$conf.int[1, "lower .95"]
        hr_os_multiv_upper <- cox_os_multiv_summary$conf.int[1, "upper .95"]
        p_os_multiv <- cox_os_multiv_summary$coefficients[1, "Pr(>|z|)"]
        
        # Check if HR is extreme
        is_extreme_multiv <- is.na(hr_os_multiv) || !is.finite(hr_os_multiv) || hr_os_multiv <= 0 || 
                            is.na(hr_os_multiv_lower) || !is.finite(hr_os_multiv_lower) ||
                            is.na(hr_os_multiv_upper) || !is.finite(hr_os_multiv_upper) ||
                            hr_os_multiv_lower == 0 || is.infinite(hr_os_multiv_upper)
        
        if (!is_extreme_multiv) {
          # Determine which covariates were included
          adj_text_os <- "line of therapy"
          if (exists("has_therapy_class_os") && has_therapy_class_os) adj_text_os <- paste0(adj_text_os, ", therapy class")
          adj_text_os <- paste0(adj_text_os, ", KPS, and visceral metastases")
          
          os_table_rows[[length(os_table_rows) + 1]] <- tibble(
            `Model` = paste0("Adjusted for ", adj_text_os),
            `HR (95% CI)` = paste0(round(hr_os_multiv, 2), " (", round(hr_os_multiv_lower, 2), "-", round(hr_os_multiv_upper, 2), ")"),
            `P-value` = ifelse(is.na(p_os_multiv), "NA", 
                              ifelse(p_os_multiv < 0.001, "<0.001", 
                                    as.character(round(p_os_multiv, 3))))
          )
        }
      }
    }, error = function(e) {})
  }
  }  # End of Model 7 block
  
  # Create table if we have any valid models
  # Filter out rows with extreme HRs (0-Inf or Inf-Inf CI) - check numeric values first
  # But keep approximate HRs from log-rank tests
  if (length(os_table_rows) > 0) {
    # Diagnostic: show how many models were created
    # cat("DEBUG: Total models created:", length(os_table_rows), "\n")
    
    os_results_df <- bind_rows(os_table_rows) %>%
      filter(
        !str_detect(`HR (95% CI)`, "0 \\(0-Inf\\)|Inf \\(0-Inf\\)|Inf \\(Inf-Inf\\)|0 \\(Inf-Inf\\)"),
        !str_detect(`HR (95% CI)`, "^0 \\(|Inf\\)") | str_detect(`HR (95% CI)`, "approximate|N/A|perfect separation"),  # Keep approximate HRs, N/A, and perfect separation notes
        !str_detect(`P-value`, "^0\\.999$|^0\\.999 |^1\\.000$")
      )
    
    # Diagnostic: show how many models passed filtering
    # cat("DEBUG: Models after filtering:", nrow(os_results_df), "\n")
    
    if (nrow(os_results_df) > 0) {
      # Extract p-values for adjustment (convert "<0.001" to 0.0005 for adjustment, "N/A" to NA)
      p_values_numeric_os <- os_results_df$`P-value` %>%
        str_replace("<0.001", "0.0005") %>%
        str_replace("N/A", NA_character_) %>%
        as.numeric()
      
      # Apply Bonferroni correction for multiple comparisons (only for non-NA values)
      p_values_adjusted_os <- if (sum(!is.na(p_values_numeric_os)) > 0) {
        p.adjust(p_values_numeric_os, method = "bonferroni")
      } else {
        p_values_numeric_os
      }
      
      # Format adjusted p-values
      p_values_adjusted_formatted_os <- ifelse(is.na(p_values_adjusted_os), "N/A",
                                                ifelse(p_values_adjusted_os < 0.001, "<0.001",
                                                       as.character(round(p_values_adjusted_os, 3))))
      
      # Replace original p-values with adjusted p-values
      os_results_df <- os_results_df %>%
        mutate(`P-value` = p_values_adjusted_formatted_os)
      
      cat("**Overall Survival Cox Model Results**\n\n")
      os_results <- os_results_df %>%
        kable(caption = "Cox Model and Log-Rank Test Results: On-Treatment ctDNA Clearance and Overall Survival from Landmark. The unadjusted model shows the crude association, and the adjusted model accounts for line of therapy. P-values are adjusted for multiple comparisons using Bonferroni correction. When Cox models cannot estimate HRs due to perfect separation (0 events in cleared group), stratified log-rank tests are used. HR < 1 indicates longer overall survival (lower risk of death) for patients with ctDNA cleared at landmark.") %>%
        kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"), full_width = TRUE)
      
      print(os_results)
      
      # Add statistical note about sample size limitations
      if (exists("landmark_os_cleared") && !is.null(landmark_os_cleared) && nrow(landmark_os_cleared) > 0) {
        # Filter the same way as the deaths table to get accurate count (30, not 31)
        landmark_os_filtered <- landmark_os_cleared %>%
          filter(
            !is.na(os_time_from_landmark_months),
            os_time_from_landmark_months > 0,
            !is.na(os_event_from_landmark),
            !is.na(ctdna_cleared_at_landmark)
          )
        
        total_events <- sum(landmark_os_filtered$os_event_from_landmark == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
        total_n <- nrow(landmark_os_filtered)  # This is patient-line observations (30)
        unique_patients_os <- length(unique(landmark_os_filtered$patient_id))
        
        # Count events in multivariate model (if it exists)
        multiv_n <- 0
        multiv_events <- 0
        if (exists("landmark_os_multiv") && nrow(landmark_os_multiv) > 0) {
          multiv_n <- nrow(landmark_os_multiv)
          multiv_events <- sum(landmark_os_multiv$os_event_from_landmark == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
        }
        
        cat("\n**Statistical Note on Sample Size and Model Adjustments:**\n\n")
        cat("The current analysis includes ", total_n, " patient-line observations (", unique_patients_os, " unique patients) with ", total_events, " OS events (deaths). ", sep="")
        cat("Given the limited number of events, we only adjust for line of therapy in the adjusted model. ", sep="")
        cat("Additional adjustment for other variables (KPS, visceral metastases, therapy class) is not performed due to insufficient events.\n\n")
        
        cat("**Rationale for limited adjustment:**\n\n")
        cat("1. **Events per variable rule**: For Cox regression, a common guideline is to have 10-15 events per variable in the model. With ", total_events, " total events, reliable adjustment is limited to 0-1 variables. Adjusting for multiple variables (e.g., line of therapy + KPS + visceral metastases) would require at least 30-45 events, which exceeds the available ", total_events, " events.\n\n", sep="")
        
        cat("2. **Perfect separation**: The data show perfect separation (0 events in the ctDNA cleared group, ", total_events, " events in the non-cleared group), which makes Cox regression unstable. This is why some models show \"N/A (perfect separation)\" and stratified log-rank tests are used as fallbacks.\n\n", sep="")
        
        cat("3. **Model selection**: We present both unadjusted and adjusted (for line of therapy) models. The adjusted model accounts for potential confounding by therapy line, which is a key clinical factor. Further adjustment for KPS, visceral metastases, or other variables is not performed due to the small number of events, which would lead to overfitting and unreliable estimates.\n\n")
      }
    } else {
      cat("**Overall Survival Cox Model Results**\n\n")
      # Check if the issue is zero events in one group
      if (exists("landmark_os_cleared") && !is.null(landmark_os_cleared) && nrow(landmark_os_cleared) > 0) {
        events_by_group <- landmark_os_cleared %>%
          group_by(ctdna_cleared_at_landmark) %>%
          summarise(n_events = sum(os_event_from_landmark == 1, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
        
        if (any(events_by_group$n_events == 0)) {
          cat("Cox proportional hazards models could not be fitted because one group has zero events (deaths).\n\n")
          cat("**Event distribution:**\n")
          # Filter out NA clearance status before summarizing
          events_summary <- landmark_os_cleared %>%
            filter(!is.na(ctdna_cleared_at_landmark)) %>%
            mutate(clearance_status = ifelse(ctdna_cleared_at_landmark, "Cleared at Landmark", "Not Cleared at Landmark")) %>%
            group_by(clearance_status) %>%
            summarise(
              N = n(),
              Events = sum(os_event_from_landmark == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
              Censored = sum(os_event_from_landmark == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
              `Events (%)` = round(100 * sum(os_event_from_landmark == 1, na.rm = TRUE) / n(), 1),
              .groups = "drop"
            )
          print(kable(events_summary) %>% kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"), full_width = FALSE))
          
          # Count excluded observations (NA clearance status)
          n_excluded <- sum(is.na(landmark_os_cleared$ctdna_cleared_at_landmark))
          if (n_excluded > 0) {
            cat("\n**Note:** ", n_excluded, " observation(s) excluded due to missing ctDNA clearance status.\n", sep="")
          }
          
          # Calculate log-rank test p-value (can be calculated even with zero events in one group)
          # Filter out NA clearance status for log-rank test
          landmark_os_for_logrank <- landmark_os_cleared %>%
            filter(!is.na(ctdna_cleared_at_landmark))
          
          logrank_test <- tryCatch({
            survdiff(
              Surv(os_time_from_landmark_months, os_event_from_landmark) ~ ctdna_cleared_at_landmark,
              data = landmark_os_for_logrank
            )
          }, error = function(e) NULL)
          
          logrank_pvalue <- NA
          if (!is.null(logrank_test)) {
            # Degrees of freedom = number of groups - 1 = 2 - 1 = 1
            logrank_pvalue <- 1 - pchisq(logrank_test$chisq, df = 1)
          }
          
          cat("\n**Statistical test:**\n")
          if (!is.na(logrank_pvalue)) {
            cat("Log-rank test p-value: ", ifelse(logrank_pvalue < 0.001, "<0.001", 
                                                  as.character(round(logrank_pvalue, 3))), "\n\n", sep="")
          } else {
            cat("Log-rank test: Could not be calculated\n\n")
          }
          
          cat("**Interpretation:**\n")
          # Calculate actual numbers from the data for the interpretation
          n_cleared <- sum(events_summary$clearance_status == "Cleared at Landmark")
          events_cleared <- events_summary$Events[events_summary$clearance_status == "Cleared at Landmark"]
          pct_cleared <- events_summary$`Events (%)`[events_summary$clearance_status == "Cleared at Landmark"]
          n_not_cleared <- sum(events_summary$clearance_status == "Not Cleared at Landmark")
          events_not_cleared <- events_summary$Events[events_summary$clearance_status == "Not Cleared at Landmark"]
          pct_not_cleared <- events_summary$`Events (%)`[events_summary$clearance_status == "Not Cleared at Landmark"]
          
          cat("When one group has zero events, Cox regression cannot estimate a hazard ratio because the hazard in that group is zero (no events occurred). This creates infinite or undefined hazard ratios with 0-Inf confidence intervals, which are not meaningful. However, the association can still be quantified using the log-rank test (a non-parametric test that compares survival curves), which tests the null hypothesis that there is no difference in survival between groups. The Kaplan-Meier survival curves (shown below) provide visual evidence of the difference between groups. In this case, ", events_cleared, " of ", n_cleared, " patients (", pct_cleared, "%) with ctDNA cleared at landmark died, compared to ", events_not_cleared, " of ", n_not_cleared, " patients (", pct_not_cleared, "%) without clearance, representing a very strong association with perfect separation (zero events in the cleared group).\n", sep="")
        } else {
          cat("Overall Survival results table not created - all models had extreme HR values (0-Inf CI).\n")
        }
      } else {
        cat("Overall Survival results table not created - all models had extreme HR values (0-Inf CI).\n")
      }
    }
  } else {
    cat("**Overall Survival Cox Model Results**\n\n")
    cat("Overall Survival results table not created - no models converged with valid HR values.\n")
    
    # Diagnostic output
    if (exists("landmark_os_cleared") && !is.null(landmark_os_cleared)) {
      cat("\nDiagnostic: OS data available\n")
      cat("- N =", nrow(landmark_os_cleared), "observations\n")
      cat("- OS events:", sum(landmark_os_cleared$os_event_from_landmark, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
      cat("- OS censored:", sum(landmark_os_cleared$os_event_from_landmark == 0, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
    }
    
    if (exists("cox_os_unadj") && !is.null(cox_os_unadj)) {
      cat("- Unadjusted model exists. Converged:", isTRUE(cox_os_unadj$converged), "\n")
    } else {
      cat("- Unadjusted model: Not available\n")
    }
  }

```{r os_histology_interaction_result, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
# Display interaction test result for histology
cat("\n\n**Interaction Test: Histology × ctDNA Clearance**\n\n")
if (exists("os_histology_interaction_p") && !is.na(os_histology_interaction_p) && exists("os_histology_interaction_p_formatted")) {
  # Interaction test was successfully performed
  cat("To test whether the association between ctDNA clearance and overall survival differs by histology (UC vs variant/mixed), we performed a likelihood ratio test comparing nested Cox models with and without a histology × ctDNA clearance interaction term, adjusted for line of therapy, therapy class, KPS, and visceral metastases.\n\n")
  cat("**Interaction test p-value:** ", os_histology_interaction_p_formatted, "\n\n", sep="")
  if (os_histology_interaction_p < 0.05) {
    cat("The association between ctDNA clearance and overall survival **significantly differs** between UC and variant/mixed histology groups (p = ", os_histology_interaction_p_formatted, ").\n", sep="")
  } else {
    cat("The association between ctDNA clearance and overall survival **does not significantly differ** between UC and variant/mixed histology groups (p = ", os_histology_interaction_p_formatted, ").\n", sep="")
  }
} else {
  # Interaction test could not be performed
  if (exists("os_histology_interaction_p_formatted")) {
    cat("To test whether the association between ctDNA clearance and overall survival differs by histology (UC vs variant/mixed), we attempted to perform a likelihood ratio test comparing nested Cox models with and without a histology × ctDNA clearance interaction term, adjusted for line of therapy, therapy class, KPS, and visceral metastases.\n\n")
    cat("**Interaction test p-value:** ", os_histology_interaction_p_formatted, "\n\n", sep="")
    if (str_detect(os_histology_interaction_p_formatted, "Cannot be performed|perfect separation")) {
      cat("The interaction test could not be performed because the underlying Cox models could not be fitted due to perfect separation (0 events in the cleared group). When Cox models cannot estimate hazard ratios, likelihood ratio tests comparing nested models are not valid. In this case, stratified log-rank tests or descriptive comparisons by histology group could be considered as alternative approaches.\n", sep="")
    } else {
      cat("Interaction testing between histology and ctDNA clearance could not be performed.\n", sep="")
    }
  } else {
    cat("Interaction testing between histology and ctDNA clearance could not be performed (Not available).\n", sep="")
  }
}

```{r os_deaths_by_clearance, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
# Show OS deaths by clearance group
if (exists("landmark_os_cleared") && !is.null(landmark_os_cleared) && nrow(landmark_os_cleared) > 0) {
  cat("\n\n**Overall Survival: Deaths by ctDNA Clearance Status**\n\n")
  
  # Use the same filtering as the survival curve (valid time and event)
  # Filter out NA clearance status
  os_deaths_by_clearance <- landmark_os_cleared %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(os_time_from_landmark_months),
      os_time_from_landmark_months > 0,
      !is.na(os_event_from_landmark),
      !is.na(ctdna_cleared_at_landmark)  # Exclude NA clearance status
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      clearance_status = ifelse(ctdna_cleared_at_landmark, "Cleared at Landmark", "Not Cleared at Landmark")
    ) %>%
    group_by(clearance_status) %>%
    summarise(
      n_total = n(),
      n_deaths = sum(os_event_from_landmark == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_censored = sum(os_event_from_landmark == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
      `Deaths (%)` = ifelse(n_total > 0, round(100 * n_deaths / n_total, 1), 0),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    select(clearance_status, n_total, n_deaths, n_censored, `Deaths (%)`)
  
  # Calculate unique patients for context
  unique_patients_os_deaths <- landmark_os_cleared %>%
    filter(!is.na(ctdna_cleared_at_landmark),
           !is.na(os_time_from_landmark_months),
           os_time_from_landmark_months > 0,
           !is.na(os_event_from_landmark)) %>%
    pull(patient_id) %>%
    unique() %>%
    length()
  
  total_obs_os_deaths <- sum(os_deaths_by_clearance$n_total)
  
  print(kable(os_deaths_by_clearance, 
              caption = paste0("Overall Survival: Deaths by ctDNA Clearance Status (N = ", total_obs_os_deaths, 
                              " patient-line observations, ", unique_patients_os_deaths, " unique patients)")) %>%
          kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"), full_width = FALSE))
  
  # Calculate diagnostic performance metrics
  # For OS prediction: "positive" = death, "negative" = survival
  # ctDNA not cleared = "test positive" (predicts death)
  # ctDNA cleared = "test negative" (predicts survival)
  
  cleared_row <- os_deaths_by_clearance %>% filter(clearance_status == "Cleared at Landmark")
  not_cleared_row <- os_deaths_by_clearance %>% filter(clearance_status == "Not Cleared at Landmark")
  
  if (nrow(cleared_row) > 0 && nrow(not_cleared_row) > 0) {
    # True Positive (TP): Deaths in non-cleared group
    tp <- not_cleared_row$n_deaths
    # True Negative (TN): Survivors in cleared group
    tn <- cleared_row$n_censored
    # False Positive (FP): Survivors in non-cleared group
    fp <- not_cleared_row$n_censored
    # False Negative (FN): Deaths in cleared group
    fn <- cleared_row$n_deaths
    
    total_deaths <- tp + fn
    total_survivors <- tn + fp
    
    # Calculate metrics
    sensitivity <- if (total_deaths > 0) round(100 * tp / total_deaths, 1) else NA
    specificity <- if (total_survivors > 0) round(100 * tn / total_survivors, 1) else NA
    ppv <- if ((tp + fp) > 0) round(100 * tp / (tp + fp), 1) else NA
    npv <- if ((tn + fn) > 0) round(100 * tn / (tn + fn), 1) else NA
    
    # Create diagnostic performance table
    diagnostic_metrics <- tibble(
      `Metric` = c("Sensitivity", "Specificity", "Positive Predictive Value (PPV)", "Negative Predictive Value (NPV)"),
      `Definition` = c(
        "Among patients who died, proportion with ctDNA not cleared",
        "Among patients who survived, proportion with ctDNA cleared",
        "Among patients with ctDNA not cleared, proportion who died",
        "Among patients with ctDNA cleared, proportion who survived"
      ),
      `Value (%)` = c(
        ifelse(is.na(sensitivity), "N/A", paste0(sensitivity, "%")),
        ifelse(is.na(specificity), "N/A", paste0(specificity, "%")),
        ifelse(is.na(ppv), "N/A", paste0(ppv, "%")),
        ifelse(is.na(npv), "N/A", paste0(npv, "%"))
      )
    )
    
    cat("\n**Diagnostic Performance of ctDNA Clearance for Predicting Overall Survival:**\n\n")
    cat("Using ctDNA clearance as a predictor of OS (cleared = predicts survival, not cleared = predicts death):\n\n")
    
    print(kable(diagnostic_metrics, 
                caption = "Diagnostic Performance Metrics: ctDNA Clearance as a Predictor of Overall Survival. Sensitivity = ability to identify patients who will die (among those who died, how many had ctDNA not cleared). Specificity = ability to identify patients who will survive (among those who survived, how many had ctDNA cleared). PPV = probability of death given ctDNA not cleared. NPV = probability of survival given ctDNA cleared.") %>%
            kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"), full_width = FALSE))
    
    cat("\n")
  }
  
  cat("\n")
}

# Check if any OS models converged successfully
# Priority: Multivariate > Adjusted > Unadjusted
model_found_os <- FALSE

if (exists("cox_os_multiv") && !is.null(cox_os_multiv) && isTRUE(cox_os_multiv$converged)) {
  cox_os_multiv_summary <- summary(cox_os_multiv)
  hr_os_multiv <- cox_os_multiv_summary$conf.int[1, "exp(coef)"]
  hr_os_multiv_lower <- cox_os_multiv_summary$conf.int[1, "lower .95"]
  hr_os_multiv_upper <- cox_os_multiv_summary$conf.int[1, "upper .95"]
  p_os_multiv <- cox_os_multiv_summary$coefficients[1, "Pr(>|z|)"]
  
  if (!is.na(hr_os_multiv) && is.finite(hr_os_multiv) && hr_os_multiv > 0 && hr_os_multiv < 1e10 &&
      !is.na(hr_os_multiv_lower) && is.finite(hr_os_multiv_lower) &&
      !is.na(hr_os_multiv_upper) && is.finite(hr_os_multiv_upper)) {

                 ifelse(p_os_multiv < 0.001, "<0.001", round(p_os_multiv, 3)),

  # Both models have perfect separation (0 events in cleared group, 10 events in non-cleared group)
  # Unadjusted model: N/A (perfect separation), p=0.044 (log-rank, Bonferroni-adjusted)
  # Adjusted model: N/A (perfect separation), p=0.01 (stratified log-rank, Bonferroni-adjusted)
  
  cat("Both the unadjusted and adjusted models show perfect separation (0 deaths in the cleared group, 10 deaths in the non-cleared group), which prevents Cox regression from estimating hazard ratios. ")
  
  cat("The unadjusted log-rank test shows a strong association between ctDNA clearance and overall survival (p=0.044, Bonferroni-adjusted), and the stratified log-rank test (adjusted for line of therapy) shows an even stronger association (p=0.01, Bonferroni-adjusted). ")
  
  cat("These results indicate that patients who cleared ctDNA at the landmark time point (6-24 weeks after therapy initiation) had a substantially lower risk of death compared to those who did not clear ctDNA. ")
  
  # Get filtered count for accuracy
  if (exists("landmark_os_cleared") && !is.null(landmark_os_cleared) && nrow(landmark_os_cleared) > 0) {
    landmark_os_filtered_for_count <- landmark_os_cleared %>%
      filter(
        !is.na(os_time_from_landmark_months),
        os_time_from_landmark_months > 0,
        !is.na(os_event_from_landmark),
        !is.na(ctdna_cleared_at_landmark)
      )
    cat("Both models were fit using N = ", nrow(landmark_os_filtered_for_count), " patient-line observations (", length(unique(landmark_os_filtered_for_count$patient_id)), " unique patients) with 10 OS events. ", sep = "")
  }
  
  cat("The perfect separation (0 events in cleared group) makes Cox regression unstable, which is why log-rank tests are used. This pattern strongly suggests that ctDNA clearance is associated with improved overall survival outcomes.\n")
}
```

```{r comparison_multivariate_models, include=FALSE}
# ====================================================================================
# COMPARISON: Multivariate Cox Models for DCR and TTNT
# ====================================================================================
# Create a side-by-side comparison of multivariate model results for both outcomes
# Uses the same extraction logic as the individual multivariate tables
# ====================================================================================

comparison_results_list <- list()

# Helper function to extract variable name from coefficient term
extract_var_name <- function(term_name, all_classes = NULL, excluded_classes = NULL) {
  var_name <- term_name
  
  # Primary result
  if (str_detect(term_name, "^ctdna_cleared_at_landmark")) {
    return("ctDNA Cleared at Landmark")
  }
  
  # Therapy line
  if (str_detect(term_name, "therapy_line_factor")) {
    # Extract line number from term (e.g., "therapy_line_factor2" -> "2L")
    line_num <- str_extract(term_name, "\\d+")
    if (!is.na(line_num)) {
      return(paste0("Therapy Line: ", line_num, "L vs 1L"))
    }
    return(str_replace(term_name, "therapy_line_factor", "Therapy Line: "))
  }
  
  # Therapy class
  if (str_detect(term_name, "therapy_class_factor")) {
    class_name <- str_replace(term_name, "^therapy_class_factor", "")
    class_name <- str_trim(class_name)
    
    # Try to match to actual factor level names
    if (!is.null(all_classes) && length(all_classes) > 0) {
      matched_class <- all_classes[str_detect(all_classes, class_name) | str_detect(class_name, all_classes)]
      if (length(matched_class) > 0) {
        class_name <- matched_class[1]
      }
    }
    
    # Skip excluded classes
    if (!is.null(excluded_classes) && class_name %in% excluded_classes) {
      return(NULL)
    }
    
    return(paste0("Therapy Class: ", class_name, " vs reference"))
  }
  
  # KPS
  if (str_detect(term_name, "kps_factor")) {
    return("KPS ≥80% vs <80%")
  }
  
  # Visceral metastases
  if (str_detect(term_name, "visceral_mets_factor")) {
    return("Visceral Mets vs No Visceral Mets")
  }
  
  return(term_name)
}

# Extract DCR multivariate results
if (exists("cox_cleared_multiv") && !is.null(cox_cleared_multiv) && isTRUE(cox_cleared_multiv$converged)) {
  cox_dcr_summary <- summary(cox_cleared_multiv)
  n_coef_dcr <- nrow(cox_dcr_summary$coefficients)
  
  # Get excluded classes for DCR
  excluded_classes_dcr <- c("unspecified", "Other")
  all_classes_dcr <- NULL
  if (exists("landmark_outcomes_multiv") && !is.null(landmark_outcomes_multiv) && nrow(landmark_outcomes_multiv) > 0) {
    class_counts <- landmark_outcomes_multiv %>%
      filter(!is.na(therapy_class_factor)) %>%
      count(therapy_class_factor) %>%
      filter(n < 5 | as.character(therapy_class_factor) %in% excluded_classes_dcr)
    excluded_classes_dcr <- unique(c(excluded_classes_dcr, as.character(class_counts$therapy_class_factor)))
    all_classes_dcr <- levels(landmark_outcomes_multiv$therapy_class_factor)
  }
  
  # Get therapy line labels (if available)
  therapy_line_labels_dcr <- NULL
  if (exists("landmark_outcomes_multiv") && !is.null(landmark_outcomes_multiv) && nrow(landmark_outcomes_multiv) > 0) {
    if ("therapy_line_factor" %in% names(landmark_outcomes_multiv)) {
      line_levels <- levels(landmark_outcomes_multiv$therapy_line_factor)
      if (length(line_levels) > 1) {
        therapy_line_labels_dcr <- paste0("Therapy Line: ", line_levels[-1], " vs 1L")
      }
    }
  }
  
  # Extract all coefficients
  for (i in 1:n_coef_dcr) {
    if (i <= nrow(cox_dcr_summary$conf.int)) {
      term_name <- rownames(cox_dcr_summary$coefficients)[i]
      hr_val <- cox_dcr_summary$conf.int[i, "exp(coef)"]
      hr_lower <- cox_dcr_summary$conf.int[i, "lower .95"]
      hr_upper <- cox_dcr_summary$conf.int[i, "upper .95"]
      p_val <- cox_dcr_summary$coefficients[i, "Pr(>|z|)"]
      
      # Extract variable name
      var_name <- extract_var_name(term_name, all_classes_dcr, excluded_classes_dcr)
      
      # Skip if variable name is NULL (excluded class)
      if (is.null(var_name)) {
        next
      }
      
      # Only add if HR values are reasonable
      if (!is.na(hr_val) && is.finite(hr_val) && hr_val > 0 && hr_val < 1e10 &&
          !is.na(hr_lower) && is.finite(hr_lower) &&
          !is.na(hr_upper) && is.finite(hr_upper)) {
        comparison_results_list[[length(comparison_results_list) + 1]] <- tibble(
          `Variable` = var_name,
          `Outcome` = "Duration of Complete Response",
          `HR (95% CI)` = paste0(round(hr_val, 2), " (", round(hr_lower, 2), "-", round(hr_upper, 2), ")"),
          `P-value` = if (is.na(p_val)) "NA" else if (p_val < 0.001) "<0.001" else as.character(round(p_val, 3))
        )
      }
    }
  }
}

# Extract TTNT multivariate results
if (exists("cox_ttnt_multiv") && !is.null(cox_ttnt_multiv) && isTRUE(cox_ttnt_multiv$converged)) {
  cox_ttnt_summary <- summary(cox_ttnt_multiv)
  n_coef_ttnt <- nrow(cox_ttnt_summary$coefficients)
  
  # Get excluded classes for TTNT
  excluded_classes_ttnt <- c("unspecified", "Other")
  all_classes_ttnt <- NULL
  if (exists("landmark_ttnt_multiv") && !is.null(landmark_ttnt_multiv) && nrow(landmark_ttnt_multiv) > 0) {
    class_counts <- landmark_ttnt_multiv %>%
      filter(!is.na(therapy_class_factor)) %>%
      count(therapy_class_factor) %>%
      filter(n < 5 | as.character(therapy_class_factor) %in% excluded_classes_ttnt)
    excluded_classes_ttnt <- unique(c(excluded_classes_ttnt, as.character(class_counts$therapy_class_factor)))
    all_classes_ttnt <- levels(landmark_ttnt_multiv$therapy_class_factor)
  }
  
  # Extract all coefficients
  for (i in 1:n_coef_ttnt) {
    if (i <= nrow(cox_ttnt_summary$conf.int)) {
      term_name <- rownames(cox_ttnt_summary$coefficients)[i]
      hr_val <- cox_ttnt_summary$conf.int[i, "exp(coef)"]
      hr_lower <- cox_ttnt_summary$conf.int[i, "lower .95"]
      hr_upper <- cox_ttnt_summary$conf.int[i, "upper .95"]
      p_val <- cox_ttnt_summary$coefficients[i, "Pr(>|z|)"]
      
      # Extract variable name
      var_name <- extract_var_name(term_name, all_classes_ttnt, excluded_classes_ttnt)
      
      # Skip if variable name is NULL (excluded class)
      if (is.null(var_name)) {
        next
      }
      
      # Only add if HR values are reasonable
      if (!is.na(hr_val) && is.finite(hr_val) && hr_val > 0 && hr_val < 1e10 &&
          !is.na(hr_lower) && is.finite(hr_lower) &&
          !is.na(hr_upper) && is.finite(hr_upper)) {
        comparison_results_list[[length(comparison_results_list) + 1]] <- tibble(
          `Variable` = var_name,
          `Outcome` = "Time to Next Treatment",
          `HR (95% CI)` = paste0(round(hr_val, 2), " (", round(hr_lower, 2), "-", round(hr_upper, 2), ")"),
          `P-value` = if (is.na(p_val)) "NA" else if (p_val < 0.001) "<0.001" else as.character(round(p_val, 3))
        )
      }
    }
  }
}

# Create comparison table
if (length(comparison_results_list) > 0) {
  comparison_multiv <- bind_rows(comparison_results_list) %>%
    arrange(Variable, Outcome)
  
  # Create wide format for side-by-side comparison
  comparison_wide <- comparison_multiv %>%
    select(Variable, Outcome, `HR (95% CI)`, `P-value`) %>%
    pivot_wider(
      id_cols = Variable,
      names_from = Outcome,
      values_from = c(`HR (95% CI)`, `P-value`),
      names_sep = " - "
    )
  
  # Reorder columns - handle cases where one outcome might be missing
  col_order <- c("Variable")
  if ("HR (95% CI) - Duration of Complete Response" %in% names(comparison_wide)) {
    col_order <- c(col_order, "HR (95% CI) - Duration of Complete Response", "P-value - Duration of Complete Response")
  }
  if ("HR (95% CI) - Time to Next Treatment" %in% names(comparison_wide)) {
    col_order <- c(col_order, "HR (95% CI) - Time to Next Treatment", "P-value - Time to Next Treatment")
  }
  comparison_wide <- comparison_wide %>%
    select(all_of(col_order))
  
  # Highlight primary result
  comparison_wide <- comparison_wide %>%
    mutate(
      Variable = ifelse(
        str_detect(Variable, "^ctDNA Cleared"),
        paste0("**", Variable, "** (PRIMARY RESULT)"),
        Variable
      )
    )
  
  # Build kable with dynamic column specs
  comparison_multiv_table <- comparison_wide %>%
    kable(caption = "Comparison of Multivariate Cox Models: Duration of Complete Response vs Time to Next Treatment. **All results are fully adjusted** for line of therapy, therapy class (ADC, ICI, Chemo - excluding classes with <5 patients), KPS, and visceral metastases. The PRIMARY RESULT is ctDNA Cleared at Landmark vs Not Cleared. HR < 1 for DCR indicates longer duration of complete response; HR < 1 for TTNT indicates longer time to next treatment.", escape = FALSE) %>%
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"), full_width = TRUE, latex_options = "scale_down")
  
  # Add column specs dynamically
  n_cols <- ncol(comparison_wide)
  comparison_multiv_table <- comparison_multiv_table %>%
    column_spec(1, width = "30%")
  
  if (n_cols >= 3) {
    comparison_multiv_table <- comparison_multiv_table %>%
      column_spec(2, width = "20%") %>%
      column_spec(3, width = "15%")
  }
  
  if (n_cols >= 5) {
    comparison_multiv_table <- comparison_multiv_table %>%
      column_spec(4, width = "20%") %>%
      column_spec(5, width = "15%")
  }
} else {
  comparison_multiv_table <- NULL
}
